description: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailing finds all food buried deep underground.
name: Ursaring

description: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
name: Weezing

description: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.
name: Zangoose

description: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy's actions.
name: Espeon

description: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.
name: Bayleef

description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
name: Croconaw

description: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.
name: Donphan

description: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.
name: Flaaffy

description: It stores some of the air it inhales in its internal flame pouch, which heats it to over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Flareon

description: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.
name: Jolteon

description: It is found in volcanic craters. Its body temperature is over 1,100 degrees Fahrenheit, so don't underestimate it.
name: Magby

description: In an attempt to confuse its enemy, it mimics the enemy's movements. Then it wastes no time in making itself scarce!
name: Mime Jr.

description: It renders its prey immobile using well-developed claws, then carries the prey more than 60 miles to its nest.
name: Pidgeotto

description: This Pokémon is fully covered by nonflammable fur. It can withstand any kind of fire attack.
name: Quilava

description: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.
name: Forretress

description: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.
name: Riolu

description: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.
name: Seviper

description: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.
name: Vaporeon

description: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sunrays.
name: Chikorita

description: The moonlight that it stores in the wings on its back apparently gives it the ability to float in midair.
name: Clefairy

description: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
name: Cyndaquil

description: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.
name: Eevee

description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
name: Hitmonchan

description: If it starts kicking repeatedly, both legs will stretch even longer to strike a fleeing foe.
name: Hitmonlee

description: To corner prey, they check each other's location using barks that only they can understand.
name: Houndour

description: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.
name: Groudon

description: Its thin, filmy body is filled with gases that cause constant sniffles, coughs and teary eyes.
name: Koffing

description: For no reason, it jumps and splashes about, making it easy for predators like Pidgeotto to catch it mid-jump.
name: Magikarp

description: It dislikes cold places, so it blows scorching flames to make the environment suitable for itself.
name: Magmar

description: Its fleece grows continually. In the summer, the fleece is fully shed, but it grows back in a week.
name: Mareep

description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.
name: Mawile

description: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.
name: Misdreavus

description: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.
name: Phanpy

description: Common in grassy areas and forests, it is very docile and will chase off enemies by flapping up sand.
name: Pidgey

description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.
name: Pineco

description: Discovered by chance during deep-sea explorations, it has not changed since ancient times.
name: Relicanth

description: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.
name: Gyarados

description: It lazes vacantly near water. If something bites its tail, it won't even notice for a whole day.
name: Slowpoke

description: It has an active, playful nature. Many women like to frolic with it because of its affectionate ways.
name: Snubbull

description: It tangles any moving thing with its vines. Their subtle shaking is ticklish if you get ensnared.
name: Tangela

description: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.
name: Teddiursa

description: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.
name: Totodile

description: If it is attacked by an enemy that is stronger than itself, it feigns injury to fool the enemy and escapes.
name: Vulpix

description: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Draw 3 cards. Your opponent may draw a card.
name: Cheerleader's Cheer

description: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw a number of cards equal to the number of cards in your opponent's hand.
name: Copycat

description: Flip 2 coins. For each heads, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. If you do, shuffle your deck afterward.
name: Dual Ball

description: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Look at the top 8 cards of your deck. Choose as many Energy cards as you like, show them to your opponent, and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
name: Interviewer's Questions

description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.
name: Hitmontop

description: Put 1 Special Energy card attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon in the Lost Zone.
name: Lost Remover

description: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card. Once during each player's turn, if that player's opponent has 6 or more Pokémon in the Lost Zone, the player may choose to win the game.
name: Lost World

description: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Search your deck for an Evolution card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
name: Professor Elm's Training Method

description: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 6 cards.
name: Professor Oak's New Theory

description: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck and put as many of them as you like back on top of your deck in any order. Then, put the remaining cards on the bottom of your deck in any order.
name: Research Record

description: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Look at the top 5 cards of your deck. Choose any 2 cards you find there and put them into your hand. Discard the other cards.
name: Sage's Training

description: If the Pokémon Darkness Energy is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this Effect if the Pokémon that Darkness Energy is attached to isn't Darkness. Darkness Energy provides Darkness Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)
name: Darkness Energy

description: Damage done by attacks to the Pokémon that Metal Energy attached to is reduced by 10 (after applying Weakness and Resistance). Ignore this effect if the Pokémon that Metal Energy is attached to isn't Metal. Metal Energy provides Metal Energy. (Doesn't count as a basic Energy card.)
name: Metal Energy

description: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven-colored wings.
name: Ho-Oh

description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.
name: Deoxys

description: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.
name: Rayquaza

description: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.
name: Suicune

description: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.
name: Dialga

description: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.
name: Entei

description: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.
name: Groudon

description: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world's skies continuously on its magnificent seven-colored wings.
name: Ho-Oh

description: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.
name: Kyogre

description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.
name: Lugia

description: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.
name: Palkia

description: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.
name: Raikou

description: No matter how heavy the cargo, we can transport it to our destination with ease, thanks to Numel.
name: Team Magma's Numel

description: They all cry out at once to let us know when they spot an enemy. It really helps out!
name: Team Magma's Baltoy

description: Claydol's beam can seize opponents and keep them from moving. Long-range attacks are its specialty!
name: Team Magma's Claydol

description: Aron, which even devour metal, can eat and destroy enemy ships in an instant.
name: Team Magma's Aron

description: When Lairon uses Take Down, the impact from its solid body is enough to destroy concrete!
name: Team Magma's Lairon

description: Aggron's metal horns can smash through any defenses, no matter how strong!
name: Team Magma's Aggron

description: Poochyena can easily detect invading foes with its acute sense of smell. It's an excellent lookout!
name: Team Aqua's Poochyena

description: Poochyena's nose can identify any scent. It's very useful for reconnaissance.
name: Team Magma's Poochyena

description: Thanks to Mightyena's outstanding leadership, it's very good at combination attacks that can leave a foe helpless.
name: Team Aqua's Mightyena

description: This Pokémon is loyal to its master. It will protect its partner to the end, no matter what.
name: Team Magma's Mightyena

description: Camerupt, with its strength against fire, played a big role in rescuing team members.
name: Team Magma's Camerupt

description: You can't keep up with its movements underwater, can you? If you get caught in this whirlpool, there'll be no escape.
name: Team Aqua's Carvanha

description: It boasts fangs so powerful that they knock opponents out in one shot! Enemies that slip up will be taken down without fail!
name: Team Aqua's Sharpedo

description: Can you handle the formation attack of the fearless Zangoose?
name: Team Magma's Zangoose

description: The Team Aqua Pokémon this card is attached to can also use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)
name: Aqua Diffuser

description: The Team Magma Pokémon this card is attached to can also use the attack on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)
name: Magma Pointer

description: Attach a basic Energy card from your discard pile to your Active Team Aqua Pokémon.
name: Team Aqua Admin

description: Discard a card from your hand. (If you can't discard a card, you can't play this card.) Draw 3 cards. If you discarded a Team Aqua Pokémon, draw 1 more card.
name: Team Aqua Grunt

description: Search your deck for a Basic Team Aqua Pokémon and a basic {W} Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
name: Team Aqua's Great Ball

description: The Retreat Cost of each Pokémon in play (except for Team Aqua Pokémon) is {C} more.
name: Team Aqua's Secret Base

description: Put up to 3 Team Magma Pokémon from your discard pile into your hand.
name: Team Magma Admin

description: Spheal's Water Gun can put out any fire. Flames used by opponents have no effect!
name: Team Aqua's Spheal

description: Discard a card from your hand. (If you can't discard a card, you can't play this card.) Draw 3 cards. If you discarded a Team Magma Pokémon, draw 1 more card.
name: Team Magma Grunt

description: Search your deck for a Basic Team Magma Pokémon and a basic {F} Energy card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
name: Team Magma's Great Ball

description: Whenever any player puts a Basic Pokémon (except for Team Magma Pokémon) from his or her hand onto his or her Bench, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.
name: Team Magma's Secret Base

description:
This card can only be attached to Team Aqua Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of the turn you attached it.

This card provides {W}{W} Energy only while it is attached to a Team Aqua Pokémon.

(If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Aqua Pokémon, discard this card.)
name: Double Aqua Energy

description:
This card can only be attached to Team Magma Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of the turn you attached it.

This card provides {F}{F} Energy only while it is attached to a Team Magma Pokémon.

(If this card is attached to anything other than a Team Magma Pokémon, discard this card.)
name: Double Magma Energy

description: It provides support by making paths of ice. It can win any battle as long as it's on ice.
name: Team Aqua's Sealeo

description: It's good at attacks that freeze opponents with a powerful cold snap. Then, it pulverizes a frozen foe with its sharp tusks!
name: Team Aqua's Walrein

description: Its flexible body, which allows it to squeeze into any cracks, comes in handy when invading enemy hideouts.
name: Team Aqua's Grimer

description: It immobilizes its opponents by wrapping them in its huge, poisonous body. It'll smoosh you, too!
name: Team Aqua's Muk

description: Seviper's tail is a sharp blade. It can even poison you!
name: Team Aqua's Seviper

description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.
name: Bulbasaur

description: He loves to show off his vast knowledge. This expressive Pikachu is like a middle-aged man.
name: Detective Pikachu

description: Its pantomime skills are wonderful. You may become enraptured while watching it, but next thing you know, Mr. Mime has made a real wall.
name: Mr. Mime

description: This Pokémon was created by years of horrific gene splicing and DNA engineering experiments.
name: Mewtwo

description: It grasps its opponents with its four arms and twists them up in an intricate hold. People call it "the Machamp special."
name: Machamp

description: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.
name: Jigglypuff

description: It grows close to others easily and is also easily spoiled. The disparity between its face and its actions makes many young people wild about it.
name: Snubbull

description: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!
name: Lickitung

description: While it can transform into anything, each Ditto apparently has its own strengths and weaknesses when it comes to transformations.
name: Ditto

description: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.
name: Slaking

description: If it hears festive music, all its muscles fill with energy. It can't help breaking out into a dance.
name: Ludicolo

description: It scatters its shining spores around itself. Even though they're dangerous, nighttime tours of forests where Morelull live are popular.
name: Morelull

description: The flame on its tail indicates Charmander's life force. If it is healthy, the flame burns brightly.
name: Charmander

description: When expelling a blast of superhot fire, the red flame at the tip of its tail burns more intensely.
name: Charizard

description: Legends tell of its fighting alongside a general and conquering a whole country.
name: Arcanine

description: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.
name: Psyduck

description: In the distant past, they were fairly strong, but they have become gradually weaker over time.
name: Magikarp

description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
name: Greninja

description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
name: Dialga

description: Its cries sound like incantations. Those hearing it are tormented by headaches and hallucinations.
name: Mismagius

description: It feeds on eggs stolen from nests. Its sharply hooked claws rip vulnerable spots on prey.
name: Sneasel

description: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
name: Starly

description: It protects itself by spraying a noxious fluid from its rear. The stench lingers for 24 hours.
name: Stunky

description: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
name: Turtwig

description: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a STARLY, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
name: Wurmple

description: Remove all Special Conditions from each of your Active Pokémon.
name: Double Full Heal

description: Flip 3 coins. For each heads, put a basic Energy card from your discard pile into your hand. If you don't have that many basic Energy cards in your discard pile, put all of them into your hand.
name: Energy Restore

description: Move a basic Energy card attached to 1 of your Pokémon to another of your Pokémon.
name: Energy Switch

description: Choose 1 of your Pokémon. Flip 2 coins. If both are heads, remove all damage counters from that Pokémon. If both are tails, discard all Energy cards attached to that Pokémon.
name: Night Pokémon Center

description: Attach PlusPower to 1 of your Pokémon. Discard this card at the end of your turn. If the Pokémon PlusPower is attached to attacks, the attack does 10 more damage to the Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
name: PlusPower

description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
name: Palkia

description: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for a Pokémon, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
name: Poké Ball

description: Look at the top 2 cards of your deck, choose 1 of them, and put it into your hand. Put the other card on the bottom of your deck.
name: Pokédex HANDY910is

description: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Choose 1 card in your hand and shuffle the rest of your cards into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. (If this is the only card in your hand, you can't play this card.)
name: Professor Rowan

description: You can play only one Supporter card each turn. When you play this card, put it next to your Active Pokémon. When your turn ends, discard this card. Reveal the top 5 cards of your deck. Your opponent chooses 3 of those cards. Put those cards into your hand and put other 2 cards on top of your deck. Shuffle your deck afterward.
name: Rival

description: This card stays in play when you play it. Discard this card if another Stadium card comes into play. If another card with the same name is in play, you can't play this card. Once during each player's turn, the player may flip a coin until he or she gets tails. For each heads, that player draws a card.
name: Speed Stadium

description: Flip a coin. If heads, return 1 of your Pokémon and all cards attached to it to your hand.
name: Super Scoop Up

description: Your opponent switches 1 of his or her Defending Pokémon with 1 of his or her Benched Pokémon, if any. You switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon, if any.
name: Warp Point

description: Search your deck for a basic Energy card, show it to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Shuffle your deck afterward.
name: Energy Search

description: Remove 2 damage counters from 1 of your Pokémon (remove 1 damage counter if that Pokémon has only 1).
name: Potion

description: Switch 1 of your Active Pokémon with 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
name: Switch

description: It puts rocks in holes in its palms and uses its muscles to shoot them. Geodude are shot at rare times.
name: Rhyperior

description: It attracts prey with a sweet aroma, then downs it with thorny whips hidden in its arms.
name: Roserade

description: By flapping its leafy fan, it can whip up gusts of 100 ft/second that can level houses.
name: Shiftry

description: It sprays a vile-smelling fluid from the tip of its tail to attack. Its range is over 160 feet.
name: Skuntank

description: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
name: Staraptor

description: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
name: Torterra

description: It lives in rivers and lakes. In water, its coloring and patterns trick the vision of foes.
name: Azumarill

description: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey's fluids.
name: Beautifly

description: The antenna on its head captures radio waves from the world of spirits that command it to take people there.
name: Dusknoir

description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
name: Bibarel

description: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
name: Carnivine

description: Rarely seen by people, it is said to be drawn by the full moon to play at deserted lakes.
name: Clefable

description: It has the power in its clawed arms to make scrap of a car. The tips of its claws release poison.
name: Drapion

description: It's drowzy in daytime, but flies off in the evening in big groups. No one knows where they go.
name: Drifblim

description: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
name: Dustox

description: It floats using its well-developed floatation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
name: Floatzel

description: It hides in shadows. It is said that if Gengar is hiding, it cools that area by nearly 10 degrees F.
name: Gengar

description: It gathers in forests to search for tree sap, its favorite food. It's strong enough to hurl foes.
name: Heracross

description: It blasts internally stored sand from ports on its body to create a towering twister for attack.
name: Hippowdon

description: It pushes the tips of its two tails against the foe, then lets loose with over 20,000 volts of power.
name: Electivire

description: An extremely cautious Pokémon. It cloaks its body with its fluffy ear fur when it senses danger.
name: Lopunny

description: It punches with its four arms at blinding speed. It can launch 1,000 punches in two seconds.
name: Machamp

description: Through yoga training, it has honed its sixth sense. Its movements are elegant.
name: Medicham

description: It wolfs down its weight in food once a day, swallowing food whole with almost no chewing.
name: Munchlax

description: Its eyes are special. They can pick out objects as long as there is the tiniest amount of light.
name: Noctowl

description: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
name: Pachirisu

description: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon's nest and claims it as its own.
name: Purugly

description: Its stomach can digest any kind of food, even if it happens to be moldy or rotten.
name: Snorlax

description: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.
name: Steelix

description: Its abdomen is a honeycomb for grubs. It raises its grubs on honey collected by COMBEE.
name: Vespiquen

description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
name: Empoleon

description: They live in cold regions, forming groups of four or five that hunt prey with impressive coordination.
name: Weavile

description: It desperately tries to keep its black tail hidden. It is said to be proof the tail hides a secret.
name: Wobbuffet

description: It grows strong by pushing up against others en masse. It loves eating sweet fruit.
name: Wynaut

description: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.
name: Budew

description: It is hot inside its cocoon. All the cells in its body create the energy for it to evolve.
name: Cascoon

description: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.
name: Cherrim

description: A Pokémon formed by the spirits of people and Pokémon. It loves damp, humid seasons.
name: Drifloon

description: Its body is hollow. It is said that those who look into its body are sucked into the void.
name: Dusclops

description: It generates electricity by whirling its arms. However, it can't store the energy it makes.
name: Elekid

description: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
name: Grotle

description: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
name: Infernape

description: It can slip through any obstacle. It lurks inside walls to keep an eye on its foes.
name: Haunter

description: It lives in arid places. Instead of perspiration, it expels grainy sand from its body.
name: Hippopotas

description: Its claws loose electricity with enough amperage to cause fainting. They live in small groups.
name: Luxio

description: MACHOKE's boundless power is very dangerous, so it wears a belt that suppresses its energy.
name: Machoke

description: It is actually three MAGNEMITE linked by magnetism. A group can set off a magnetic storm.
name: Magneton

description: A friendly Pokémon that captures the subtle flows of seawater using its two antennae.
name: Mantyke

description: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
name: Monferno

description: The sound of its grass flute makes its listeners uneasy. It lives deep in forests.
name: Nuzleaf

description: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
name: Prinplup

description: It gallops at nearly 150 mph. With its mane blazing ferociously, it races as if it were an arrow.
name: Rapidash

description: It has the ability to sense the auras of all things. It understands human speech.
name: Lucario

description: Its brain developed after it stood up on its hind legs. Its drill horn bores tunnels through solid rock.
name: Rhydon

description: The aura that emanates from its body intensifies to alert others if it is afraid or sad.
name: Riolu

description: It makes its nest by hollowing out boulders in streams with its horn. It defends its eggs with its life.
name: Seaking

description: It anchors itself by wrapping twigs with the silk from its body. It motionlessly awaits evolution.
name: Silcoon

description: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
name: Staravia

description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.
name: Unown A

description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.
name: Unown B

description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.
name: Unown C

description: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or UNOWN came first.
name: Unown D

description: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.
name: Azurill

description: It has eyes that can see through anything. It spots and captures prey hiding behind objects.
name: Luxray

description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
name: Bidoof

description: It looks as if it is always crying. It is actually adjusting its body's fluid levels by eliminating excess.
name: Bonsly

description: It has a flotation sac that is like an inflatable collar. It floats on water with its head out.
name: Buizel

description: It slams foes by sharply uncoiling its rolled ears. It stings enough to make a grown-up cry in pain.
name: Buneary

description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
name: Chatot

description: The small ball holds the nutrients needed for evolution. Apparently, it is very sweet and tasty.
name: Cherubi

description: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
name: Chimchar

description: Thought to live with others on quiet mountains, it is popular for its adorable nature.
name: Clefairy

description: Its silhouette is like a star. It is believed to arrive riding on shooting stars.
name: Cleffa

description: A Pokémon formed by three others. It busily carries sweet floral honey to VESPIQUEN.
name: Combee

description: It evolved from exposure to a special magnetic field. Three units generate magnetism.
name: Magnezone

description: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.
name: Duskull

description: Half of all blackouts occur when this Pokémon appears at power plants and eats electricity.
name: Electabuzz

description: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.
name: Slowking

description: They say that during past strife, Gyarados would appear and leave blazing ruins in its wake.
name: Gyarados

description: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.
name: Wobbuffet

description: The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.
name: Ampharos

description: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.
name: Ariados

name: Butterfree

description: Because of its unusual, star-like silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

description: If a head drops off, it emits a telepathic call in search of others to form an Exeggcute cluster.
name: Exeggutor

description: If it eats the plant stalk it carries as emergency rations, it runs off in search of a new stalk.

description: When it plays in water, it rolls up its elongated ears to prevent their insides from getting wet.

description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

description: Because its fangs are too heavy, it always keeps its head tilted down. However, its bite is powerful.

description: The spot patterns on its back grow larger or smaller depending on the number of stars in the night sky.

description: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
name: Weezing

description: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.

description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

description: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

description: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.

name: Rare Candy

description: Shuffle your deck!
name: Alph Lithograph

name: Bellossom

name: Honchkrow

name: Wurmple

description: Within its internal organs, Snom amplifies the frigid air it gets from eating snow and then uses this amplified air to create icicle-like spikes.
name: Snom

description: It causes blizzards as it flies around with its huge, chill-emanating wings. Clean meltwater is its favorite thing to drink.
name: Frosmoth

description: Glastrier emits intense cold from its hooves. It’s also a belligerent Pokémon—anything it wants, it takes by force.
name: Glastrier

description: When its electricity builds, its muscles are stimulated, and it becomes more aggressive than usual.
name: Raichu

description: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
name: Tynamo

description: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
name: Eelektrik

description: It conceals itself in the mud of the seashore. Then it waits. When prey touch it, it delivers a jolt of electricity.
name: Stunfisk

description: The frills on either side of its head have cells that generate electricity when exposed to sunlight.
name: Helioptile

description: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.
name: Heliolisk

description: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.
name: Charjabug

description: When carrying a Charjabug, Vikavolt can receive electricity from it and then rapidly fire powerful electromagnetic beams from its large jaws.
name: Vikavolt

description: Although it’s called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.
name: Tapu Koko

description: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.
name: Iono's Tadbulb

description: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.
name: Iono's Wattrel

description: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.
name: Iono's Kilowattrel

description: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.
name: Clefairy

description: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.
name: Clefable

description: Using telepathy only fellow Exeggcute can pick up on, they always form a cluster of six.
name: Team Rocket's Exeggcute

description: It is said that on rare occasions, one of its heads will drop off and continue on as an Exeggcute.
name: Team Rocket's Exeggutor

description: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
name: Togepi

description: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.
name: Togetic

description: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they’ve hardly been seen at all.
name: Togekiss

description: The oil-filled tail functions as a buoy, so it’s fine even in rivers with strong currents.
name: Marill

description: It loves to bite and yank people's hair from behind without warning, just to see their shocked reactions.
name: Misdreavus

description: Its cries sound like incantations to torment the foe. It appears where you least expect it.
name: Mismagius

description: The horns on its head provide a strong power that enables it to sense people’s emotions.
name: Ralts

description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.
name: Kirlia

description: It loves to feed on feelings like envy and malice. Its upright horn catches the emotions of people.
name: Shuppet

description: This Pokémon developed from an abandoned doll that amassed a grudge. It is seen in dark alleys.
name: Banette

description: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.
name: Rotom

description: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.
name: Slurpuff

description: According to old tales, these Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died while lost in the forest.
name: Hop's Phantump

description: Using its roots as a nervous system, it controls the trees in the forest. It’s kind to the Pokémon that reside in its body.
name: Hop's Trevenant

description: This Pokémon lives in dark places untouched by sunlight. When it appears before humans, it hides itself under a cloth that resembles a Pikachu.
name: Team Rocket's Mimikyu

description: It probes its surroundings with all its senses save one—it doesn’t use its sense of sight. Spectrier’s kicks are said to separate soul from body.
name: Spectrier

description: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.
name: Munkidori

description: Its skin is very thin. If it is exposed to light, its blood heats up, causing it to grow weak.
name: Team Rocket's Diglett

description: In battle, it digs through the ground and strikes the unsuspecting foe from an unexpected direction.
name: Team Rocket's Dugtrio

description: It spins on its horn while dealing out elegant kicks. Its horn grows continuously through its lifetime.
name: Hitmontop

description: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.
name: Lunatone

description: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.
name: Solrock

description: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.
name: Groudon

description: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.
name: Cynthia's Gible

description: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.
name: Cynthia's Gabite

description: They communicate with one another using their auras. They are able to run all through the night.
name: Riolu

description: It does its level best to glare and pull a scary face, but it can’t help grinning if anyone pats its head.
name: Pancham

description: Chunks of the surface of this Pokémon’s body that have grown old and flaked off have long been used for fuel as an alternative to coal.
name: Rolycoly

description: Due to the coal tar created inside it, the heap of coal on Carkol’s back never falls apart, even when the Pokémon rolls around at high speeds.
name: Carkol

description: It’s gentle usually but fearsome when angered. With a body that burns at over 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit, it crushes foes and turns them to ash.
name: Coalossal

description: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.
name: Okidogi

description: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.
name: Gastly

description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
name: Haunter

description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.
name: Team Rocket's Murkrow

description: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than 100 of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.
name: Team Rocket's Honchkrow

description: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
name: Poochyena

description: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
name: Mightyena

description: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.
name: Galarian Zigzagoon

description: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.
name: Galarian Linoone

description: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
name: Galarian Obstagoon

description: Its constant mischief and misdeeds resulted in it being bound to an Odd Keystone by a mysterious spell.
name: Cynthia's Spiritomb

description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
name: Scraggy

description: It changes into the forms of others to surprise them. Apparently, it often transforms into a silent child.
name: N's Zorua

description: Its healthy appetite leads to visible growth spurts. It often has to replace the bones it wears as its size increases.
name: Vullaby

description: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
name: Hoopa

description: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
name: Pecharunt

description: Attached to its head is a huge set of jaws formed by horns. It can chew through iron beams.
name: Mawile

description: Any chips in its blades would prove fatal for it. After each battle, it diligently maintains its blades using its favorite sharpening stone.
name: Pawniard

description: Bisharp mercilessly cuts its opponents to pieces with the sharp blades covering its body. It will do anything to win.
name: Bisharp

description: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.
name: Kingambit

description: This Pokémon is full of life energy. It continually sheds its skin and grows steadily larger.
name: Dratini

description: Its crystalline orbs appear to give this Pokémon the power to freely control the weather.
name: Dragonair

description: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
name: Rayquaza

description: According to myth, if people ignore truth and let themselves become consumed by greed, Reshiram will arrive to burn their kingdoms down.
name: N's Reshiram

description: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.
name: N's Zekrom

description: Even a robust wrestler will become dizzy and unable to stand when exposed to its 200,000-hertz ultrasonic waves.
name: Noibat

description: They fly around on moonless nights and attack careless prey. Nothing can beat them in a battle in the dark.
name: Noivern

description: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn’t feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.
name: Dreepy

description: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they’re all grown up.
name: Drakloak

description: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.

description: If spotted, it escapes by burrowing with its tail. It can float just slightly using its wings.
name: Larry's Dunsparce

description: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
name: Skitty

description: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.
name: Delcatty

description: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.
name: Larry's Starly

description: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.

description: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.
name: Larry's Staraptor

description: There are several appliances that Rotom can inspirit, but the first one to be developed was the electric fan.
name: Fan Rotom

description: With its sharp claws, this Pokémon pierces its prey, and then it pecks at them. Although it also consumes berries, it’s a carnivore at heart.
name: Larry's Rufflet

description: For the sake of its friends, this brave warrior of the sky will not stop battling, even if injured.
name: Larry's Braviary

description: A potent anesthetic can be made by diluting Komala’s drool. This anesthetic was used for surgeries in the past.
name: Larry's Komala

description: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it completely destroys its surroundings with its intense breath.
name: Drampa

description: Cramorant instinctively swallow everything whole. They’re at their most formidable when they’re struggling to swallow overly large prey.
name: Hop's Cramorant

description: The shell is made of crystallized Terastal energy. When struck by a move, this shell absorbs the move’s energy and transfers it to Terapagos.

description: Attach Gold Berry to 1 of your Pokémon that doesn't have a Pokémon Tool attached to it. name: Palossand

description: When the sun goes down, it becomes active. It runs around town on a chase for good food for the boss of its nest—Raticate.
name: Alolan Rattata

description: This gourmet Pokémon is particular about the taste and freshness of its food. Restaurants where Raticate live have a good reputation.
name: Alolan Raticate

description: This Pokémon was not originally found in Alola. Human actions caused a surge in their numbers, and they went feral. They're prideful and crafty.
name: Alolan Meowth

description: Its round face and smooth coat—softer than the most high-class velvet—have made this a very popular Pokémon in Alola.
name: Alolan Persian

description: Its wings and antennae don't cope well with moisture. After a rain, it faces sunward to dry off.
name: Masquerain

description: If they scent the faintest trace of blood, they rush to attack en masse. When alone, they're rather cowardly.
name: Carvanha

description: It has a sad history. In the past, its dorsal fin was a treasured foodstuff, so this Pokémon became a victim of overfishing.
name: Sharpedo

description: It submerges itself in sand and moves as if swimming. This wise behavior keeps its enemies from finding it and maintains its temperature.
name: Sandile

description: They move in groups of a few individuals. A female is often the leader of the group, and the males will gather food.
name: Krokorok

description: Its unique faculty of sight can detect small prey more than 30 miles away, even in the midst of a sandstorm.
name: Krookodile

description: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.
name: Alolan Diglett

description: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.
name: Alolan Dugtrio

description: Its feathers, which fall off as it grows, are thin and sharp. In times long past, warriors used them as swords.
name: Skarmory

description: This wary Pokémon uses photosynthesis to store up energy during the day, while becoming active at night.
name: Rowlet

description: Its growls make its opponents uneasy. This laid-back Pokémon tends to sleep half the day.
name: Snubbull

description: More timid than Snubbull, this Pokémon is doted on by young people amused at the contrast between its looks and its attitude.
name: Granbull

description: It feeds on the nectar and pollen of flowers. Because it's able to sense auras, it can identify which flowers are about to bloom.
name: Cutiefly

description: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
name: Ribombee

description: After a 10-hour struggle, a fisherman was able to pull one up and confirm its existence.
name: Dratini

description: From time immemorial, it has been venerated by agricultural peoples as an entity able to control the weather.
name: Dragonair

description: Incur the wrath of this normally calm Pokémon at your peril, because it will smash everything to smithereens before it's satisfied.
name: Dragonite

description: Farmers whose fields are troubled by bug Pokémon appreciate Spearow for its vigorous appetite and look after it.
name: Spearow

description: Drawings of a Pokémon resembling Fearow can be seen in murals from deep in ancient history.
name: Fearow

description: Kangaskhan's maternal love is so deep that it will brave death to protect its offspring.
name: Kangaskhan

description: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.
name: Venonat

description: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.
name: Tyrogue

description: It fights while spinning like a top. The centrifugal force boosts its destructive power by 10.
name: Hitmontop

description: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.
name: Riolu

description: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as "The Guardian of the Fields."
name: Landorus

description: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.
name: Crabrawler

description: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!
name: Crabominable

description: It appeared from an Ultra Wormhole. Each one appears to be made up of many life-forms stacked one on top of each other.
name: Stakataka

description: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.
name: Murkrow

description: The scales it scatters will paralyze anyone who touches them, making that person unable to stand.
name: Venomoth

description: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!
name: Carvanha

description: People believe that carrying one of its discarded fangs will prevent mishaps at sea, so the fangs are made into accessories.
name: Sharpedo

description: A Pokémon that was formed by 108 spirits. It is bound to a fissure in an odd keystone.
name: Spiritomb

description: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.
name: Sandile

description: Alola, where it's warm all year round, is a comfortable environment for this Pokémon. Sometimes you'll even see it outside of deserts.
name: Sandile

description: Krokorok really hates it when its body gets cold. On nights when the temperature drops, it digs deep into the desert sands.
name: Krokorok

description: When it spots prey, even at a distance of over 30 miles, it swims through the desert as if it were water, then jumps out and chomps them.
name: Krookodile

description: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
name: Greninja

description: It draws prey near with its blinking lights and then wraps them up in its long tentacles and holds them in place.
name: Inkay

description: When it comes to strong hypnosis, there's an endless number of people who utilize Malamar for their nefarious deeds.
name: Malamar

description: Although it's powerful enough to dig right through volcanic rock, it doesn't allow itself to be seen very often.
name: Alolan Diglett

description: Its metallic whiskers are heavy, so it's not very fast, but it has the power to dig through bedrock.
name: Alolan Dugtrio

description: It usually lives deep in mountains. However, hunger may drive it to eat railroad tracks and cars.
name: Aron

description: It loves iron ore. Groups of them fight for territory by bashing one another with their steel bodies.
name: Lairon

description: It claims an entire mountain as its own. The more wounds it has, the more it has battled, so don't take it lightly.
name: Aggron

description: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.
name: Lucario

description: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
name: Genesect

description: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
name: Meltan

description: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
name: Melmetal

description: Even though its body is extremely skinny, it is blindingly fast when catching its prey.
name: Bellsprout

description: On nights with many shooting stars, they gather in packs and dance in circles. If you should see them, something good will happen!
name: Cleffa

description: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.
name: Clefairy

description: It can't help but hear a pin drop from over half a mile away, so it lives deep in the mountains where there aren't many people or Pokémon.
name: Clefable

description: Recordings of Jigglypuff's strange lullabies can be purchased from department stores. These CDs can be found near the bedding area.
name: Jigglypuff

description: Thanks to its bouncy body and fine fur, this Pokémon is sought after. Holding one in your arms while you sleep feels great.
name: Wigglytuff

description: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.
name: Togepi

description: It grows dispirited if it is not with kind people. It can float in midair without moving its wings.
name: Togetic

description: As everyone knows, it visits peaceful regions, bringing them gifts of kindness and sweet blessings.
name: Togekiss

description: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.
name: Cottonee

description: The leafy parts act as cutters for slashing foes. It spits a fluid that dissolves everything.
name: Weepinbell

description: It emits a scent that enraptures those who smell it. This fragrance changes depending on what it has eaten.
name: Spritzee

description: It devises various scents, pleasant and unpleasant, and emits scents that its enemies dislike in order to gain an edge in battle.
name: Aromatisse

description: Its incisors grow continuously throughout its life. If its incisors get too long, this Pokémon becomes unable to eat, and it starves to death.
name: Rattata

description: People say that it fled from its enemies by using its small webbed hind feet to swim from island to island in Alola.
name: Raticate

description: Its reckless nature leads it to stand up to others—even large Pokémon—if it has to protect its territory.
name: Spearow

description: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!
name: Fearow

description: When visiting a junkyard, you may catch sight of it having an intense fight with Murkrow over shiny objects.
name: Meowth

description: Although the jewel on its forehead appears to be a different color than those of Alolan Persian, it's mostly made of the same material.
name: Persian

description: Said to live in huge colonies deep in jungles, although no one has ever returned from there.
name: Victreebel

description: A two-headed Pokémon that was discovered as a sudden mutation. It runs at a pace of over 60 miles per hour.
name: Doduo

description: An enemy that takes its eyes off any of the three heads—even for a second—will get pecked severely.
name: Dodrio

description: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!
name: Lickitung

description: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.
name: Lickilicky

description: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.
name: Porygon

description: This Pokémon was created using the cutting-edge science of 20 years ago, so many parts of it have since become obsolete.
name: Porygon

description: AI has been installed in it. It learns various things all on its own, but it even remembers things it doesn't need to know.
name: Porygon2

description: Its behavior is noticeably unstable, which is apparently due to the incompetence of the engineer who updated its programming.
name: Porygon-Z

description: It doesn't do anything other than eat and sleep. When prompted to make a serious effort, though, it apparently displays awesome power.
name: Snorlax

description: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
name: Glameow

description: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.
name: Tangela

description: It would claim another Pokémon's nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
name: Purugly

description: Usually it's a well-behaved Pokémon, but if you take its round rock away, it will cry and fuss and throw a big old tantrum.
name: Happiny

description: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.
name: Chatot

name: Darmanitan

name: Volcanion

description: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.
name: Litten

description: If you try too hard to get close to it, it won't open up to you. Even if you do grow close, giving it too much affection is still a no-no.
name: Litten

description: It can act spoiled if it grows close to its Trainer. A powerful Pokémon, its sharp claws can leave its Trainer's whole body covered in scratches.
name: Torracat

description: Although it's rough mannered and egotistical, it finds beating down unworthy opponents boring. It gets motivated for stronger opponents.
name: Incineroar

description: Its shell is filled with a thick liquid. All of the cells throughout its body are being rebuilt in preparation for evolution.
name: Metapod

description: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.
name: Salandit

description: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.
name: Salazzle

description: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.
name: Blacephalon

description: It shelters itself in its shell, then strikes back with spouts of water at every opportunity.
name: Squirtle

description: When tapped, this Pokémon will pull in its head, but its tail will still stick out a little bit.
name: Wartortle

description: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.
name: Poliwag

description: Despite the danger, it wants to come up on land. So it does its best to waddle along, but when an enemy finds it, it rushes back to the water.
name: Poliwag

description: Although it has become capable of living on land, it spends its time in the water, where its prey, fish Pokémon, are plentiful.
name: Poliwhirl

description: It's quite a gifted swimmer, even among Water-type Pokémon, but it normally spends its time on land.
name: Poliwrath

description: Its wings are covered in toxic scales. If it finds bird Pokémon going after Caterpie, Butterfree sprinkles its scales on them to drive them off.
name: Butterfree

description: It drifts through the sea searching for prey. Its poisonous tentacles break off sometimes, but after a while, they grow back.
name: Tentacool

description: It fires off ultrasonic waves from its red orbs to weaken its prey, and then it wraps them up in its 80 tentacles.
name: Tentacruel

description: There are some places where Slowpoke is worshiped because of a long-standing belief that whenever Slowpoke yawns, it rains.
name: Slowpoke

description: Spacing out is basically all it does. It turns back into Slowpoke if its tail, along with Shellder, breaks off.
name: Slowbro

description: It has always been supposed that Seel live only in cold seas. Their having shown up in Alola is a mystery.
name: Seel

description: It swims through the ocean at a speed of eight knots, searching for Pokémon that will become its prey. It's especially fond of Wishiwashi.
name: Dewgong

description: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
name: Krabby

description: Its large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
name: Kingler

description: Although known for their splendid tail fins, Goldeen apparently compete among themselves to see whose horn is thickest and sharpest.
name: Goldeen

description: Its horn spins like a drill to steadily hollow out rocks—even harder ones. The coloration of the male is more vivid.
name: Seaking

description: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
name: Oddish

description: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.
name: Kyurem

description: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
name: Froakie

description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
name: Frogadier

description: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.
name: Pyukumuku

description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.
name: Pikachu

description: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.
name: Raichu

description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
name: Stunfisk

description: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you'll get a shock!
name: Charjabug

description: It has an organ that generates electricity in its abdomen. It concentrates energy in its strong jaws and fires off powerful jolts of electricity.
name: Vikavolt

description: During the day, It stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
name: Oddish

description: It electrifies its claws and tears its opponents apart with them. Even if they dodge its attack, they'll be electrocuted by the flying sparks.
name: Zeraora

description: By dislocating its jaw, it can swallow prey larger than itself. After a meal, it curls up and rests.
name: Ekans

description: The latest research has determined that there are over 20 possible arrangements of the patterns on its stomach.
name: Arbok

description: It has no eyeballs, so it can't see. It checks its surroundings via the ultrasonic waves it emits from its mouth.
name: Zubat

description: Every once in a while, you'll see a Golbat that's missing some fangs. This happens when hunger drives it to try biting a Steel-type Pokémon.
name: Golbat

description: Its fangs are so sharp, if it bites you in the dark and sucks your blood, you won't notice any pain or realize you've been bitten.
name: Crobat

description: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.
name: Gastly

description: It's said that gas emanating from a graveyard was possessed by the grievances of the deceased and thus became a Pokémon.

description: On moonless nights, Haunter searches for someone to curse, so it's best not to go out walking around.
name: Haunter

description: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.
name: Gloom

description: You can hear tales told all over the world about how Gengar will pay a visit to children who are naughty.
name: Gengar

description: It can be spotted near recreational facilities, intending to eat the pleasant dreams of children who enjoyed themselves there that day.
name: Drowzee

description: In Alola, Komala is Hypno's main target. It rarely harms people.
name: Hypno

description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.
name: Koffing

description: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.
name: Weezing

description: It was created by a scientist after years of horrific gene-splicing and DNA-engineering experiments.
name: Mewtwo

description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
name: Mew

description: What gives meaning to its life is surprising others. If you set your ear against the red orbs around its neck, you can hear shrieking.
name: Misdreavus

description: Feared for its wrath and the curses it spreads, this Pokémon will also, on a whim, cast spells that help people.
name: Mismagius

description: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
name: Espurr

description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
name: Vileplume

description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck into dust.
name: Meowstic

description: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.
name: Marshadow

description: It lives in areas of limited rainfall. When danger approaches, it curls up into a ball to protect its soft stomach.
name: Sandshrew

description: Its claws and horns often break off. The broken claws and horns can be used to carve plows for tilling farm fields.
name: Sandslash

description: It travels through tunnels that it digs underground. It hates sunlight, so it comes out only after the sun goes down.
name: Diglett

description: While the three of them normally get along splendidly, on rare occasions a huge fight will break out over which head gets to eat first.

description: Geodude that have lived a long life have had all their edges smoothed out until they're totally round. They also have a calm, quiet disposition.

description: It climbs up cliffs as it heads toward the peak of a mountain. As soon as it reaches the summit, it rolls back down the way it came.
name: Graveler

description: When Golem grow old, they stop shedding their shells. Those that have lived a long, long time have shells green with moss.
name: Golem

description: Its big eyes are actually clusters of tiny eyes. At night, its kind is drawn by light.

description: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.
name: Cubone

description: It throws bones at Mandibuzz to knock it down. It's thought that Marowak is trying to avenge its parent.
name: Marowak

description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.
