description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.
name: Rhyhorn

description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Rhydon

description: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
name: Rhyperior

description: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
name: Wooper

description: It has a sluggish nature. It lies at the river's bottom, waiting for prey to stray into its mouth.
name: Quagsire

description: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.
name: Gligar

description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
name: Gliscor

description: It makes a hole in a suitable rock. If that rock breaks, the Pokémon remains agitated until it locates a replacement.
name: Dwebble

description: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.
name: Cosmog

description: It looks somehow pained as it rages around in search of light, which serves as its energy. It's apparently from another world.
name: Necrozma

description: This Ultra Beast is well enough liked to be chosen as a first partner in its own world.
name: Poipole

description: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.
name: Onix

description: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.
name: Steelix

description: At night, it weeps loudly for its dead mother, but those cries only attract its natural enemy—Mandibuzz.
name: Cubone

description: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.
name: Heracross

description: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
name: Breloom

description: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
name: Meditite

description: It possesses legs of enormous strength, enabling it to carry heavy slabs for many days, even when crossing arid land.
name: Crustle

description: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
name: Medicham

description: Thought to have gone extinct, Relicanth was given a name that is a variation of the name of the person who discovered it.
name: Relicanth

description: It reacts to anything that moves—flies right at it and bites it. Sometimes it injures itself, but it doesn't care too much.
name: Gible

description: It loves shiny things. When it finds a Sableye trying to catch a Carbink, Gabite becomes furiously angry and attacks the Sableye.
name: Gabite

description: It flies at the speed of sound while searching for prey, and it has midair battles with Salamence as the two compete for food.
name: Garchomp

description: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.
name: Riolu

description: It knows how people and Pokémon feel by looking at their auras. It doesn't approach dangerous opponents.
name: Riolu

description: It concentrates its mental energy and fires off mysterious waves called auras, which can crush boulders of large size to dust.
name: Lucario

description: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.
name: Drilbur

description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.
name: Excadrill

description: These mysterious Pokémon evolve when they receive electrical stimulation while they are in the same place as Shelmet.
name: Karrablast

description: Once thought to be the ancestor of all bird Pokémon, some of the latest research suggests that may not be the case.
name: Archen

description: This ancient Pokémon's plumage is delicate, so if anyone other than an experienced professional tries to restore it, they will fail.
name: Archeops

description: Its charge is strong enough to break through a giant castle wall in one blow. This Pokémon is spoken of in legends.
name: Terrakion

description: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.
name: Meloetta

description: This is Zygarde when about 10% of its pieces have been assembled. It leaps at its opponent's chest and sinks its sharp fangs into them.
name: Zygarde

description: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.
name: Alolan Grimer

description: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.
name: Murkrow

description: It has a weakness for shiny things. It's been known to sneak into the nests of Gabite—noted collectors of jewels—in search of treasure.
name: Murkrow

description: It lures people in with its Poké Ball pattern, then releases poison spores. Why it resembles a Poké Ball is unknown.
name: Foongus

description: It will absolutely not forgive failure from or betrayal by its goons. It has no choice in this if it wants to maintain the order of the flock.
name: Honchkrow

description: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.
name: Sneasel

description: It digs through the ground with its hard claws and crunches down gems with its thick pointy teeth. Carbink is its favorite food.
name: Sableye

description: It takes pride in its strength. Even though it can tear foes apart, it finishes them off with powerful poison.
name: Drapion

description: Its cute act is a ruse. When victims let down their guard, they find their items taken. It attacks with sharp claws.
name: Purrloin

description: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
name: Liepard

description: They move in small groups, walking around lazily. Anyone who makes eye contact gets smacked with a headbutt.
name: Scraggy

description: This Pokémon may be rude, but it takes very good care of its family, its friends, and its turf.
name: Scrafty

description: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
name: Yveltal

description: They show off their Poké Ball caps to lure prey, but very few Pokémon are fooled by this.
name: Amoonguss

description: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
name: Hoopa

description: Wearing the shell covering they stole from Shelmet, they defend themselves and attack with two lances.
name: Escavalier

description: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.
name: Cottonee

description: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.
name: Whimsicott

description: It sneaks into people's homes and steals electricity from their outlets. When your electric bill seems off, it's the handiwork of this rascal.
name: Dedenne

description: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.
name: Dratini

description: It's still weak, so it lurks on the floor of bodies of water, eating whatever food sinks down and living a quiet life.
name: Dratini

description: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.
name: Dragonair

description: When the sun rises, Fomantis spreads its four leaves and bathes in the sunlight. The tip of its head has a pleasant aroma.
name: Fomantis

description: Lakes where Dragonair live are filled with offerings from people, because they believe this Pokémon is able to control the weather.
name: Dragonair

description: It flies over raging seas as if they were nothing. Observing this, a ship's captain dubbed this Pokémon "the sea incarnate."
name: Dragonite

description: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
name: Latias

description: They use their tusks to crush the berries they eat. Repeated regrowth makes their tusks strong and sharp.
name: Axew

description: Their tusks can shatter rocks. Territory battles between Fraxure can be intensely violent.
name: Fraxure

description: They are kind but can be relentless when defending territory. They challenge foes with tusks that can cut steel.
name: Haxorus

description: The red skin on its face is harder than rock. In narrow caves, it squares off against its enemies and charges face-first right into them.
name: Druddigon

description: Fruits are its favorite foods. This gourmet carefully picks out just the ripe ones using its sonar.
name: Noibat

description: Although it has a violent disposition, if you give it a nice ripe fruit that it loves, Noivern will suddenly become tame.
name: Noivern

description: For self-protection, it pretends to be a bug Pokémon. Both of its arms bear keen-edged petals.
name: Lurantis

description: It checks out whatever's around it by licking everything. If you don't clean off a spot where it's licked you, you'll break out in a rash!
name: Lickitung

description: A contest is under way to determine which one can stick its tongue out the farthest. The current record is…more than 82 feet.
name: Lickilicky

description: Kangaskhan protects its child by keeping it in its pouch. It has zero forgiveness for those who harm its child and will beat them down.
name: Kangaskhan

description: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.
name: Tauros

description: Every day, it tilts its head in the same rhythm. A long time ago, people raised these Pokémon to serve as clocks.
name: Hoothoot

description: With eyes that can see in pitch-darkness, it never lets its prey escape. Some even call it "the emperor of dark nights."
name: Noctowl

description: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.
name: Slakoth

description: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.
name: Slakoth

description: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can't sit still for one second.
name: Vigoroth

description: Because of its sweet, delicious aroma, bird Pokémon are always after it, but it's not intelligent enough to care.
name: Bounsweet

description: The world's laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there's no food left within its reach.
name: Slaking

description: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
name: Bidoof

description: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
name: Bibarel

description: It hides food under its long fur, but it sometimes forgets about it and causes a stinky disturbance.
name: Munchlax

description: This very forgetful Pokémon will wait for a new order from its Trainer even though it already has one.
name: Pidove

description: Many people believe that, deep in the forest where Tranquill live, there is a peaceful place where there is no war.
name: Tranquill

description: Males swing their head plumage to threaten opponents. The females' flying abilities surpass those of the males.
name: Unfezant

description: Using the feelers on its ears, it can tell how someone is feeling or when an egg might hatch.
name: Audino

description: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
name: Tornadus

description: While it's an amiable Pokémon, if you touch it unexpectedly, it will heat up its body in an instant, and you'll be burned.
name: Fletchling

description: It's protected by its hard sepals, so it plays with bird Pokémon without worry. They peck it relentlessly, but it doesn't care.
name: Steenee

description: Its stomach takes up most of its long torso. It's a big eater, so the amount Trainers have to spend on its food is no laughing matter.
name: Yungoos

description: Although it wasn't originally found in Alola, this Pokémon was brought over a long time ago when there was a huge Rattata outbreak.
name: Gumshoos

description: It normally spends its time meditating in the treetops. It throws Poké Balls and gives other Pokémon orders as it pleases.
name: Oranguru

description: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.
name: Type: Null

description: This is its form once it has awakened and evolved. Freed from its heavy mask, its speed is greatly increased.
name: Silvally

description: It stays asleep from the moment it's born. When it falls into a deep sleep, it stops moving altogether.
name: Komala

description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
name: Victini

name: Litwick

name: Litwick

name: Lampent

description: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes' heads instantly while flying by at high speed.
name: Yanmega

description: Being consumed in Chandelure's flame burns up the spirit, leaving the body behind.
name: Chandelure

description: It scatters embers in the tall grass. Then bug Pokémon, frightened by the flames, come flying out, and Fletchinder gobbles them up.
name: Fletchinder

description: Its tough wings don't allow fire to pass through them. A long time ago, firefighters' outfits were made from Talonflame wings.
name: Talonflame

description: The males will do whatever the females tell them. They give the females most of their food. Due to malnutrition, the males can't evolve.
name: Salandit

description: Salazzle lives deep in caves and forces the Salandit it has attracted with its pheromones to serve it.
name: Salazzle

description: It likes swimming around with people on its back. In the Alola region, it's an important means of transportation over water.
name: Lapras

description: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.
name: Snorunt

description: It freezes hikers who have come to climb snowy mountains and carries them back to its home. It only goes after men it thinks are handsome.
name: Froslass

description: When night falls, their pink patterns begin to shine. They're popular with divers, so there are resorts that feed them to keep them close.
name: Finneon

description: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
name: Celebi

description: Deep down at the bottom of the ocean, prey is scarce. Lumineon get into fierce disputes with Lanturn over food.
name: Lumineon

description: During cold seasons, it migrates to the mountain's lower reaches. It returns to the snow-covered summit in the spring.
name: Snover

description: It blankets wide areas in snow by whipping up blizzards. It is also known as "The Ice Monster."
name: Abomasnow

description: Savage, violent Pokémon, red and blue Basculin are always fighting each other over territory.
name: Basculin

description: It was restored from an ancient fossil. Tirtouga lived in the sea but came up onto the land to search for prey.
name: Tirtouga

description: Its jaws are terrifyingly powerful. It could eat Omastar and Omanyte whole and not be bothered in the slightest by their shells.
name: Carracosta

description: They are born in snow clouds. They use chains made of ice crystals to capture prey.
name: Cryogonal

description: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.
name: Dewpider

description: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.
name: Araquanid

description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
name: Shroomish

description: It will pick up anything it finds on the ground. Sometimes it finds coins, so Murkrow and Meowth will go after it.
name: Wimpod

description: The shell covering its body is as hard as diamond. This Pokémon will do anything it takes to win.
name: Golisopod

description: The tradition known as Pyukumuku chucking started from the custom of throwing Pyukumuku back into the sea after they wash onshore.
name: Pyukumuku

description: This guardian deity of Poni Island manipulates water. Because it lives deep within a thick fog, it came to be both feared and revered.
name: Tapu Fini

description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.
name: Pikachu

description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.
name: Pikachu

description: It focuses psychic energy into its tail and rides it like it's surfing. Another name for this Pokémon is "hodad."
name: Alolan Raichu

description: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.
name: Magnemite

description: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.
name: Magneton

description: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
name: Sewaddle

description: It uses radar to monitor its territory. Intruders are quickly disposed of with a hyper beam.
name: Magnezone

description: Since it can't generate its own electricity, it sticks onto large-bodied Pokémon and absorbs static electricity.
name: Joltik

description: They employ an electrically charged web to trap their prey. While it is immobilized by shock, they leisurely consume it.
name: Galvantula

description: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
name: Tynamo

description: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
name: Tynamo

description: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
name: Eelektrik

description: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
name: Eelektross

description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
name: Stunfisk

description: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.
name: Thundurus

description: Although it's called a guardian deity, if a person or Pokémon puts it in a bad mood, it will become a malevolent deity and attack.
name: Tapu Koko

description: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
name: Sewaddle

description: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.
name: Xurkitree

description: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.
name: Exeggcute

description: It engages its enemies using psychic powers. Each of its three heads fires off psychokinetic energy, tripling its power.
name: Exeggutor

description: The rich greenery of the Alola region is hard on Marowak. It controls fire to stay alive.
name: Alolan Marowak

description: It sways its hips to a rhythm all its own. The precise movements of Jynx living in Alola are truly wonderful.
name: Jynx

description: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.
name: Wynaut

description: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
name: Swadloon

description: Its round body is stuffed with souls and expands each time it leads someone away.
name: Drifloon

description: There's a rumor that if you catch a Drifblim floating on the wind at dusk, you'll be carried away to the afterlife.
name: Drifblim

description: It grips prey with its tail claws and injects poison. It tenaciously hangs on until the poison takes.
name: Skorupi

description: Known as "The Being of Knowledge." It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
name: Uxie

description: Known as "The Being of Emotion." It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
name: Mesprit

description: Known as "The Being of Willpower." It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
name: Azelf

description: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
name: Giratina

description: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
name: Cresselia

description: This Pokémon appears before people and Pokémon who are having nightmares and eats those dreams.
name: Munna

description: The mist emanating from their foreheads is packed with the dreams of people and Pokémon.
name: Musharna

description: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
name: Leavanny

description: It controls tremendous psychic power. Most reports of alien sightings are actually just people mistaking Elgyem for an alien.
name: Elgyem

description: With its psychic powers, it rewrites its opponents' memories. You, too, may have already had your memories rewritten.
name: Beheeyem

description: Apparently this Pokémon is born when a departed spirit inhabits a sword. It attaches itself to people and drinks their life force.
name: Honedge

name: Honedge

description: When Honedge evolves, it divides into two swords, which cooperate via telepathy to coordinate attacks and slash their enemies to ribbons.
name: Doublade

description: Generations of kings were attended by these Pokémon, which used their spectral power to manipulate and control people and Pokémon.
name: Aegislash

description: They eat Corsola branches, so Mareanie are hated by craftsmen who work with Corsola branches that have naturally fallen off.

name: Gloom

description: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

description: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

name: Walrein

description: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.
name: Kyogre

description: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.
name: Piplup

description: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
name: Prinplup

description: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

description: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.
name: Tympole

description: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

description: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
name: Tangrowth

description: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

name: Wishiwashi

description: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.
name: Dewpider

description: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.
name: Araquanid

description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.
name: Pikachu

description: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

description: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

description: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.
name: Magneton

description: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

description: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

description: Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.

description: When the bacteria living inside its antennae absorb Lanturn's bodily fluids, a strong luminescent effect is produced.

description: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

description: It's said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it's not powerful enough to change the future it sees.

description: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon's face become more vivid and lively.

description: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

description: It's feared as a ghost of the forest. Lumberjacks bring along Fire types, which Trevenant hates, when they enter the forest.

name: Wailord

description: Their numbers seem to have rapidly increased in Alola. Custom has it that houses where Snorunt live will be prosperous for generations to come.
name: Snorunt

description: Legend says a boulder on an icy mountain absorbed the distress and regrets of a stranded mountaineer, giving rise to Glalie.
name: Glalie

name: Vanillite

name: Wishiwashi

description: It plunges the poison spike on its head into its prey. When the prey has weakened, Mareanie deals the finishing blow with its 10 tentacles.
name: Mareanie

description: Although the leaves on its head are bitter enough to cause dizziness, they provide relief from weariness—even more so when boiled.
name: Petilil

description: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.
name: Alolan Geodude

description: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.

name: Heliolisk

description: This Oricorio has sipped bright yellow nectar. Its bright, cheerful dance melts the hearts of its enemies.
name: Oricorio

description: Its long tail often breaks off. It doesn't really feel any pain, though, and the tail grows back, so Slowpoke isn't particularly bothered.

description: It spaces out while gazing at the sea. With Shellder's poison flowing through its body, it becomes even spacier.
name: Slowbro

description: No matter how much time and money is spent raising it, its flowers are the most beautiful when they bloom in the wild.
name: Lilligant

description: Unsanitary places are what they like best. They can be spotted in Alola, often with Grimer in hot pursuit.

description: Beware the poisonous liquid it shoots from its right arm. If even a little of it gets on you, you'll experience the effects of the unidentified toxin.
name: Garbodor

description: Their ribbonlike feelers increase their psychic power. They are always staring at something.
name: Gothita

description: Starlight is the source of their power. At night, they mark star positions by using psychic power to float stones.
name: Gothorita

description: Starry skies thousands of light-years away are visible in the space distorted by their intense psychic power.

description: This Oricorio relaxes by swaying gently. This increases its psychic energy, which it then fires at its enemies.
name: Oricorio

description: This Oricorio has sipped purple nectar. Its elegant, attractive dance will send the minds and hearts of its enemies to another world.
name: Oricorio

description: Its actual appearance is unknown. A scholar who saw what was under its rag was overwhelmed by horror and died of the shock.
name: Mimikyu

description: Swinging its massive anchor, it can KO Wailord in a single blow. What appears to be green seaweed is actually its body.
name: Dhelmise

description: These Pokémon are stumps possessed by the spirits of children who died in the forest. Their cries sound like eerie screams.
name: Phantump

description: It is said to be a female evolution of Cosmog. When its third eye activates, away it flies to another world.
name: Lunala

description: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.
name: Machop

description: It loves working out. As it gazes at its muscles, which continue to swell day by day, it becomes more and more dedicated to its training.
name: Machop

description: As a result of its continual workouts, it has developed tremendous power. It uses that power to help people with their work.
name: Machoke

description: It unleashes megaton-level punches that send opponents flying clear over the horizon.
name: Machamp

description: To avoid attack, it mimics a tree. It will run off if splashed with water, which it hates.
name: Sudowoodo

description: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.
name: Gligar

description: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
name: Gliscor

description: The magnet in Nosepass's nose provides an unerring compass, making it an excellent partner for Trainers going on a journey.
name: Nosepass

description: This Pokémon is said to devour anyone daring to ravage the forest. To the creatures dwelling in the forest, it offers great kindness.
name: Trevenant

description: Its two whiskers provide a sensitive radar. Even in muddy waters, it can detect its prey's location.
name: Barboach

description: A glutton that devours anything that moves, it quietly lurks at the bottom of swamps, lying in wait for prey.
name: Whiscash

description: It grows up imitating the behavior of Pangoro, which it looks up to as a leader.
name: Pancham

description: It's considered to be a good Pokémon for beginners because of its friendliness, but its disposition grows rougher as it grows up.
name: Rockruff

description: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
name: Mudbray

description: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
name: Mudsdale

description: It eats dust in the atmosphere. The composition of the dust determines the color of its core.
name: Minior

description: They awaken at dusk and take wing in the twilight, leading to the expression, "Get home before the Murkrow fly."
name: Murkrow

description: A single cry from this nocturnal Pokémon, and more than a hundred of its Murkrow cronies will assemble.
name: Honchkrow

description: This Pokémon is a coward. As it desperately dashes off, the flailing of its many legs leaves a sparkling clean path in its wake.
name: Wimpod

description: It's a fiend for gemstones, so it stalks Carbink. Unfortunately, Gabite almost always grabs them first.
name: Sableye

description: Long ago, superstitions were spread about it, saying it brought disaster. This fed a hatred of it, and it was driven deep into the mountains.
name: Absol

description: It boasts superb physical strength. Those who wish to become Pangoro's Trainer have no choice but to converse with their fists.
name: Pangoro

description: Its cells are all magnets. It uses magnetism to communicate with others of its kind.
name: Beldum

description: When two Beldum link together, their psychic power is doubled. Their intelligence, however, remains unchanged.
name: Metang

description: It radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances become unusable.
name: Probopass

description: It is said to live in another world. The intense light it radiates from the surface of its body can make the darkest of nights light up like midday.
name: Solgaleo

description: Its adorable behavior and appearance make it popular with men and women, young and old. Its numbers are few, however.
name: Clefairy

description: They don't like to reveal themselves in front of people. They live quietly in packs deep in the mountains.
name: Clefable

description: With a flashing slash of its giant sharp claws, it cleaves seawater—or even air—right in two.
name: Golisopod

description: When it finds others of its kind, they all stick together. When enough of them have collected, the mass resembles a cumulonimbus cloud.

description: It rides on the wind and slips into people's homes. After it has turned a room into a cotton-filled mess, it giggles to itself and takes off.

description: It attaches flowers to its highly nutritious vine. This revitalizes the flowers, and they give off an aromatic scent.
name: Comfey

description: The weakest of all Dragon-type Pokémon, it's unable to breathe if its skin dries out, so it sticks to shady places.
name: Goomy

description: It has trouble drawing a line between friends and food. It will calmly try to melt and eat even those it gets along well with.
name: Sliggoo

description: An amazingly friendly Pokémon, but if left to itself, loneliness overcomes it, and it oozes gooey tears.
name: Goodra

description: It has a compassionate personality, but if it is angered, it will completely destroy its surroundings with its intense breath.
name: Drampa

description: It expresses its feelings by smacking its scales. Metallic sounds echo through the tall mountains where Jangmo-o lives.
name: Jangmo-o

description: It leaps at its prey with a courageous shout. Its scaly punches tear its opponents to shreds.
name: Hakamo-o

description: When attacked by bird Pokémon, it resists by releasing a terrifically strong odor from its antennae, but it often becomes their prey.
name: Caterpie

description: While it's believed that starlight provides it with energy, this Pokémon also loves to eat berries. In the daytime, it curls up in the grass to sleep.
name: Ledian

description: This is Zygarde's form at times when it uses its overwhelming power to suppress those who endanger the ecosystem.
name: Zygarde

description: It lies around all day, becoming active near dusk. At night, it wanders the city in search of loose change.
name: Meowth

description: It has a violent temperament. It will attack anything that looks it in the eye. Its sharp claws inflict deep wounds.
name: Persian

description: Roughly 20 years ago, it was artificially created, utilizing the latest technology of the time.
name: Porygon

name: Charmander

name: Charmeleon

name: Metapod

name: Pansear

description: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.
name: Simisear

name: Heatmor

description: The shell on its back is chemically unstable and explodes violently if struck. The hole in its stomach is its weak point.
name: Turtonator

description: It exhales air colder than -58 degrees Fahrenheit. Elderly people in Alola call this Pokémon by an older name—Keokeo.
name: Alolan Vulpix

description: It creates drops of ice in its coat and showers them over its enemies. Anyone who angers it will be frozen stiff in an instant.
name: Alolan Ninetales

description: Known to shoot down flying bugs with precision blasts of ink from the surface of the water.
name: Horsea

description: Close examination of its large eyes reveals that each eye is composed of a myriad of tiny eyes.
name: Butterfree

description: Its body bristles with sharp spikes. Carelessly trying to touch it could cause fainting from the spikes.
name: Seadra

description: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.
name: Kingdra

description: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.
name: Magikarp

description: A tale is told of a town that angered Gyarados. Before the sun rose the next day, flames utterly consumed the town, leaving not a trace behind.
name: Gyarados

description: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry, even when it plays in the water.
name: Marill

description: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of living things on riverbeds.
name: Azumarill

description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.
name: Panpour

description: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
name: Simipour

description: When it unleashes its psychic power from the protuberance on its head, the grating sound of grinding teeth echoes through the area.
name: Bruxish

description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
name: Oddish

description: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.
name: Pikachu

description: It unleashes electric shocks that can reach 100,000 volts. When agitated, it can knock out even an Indian elephant.
name: Raichu

description: Half of all sudden blackouts are caused by Electabuzz gathering at electric power plants and gobbling up electricity.
name: Electabuzz

description: It pushes the tips of its tails against its foes and then lets loose a high-voltage current. Its foes are burned to a crisp in an instant.
name: Electivire

description: While one alone doesn't have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
name: Tynamo

description: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
name: Eelektrik

description: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
name: Eelektross

description: The spiny fur on its back is normally at rest. When this Pokémon becomes agitated, its fur stands on end and stabs into its attackers.
name: Togedemaru

description: A poisonous bite reacted with its system, blessing it with the enhanced intellect of a genius. It has full control of its psychic powers.
name: Slowking

description: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.
name: Wobbuffet

description: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.
name: Gloom

description: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.
name: Seviper

description: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.
name: Duskull

description: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.
name: Dusclops

description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.
name: Dusknoir

description: Its cheeks hold poison sacs. It tries to catch foes off guard to jab them with toxic fingers.
name: Croagunk

description: It has a poison sac at its throat. When it croaks, the stored poison is churned for greater potency.
name: Toxicroak

description: It discovers what is going on around it by using the feelers on its head and tail. It is brutally aggressive.
name: Venipede

description: Protected by a hard shell, it spins its body like a wheel and crashes furiously into its enemies.
name: Whirlipede

description: It clasps its prey with the claws on its neck until it stops moving. Then it finishes it off with deadly poison.
name: Scolipede

description: The organ that emits its intense psychic power is sheltered by its ears to keep power from leaking out.
name: Espurr

description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
name: Vileplume

description: When in danger, it raises its ears and releases enough psychic power to grind a 10-ton truck to dust.
name: Meowstic

description: Born from a sand mound playfully built by a child, this Pokémon embodies the grudges of the departed.
name: Sandygast

description: Possessed people controlled by this Pokémon transformed its sand mound into a castle. As it evolved, its power to curse grew ever stronger.
name: Palossand

description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging Tackles.
name: Rhyhorn

description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Rhydon

description: From holes in its palms, it fires out Geodude. Its carapace can withstand volcanic eruptions.
name: Rhyperior

description: Because it turns active on nights of the full moon, it is said to have some link to the lunar phases.
name: Lunatone

description: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.
name: Solrock

description: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.
name: Tangela

description: It can discern the physical and emotional states of people, Pokémon, and other natural things from the shape of their aura waves.
name: Riolu

description: Not only does it perceive auras, but it has also gained the power to control them. It employs them in battle.
name: Lucario

description: Desiring the strongest karate chop, they seclude themselves in mountains and train without sleeping.
name: Sawk

description: While guarding its weak points with its pincers, it looks for an opening and unleashes punches. When it loses, it foams at the mouth and faints.
name: Crabrawler

description: It aimed for the top but got lost and ended up on a snowy mountain. Being forced to endure the cold, this Pokémon evolved and grew fur.
name: Crabominable

description: The more intimidating the opponent it faces, the more this Pokémon's blood boils. It will attack with no regard for its own safety.
name: Lycanroc

description: Its quick movements confuse its enemies. Well equipped with claws and fangs, it also uses the sharp rocks in its mane as weapons.
name: Lycanroc

description: The mud stuck to Mudbray's hooves enhances its grip and its powerful running gait.
name: Mudbray

description: It spits a mud that provides resistance to both wind and rain, so the walls of old houses were often coated with it.
name: Mudsdale

description: They form groups of roughly 20 individuals. Their mutual bond is remarkable—they will never let down a comrade.
name: Passimian

description: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.
name: Tangrowth

description: With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and infiltrates people's homes. Then, with a twitch of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.
name: Alolan Rattata

description: It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.
name: Alolan Raticate

description: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.
name: Alolan Grimer

description: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.
name: Sneasel

description: They travel in groups of four or five, leaving signs for one another on trees and rocks. They bring down their prey with coordinated attacks.
name: Weavile

description: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
name: Darkrai

description: Opponents who stare at the flashing of the light-emitting spots on its body become dazed and lose their will to fight.
name: Inkay

description: They are timid and grow uneasy when not in a swarm with others of their kind. The pattern on their backs differs slightly from one to another.
name: Ledyba

description: It wields the most compelling hypnotic powers of any Pokémon, and it forces others to do whatever it wants.
name: Malamar

description: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
name: Ralts

description: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.
name: Kirlia

description: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
name: Diancie

name: Cutiefly

description: It rolls up pollen into puffs. It makes many different varieties, some used as food and others used in battle.
name: Ribombee

description: It scatters spores that flicker and glow. Anyone seeing these lights falls into a deep slumber.
name: Morelull

description: Forests where Shiinotic live are treacherous to enter at night. People confused by its strange lights can never find their way home again.
name: Shiinotic

description: A strange seed was planted on its back at birth. The plant sprouts and grows with this Pokémon.
name: Bulbasaur

description: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.
name: Torkoal

description: Said to have been born from the sun, it spews fire from its horns and encases itself in a cocoon of fire when it evolves.
name: Larvesta

description: A sea of fire engulfs the surroundings of their battles, since they use their six wings to scatter their ember scales.
name: Volcarona

description: This legendary Pokémon can scorch the world with fire. It helps those who want to build a world of truth.
name: Reshiram

description: While grooming itself, it builds up fur inside its stomach. It sets the fur alight and spews fiery attacks, which change based on how it coughs.
name: Litten

description: At its throat, it bears a bell of fire. The bell rings brightly whenever this Pokémon spits fire.
name: Torracat

description: This Pokémon has a violent, selfish disposition. If it's not in the mood to listen, it will ignore its Trainer's orders with complete nonchalance.
name: Incineroar

description: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.
name: Totodile

description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
name: Croconaw

description: There is a plant bulb on its back. When it absorbs nutrients, the bulb is said to blossom into a large flower.
name: Ivysaur

description: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

description: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.
name: Qwilfish

description: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.

description: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.

description: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.

description: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
name: Plusle

description: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.

description: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.
name: Arbok

description: It wiggles its hips as it walks. It can cause people to dance in unison with it.
name: Jynx

description: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
name: Shroomish

description: Because it can use all kinds of moves, many scientists believe Mew to be the ancestor of Pokémon.
name: Shining Mew

description: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
name: Latios

description: Generations have believed that any wish written on a note on its head will come true when it awakens.
name: Shining Jirachi

description: The energy that burns inside it enables it to move, but no one has yet been able to identify this energy.
name: Golett

description: It is said that Golurk were ordered to protect people and Pokémon by the ancient people who made them.
name: Golurk

description: Able to conceal itself in shadows, it never appears before humans, so its very existence was the stuff of myth.
name: Marshadow

description: Its skin is very hard, so it is unhurt even if stepped on by sumo wrestlers. It smiles when transmitting electricity.
name: Stunfisk

name: Spiritomb

description: Their beautiful form comes from the muscles they have developed. They run silently in the night.
name: Liepard

description: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
name: Breloom

description: Its skin has a rubbery elasticity, so it can reduce damage by defensively pulling its skin up to its neck.
name: Scraggy

description: It pulls up its shed skin to protect itself while it kicks. The bigger the crest, the more respected it is.
name: Scrafty

description: It changes so it looks like its foe, tricks it, and then uses that opportunity to flee.
name: Zorua

description: When this legendary Pokémon's wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
name: Yveltal

description: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.
name: Hoopa

description: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
name: Shining Rayquaza

description: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.

name: Numel

description: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years—or whenever it becomes really angry.
name: Camerupt

description: Large numbers of these Pokémon make their home at the seaside. At night, a strange red glow radiates from the center of their bodies.
name: Staryu

description: Its shining core is thought to receive and transmit enigmatic signals. It has been known to cause headaches in those who approach it.
name: Starmie

description: Although weak and helpless, this Pokémon is incredibly fertile. They exist in such multitudes, you'll soon grow tired of seeing them.
name: Magikarp

description: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.
name: Swinub

description: Almost incapable of moving, this Pokémon can only harden its shell to protect itself when it is in danger.
name: Kakuna

description: Although its legs are short, its rugged hooves prevent it from slipping, even on icy ground.
name: Piloswine

description: A frozen Mamoswine was dug from ice dating back 10,000 years. This Pokémon has been around a long, long, long time.
name: Mamoswine

description: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike even moving prey from more than 300 feet.
name: Remoraid

description: It has a tendency to want to be in holes. It prefers rock crags or pots and sprays ink from them before attacking.
name: Octillery

description: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.
name: Corphish

description: It is a ruffian that uses its pincers to pick up and toss out other Pokémon from its pond.
name: Crawdaunt

description: A tough Pokémon that is perfectly fine even in dirty water. However, due to its ragged, shabby appearance, it isn't popular.
name: Feebas

description: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.
name: Milotic

description: It is said to have slept in a glacier for thousands of years. Its body can't be melted, even by magma.
name: Regice

description: For the most part, it makes its home along the seashore. Its color and form differ according to its habitat and the quality of its food.
name: Shellos

description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.
name: Beedrill

description: A plan was recently announced to gather many Pikachu and make an electric power plant.
name: Pikachu

description: It only evolves to this form in the Alola region. According to researchers, its diet is one of the causes of this change.
name: Alolan Raichu

description: Its body is a magnetic stone. Iron sand attaches firmly to the portions of its body that are particularly magnetic.
name: Alolan Geodude

description: Its preferred food is dravite. After it has eaten this mineral, crystals form inside the Pokémon, rising to the surface of part of its body.
name: Alolan Graveler

description: It glides using its cape-like membrane. Electrical energy scatters from it, shocking its friends and foes alike.
name: Emolga

description: Should a strange light be seen flickering in an abandoned building, Gastly is lurking there.
name: Gastly

description: It strikes at humans from total darkness. Those licked by its cold tongue grow weaker with each passing day until they die.
name: Haunter

description: Should you feel yourself attacked by a sudden chill, it is evidence of an approaching Gengar. There is no escaping it. Give up.
name: Gengar

name: Pawniard

description: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
name: Kingambit

name: Togedemaru

description: They live as a group, but when the time comes, one strong Meltan will absorb all the others and evolve.
name: Meltan

description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
name: Varoom

description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

description: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.

name: Wartortle

name: Metapod

name: Butterfree

description: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.
name: Weedle

description: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
name: Kakuna

name: Beedrill

name: Pidgey

name: Pidgeotto

description: It spreads its gorgeous wings widely to intimidate enemies. It races through the skies at Mach-2 speed.
name: Pidgeot

description: This Pokémon is common but hazardous. Its sharp incisors can easily cut right through hard wood.
name: Rattata

description: Its whiskers are essential for maintaining its balance. No matter how friendly you are, it will get angry and bite you if you touch its whiskers.
name: Raticate

description: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.
name: Spearow

description: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!
name: Fearow

description: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.
name: Ekans

description: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.
name: Pikachu

description: Its tail discharges electricity into the ground, protecting it from getting shocked.
name: Raichu

description: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.
name: Sandshrew

description: It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.
name: Sandslash

description: It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran's horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male's horn.
name: Nidoran♀

description: If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.
name: Nidorina

description: It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.
name: Nidoqueen

description: Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it's friendly with.
name: Nidoran♂

description: It's nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.
name: Nidorino

description: Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It's forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.
name: Nidoking

description: Its adorable behavior and cry make it highly popular. However, this cute Pokémon is rarely found.
name: Clefairy

description: Their ears are sensitive enough to hear a pin drop from over a mile away, so they're usually found in quiet places.
name: Clefable

description: As each tail grows, its fur becomes more lustrous. When held, it feels slightly warm.
name: Vulpix

description: When its huge eyes waver, it sings a mysteriously soothing melody that lulls its enemies to sleep.
name: Jigglypuff

description: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.
name: Zubat

description: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.
name: Golbat

description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
name: Oddish

description: What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
name: Gloom

description: The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
name: Vileplume

description: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.
name: Paras

description: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.
name: Parasect

description: Poison oozes from all over its body. It catches small bug Pokémon at night that are attracted by light.
name: Venonat

description: The wings are covered with dustlike scales. Every time it flaps its wings, it looses highly toxic dust.
name: Venomoth

description: It lives about one yard underground, where it feeds on plant roots. It sometimes appears aboveground.
name: Diglett

description: Its three heads bob separately up and down to loosen the soil nearby, making it easier for it to burrow.
name: Dugtrio

description: All it does is sleep during the daytime. At night, it patrols its territory with its eyes aglow.
name: Meowth

description: Although its fur has many admirers, it is tough to raise as a pet because of its fickle meanness.
name: Persian

description: It is constantly wracked by a headache. When the headache turns intense, it begins using mysterious powers.
name: Psyduck

description: When it swims at full speed using its long, webbed limbs, its forehead somehow begins to glow.
name: Golduck

description: It lives in groups in the treetops. If it loses sight of its group, it becomes infuriated by its loneliness.
name: Mankey

description: It becomes wildly furious if it even senses someone looking at it. It chases anyone that meets its glare.
name: Primeape

description: It has a brave and trustworthy nature. It fearlessly stands up to bigger and stronger foes.
name: Growlithe

description: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.
name: Arcanine

description: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.
name: Poliwag

description: This Pokémon's sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies' grasp and escape.
name: Poliwhirl

description: Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.
name: Poliwrath

description: Abra can teleport in its sleep. Apparently the more deeply Abra sleeps, the farther its teleportations go.
name: Abra

description: This Pokémon's telekinesis is immensely powerful. To prepare for evolution, Kadabra stores up psychic energy in the star on its forehead.
name: Kadabra

description: Always brimming with power, it passes time by lifting boulders. Doing so makes it even stronger.
name: Machop

description: Its formidable body never gets tired. It helps people by doing work such as the moving of heavy goods.
name: Machoke

description: With four arms that react more quickly than it can think, it can execute many punches at once.
name: Machamp

description: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.
name: Bellsprout

description: It spits out Poison Powder to immobilize the enemy and then finishes it with a spray of Acid.
name: Weepinbell

description: Once ingested into this Pokémon's body, even the hardest object will melt into nothing.
name: Victreebel

description: This Pokémon is mostly made of water. A Tentacool out in the ocean is very hard to spot, because its body blends in with the sea.
name: Tentacool

description: Its 80 tentacles can stretch and shrink freely. Tentacruel ensnares prey in a net of spread-out tentacles, delivering venomous stings to its catch.
name: Tentacruel

description: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.
name: Geodude

description: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.
name: Graveler

description: If you've been accepted by Ponyta, its burning mane is mysteriously no longer hot to the touch.
name: Ponyta

description: The fastest runner becomes the leader, and it decides the herd's pace and direction of travel.
name: Rapidash

description: It is incredibly slow and dopey. It takes five seconds for it to feel pain when under attack.
name: Slowpoke

description: When a Slowpoke went hunting in the sea, its tail was bitten by a Shellder. That made it evolve into Slowbro.
name: Slowbro

description: The electromagnetic waves emitted by the units at the sides of its head expel antigravity, which allows it to float.
name: Magnemite

description: Three Magnemite are linked by a strong magnetic force. Earaches will occur if you get too close.
name: Magneton

description: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.
name: Farfetch'd

description: The brains in its two heads appear to communicate emotions to each other with a telepathic power.
name: Doduo

description: An odd species that is rarely found. The three heads respectively represent joy, sadness, and anger.
name: Dodrio

description: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.
name: Seel

description: It sunbathes on the beach after meals. The rise in its body temperature helps its digestion.
name: Dewgong

description: Born from sludge, these Pokémon now gather in polluted places and increase the bacteria in their bodies.
name: Grimer

description: It's thickly covered with a filthy, vile sludge. It is so toxic, even its footprints contain poison.
name: Muk

description: It is encased in a shell that is harder than diamond. Inside, however, it is surprisingly tender.
name: Shellder

description: Cloyster that live in seas with harsh tidal currents grow large, sharp spikes on their shells.

description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.

description: To steal the life of its target, it slips into the prey's shadow and silently waits for an opportunity.
name: Gengar

description: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.
name: Onix

description: It remembers every dream it eats. It rarely eats the dreams of adults because children's are much tastier.
name: Drowzee

description: When it locks eyes with an enemy, it will use a mix of psi moves, such as Hypnosis and Confusion.
name: Hypno

description: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.

description: Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it's not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.

description: It rolls to move. If the ground is uneven, a sudden jolt from hitting a bump can cause it to explode.

description: The more energy it charges up, the faster it gets. But this also makes it more likely to explode.
name: Electrode

description: These Pokémon get nervous when they're not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.
name: Exeggcute

description: When they work together, Exeggutor's three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.
name: Exeggutor

description: This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone's dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.
name: Cubone

description: When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak's temperament also turned vicious at the same time.
name: Marowak

description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.

description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.

description: Bug Pokémon are Lickitung's main food source. This Pokémon paralyzes its prey with a lick from its long tongue, then swallows the prey whole.
name: Lickitung

description: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.

description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.
name: Weezing

description: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.
name: Rhyhorn

description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

description: This kindly Pokémon lays highly nutritious eggs and shares them with injured Pokémon or people.

description: When it targets an enemy, it charges furiously while whipping its body with its long tails.

description: Once it appears, it goes on a rampage. It remains enraged until it demolishes everything around it.

description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.

description: Its transformation ability is perfect. However, if made to laugh, it can't maintain its disguise.

description: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

description: It lives close to water. Its long tail is ridged with a fin, which is often mistaken for a mermaid's.

description: It concentrates the weak electric charges emitted by its cells and launches wicked lightning bolts.
name: Jolteon

description: Inhaled air is carried to its flame sac, heated, and exhaled as fire that reaches over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Flareon

description: In recent years, this species has been very helpful in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.

description: This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it's just drifting along.

description: Omastar's sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.

description: Aerodactyl's sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.

description: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.
name: Snorlax

description: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.

description: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.

description: It sheds many layers of skin as it grows larger. During this process, it is protected by a rapid waterfall.
name: Dratini

description: They say that if it emits an aura from its whole body, the weather will begin to change instantly.
name: Dragonair

description: It is said that somewhere in the ocean lies an island where these gather. Only they live there.

name: Masquerain

name: Pansage
