description: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.
name: Crustle

description: Its sweat is sweet, like syrup made from boiled- down fruit. Because of this, Bounsweet was highly valued in the past, when sweeteners were scarce.
name: Bounsweet

description: Steenee spreads a sweet scent that makes others feel invigorated. This same scent is popular for antiperspirants.
name: Steenee

description: Often found in gardens, this Pokémon has hairs on its body that it uses to assess its surroundings.
name: Blipbug

description: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.
name: Dottler

description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.
name: Orbeetle

description: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.
name: Nymble

description: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it's in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.
name: Nymble

description: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.
name: Toedscool

description: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.
name: Toedscool

description: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.
name: Toedscruel

description: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.
name: Wo-Chien

description: This Pokémon makes its home near volcanoes. At the end of the day, Magby soaks in magma, resting and recovering from the day's fatigue.
name: Magby

description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Pansear

description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
name: Simisear

description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
name: Volcanion

description: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
name: Fuecoco

description: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.
name: Crocalor

description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.
name: Charcadet

description: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.
name: Charcadet

description: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with an object described in an old book.
name: Iron Moth

description: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.
name: Chi-Yu

description: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.
name: Horsea

description: Seadra's mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that's larger than the opening of its mouth.
name: Seadra

description: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they've been given to royalty as gifts.
name: Kingdra

description: Using its dorsal fin as a suction pad, it clings to a Mantine's underside to scavenge for leftovers.
name: Remoraid

description: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
name: Octillery

description: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
name: Feebas

description: It's said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you're feeling.
name: Milotic

description: It is said that several Snorunt gather under giant leaves and live together in harmony.
name: Snorunt

description: It swims along with a school of Remoraid, and they'll all fight together to repel attackers.
name: Mantyke

description: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
name: Palkia

description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
name: Panpour

description: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
name: Simipour

description: Supposedly, this Pokémon was born from an icicle. It spews out freezing air at −58 degrees Fahrenheit to make itself more comfortable.
name: Vanillite

description: It blasts enemies with cold air reaching −148 degrees Fahrenheit, freezing them solid. But it spares their lives afterward—it's a kind Pokémon.
name: Vanillish

description: People believe this Pokémon formed when two Vanillish stuck together. Its body temperature is roughly 21 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Vanilluxe

description: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy's presence.
name: Wimpod

description: Wimpod gather in swarms, constantly on the lookout for danger. They scatter the moment they detect an enemy's presence.
name: Wimpod

description: They live in sunken ships or in holes in the seabed. When Golisopod and Grapploct battle, the loser becomes the winner's meal.
name: Golisopod

description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
name: Wiglett

description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
name: Wiglett

description: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.
name: Wugtrio

description: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.
name: Veluza

description: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.
name: Dondozo

description: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.
name: Iron Bundle

description: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.
name: Chien-Pao

description: It's not good at storing electricity yet. This Pokémon sneaks into people's homes, looking for electrical outlets to eat electricity from.
name: Elekid

description: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.
name: Plusle

description: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
name: Minun

description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
name: Blitzle

description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
name: Zebstrika

description: Joltik latch on to other Pokémon and suck out static electricity. They're often found sticking to Yamper's hindquarters.
name: Joltik

description: It lays traps of electrified threads near the nests of bird Pokémon, aiming to snare chicks that are not yet good at flying.
name: Galvantula

description: Concealing itself in lightning clouds, it flies throughout the Unova region. It creates electricity in its tail.
name: Zekrom

description: The energetic, cheerful dance of these Oricorio is popular with children, but the Oricorio themselves are hard to find in Paldea.
name: Oricorio

description: This selfish, attention-seeking Pokémon stores poison and electricity in two different sacs inside its body.
name: Toxel

description: Because its wings aren't yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.
name: Natu

description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.
name: Xatu

description: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.
name: Latios

description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.
name: Deoxys

description: The spirit of a person from a bygone age became this Pokémon. It rambles through ruins, searching for someone who knows its face.
name: Yamask

description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.
name: Pumpkaboo

description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.
name: Gourgeist

description: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.
name: Flittle

description: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.
name: Flittle

description: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.
name: Espathra

description: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.
name: Tinkatink

description: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it's satisfied with the result.
name: Tinkatink

description: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other's hammers by smashing them together.
name: Tinkatuff

description: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.
name: Tinkaton

description: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.
name: Scream Tail

description: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.
name: Gimmighoul

description: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.
name: Gimmighoul

description: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.
name: Onix

description: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.
name: Gligar

description: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.
name: Gliscor

description: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.
name: Groudon

description: It skulks in caves, and when prey or an enemy passes by, it leaps out and chomps them. The force of its attack sometimes chips its teeth.
name: Gible

description: In rare cases, it molts and sheds its scales. Medicine containing its scales as an ingredient will make a weary body feel invigorated.
name: Gabite

description: Though small, Mienfoo's temperament is fierce. Any creature that approaches Mienfoo carelessly will be greeted with a flurry of graceful attacks.
name: Mienfoo

description: Delivered at blinding speeds, kicks from this Pokémon can shatter massive boulders into tiny pieces.
name: Mienshao

description: This is its form when its shell has fallen off. The color of its core depends on the materials that made up the food it ate.
name: Minior

description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.
name: Nacli

description: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.
name: Nacli

description: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey's body.
name: Naclstack

description: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.
name: Garganacl

description: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can't remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.
name: Klawf

description: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.
name: Flamigo

description: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.
name: Slither Wing

description: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.
name: Ting-Lu

description: Zubat live in caves, down where the sun's light won't reach. In the morning, they gather together to keep each other warm as they sleep.
name: Zubat

description: Its feet are tiny, but this Pokémon walks skillfully. It sneaks up on sleeping prey before sinking in its fangs and slurping up blood.
name: Golbat

description: This Pokémon flaps its four wings skillfully. Crobat can fly through cramped caves without needing to slow down.
name: Crobat

description: Because of this Pokémon's ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.
name: Absol

description: Opponents that get drawn in by its adorable behavior come away with stinging scratches from its claws and stinging pride from its laughter.
name: Purrloin

description: This stealthy Pokémon sneaks up behind prey without making any sound at all. It competes with Thievul for territory.
name: Liepard

description: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.
name: Trubbish

description: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.
name: Garbodor

description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
name: Yveltal

description: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.
name: Nickit

description: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.
name: Thievul

description: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.
name: Morpeko

description: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.
name: Lokix

description: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.
name: Brute Bonnet

description: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
name: Steelix

description: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
name: Jirachi

description: Mossy caves are their preferred dwellings. Enzymes contained in mosses help Ferroseed's spikes grow big and strong.
name: Ferroseed

description: Its spikes are harder than steel. This Pokémon crawls across rock walls by stabbing the spikes on its feelers into the stone.
name: Ferrothorn

description: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.
name: Durant

description: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.
name: Honedge

description: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.
name: Honedge

description: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.
name: Doublade

description: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.
name: Doublade

description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.
name: Aegislash

description: Able to cut down anything with a single strike, it became known as the Fairy King's Sword, and it inspired awe in friend and foe alike.
name: Zacian

description: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.
name: Orthworm

description: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.
name: Tatsugiri

description: In recent years, this species has been very helpful in cyberspace. These Pokémon will go around checking to make sure no suspicious data exists.
name: Porygon

description: After artificial intelligence was implemented in Porygon2, the Pokémon began using a strange language that only other Porygon2 understand.
name: Porygon2

description: Some say an additional program made this Pokémon evolve, but even academics can't agree on whether Porygon-Z is really an evolution.
name: Porygon-Z

description: It searches for prey from the tops of trees. When it spots its favorite food, Bounsweet, Aipom gets excited and pounces.
name: Aipom

description: It uses its tails for everything. If it wraps both of its tails around you and gives you a squeeze, that's proof it really likes you.
name: Ambipom

description: This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.
name: Miltank

description: When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it's exhausted, then it falls asleep.
name: Whismur

description: The force of this Pokémon's loud voice isn't just the sound—it's also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.
name: Loudred

description: This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it'll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.
name: Exploud

description: Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents' attacks brilliantly!
name: Spinda

description: It can't relax if it or its surroundings are not clean. It wipes off dirt with its wings.
name: Swablu

description: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.
name: Tandemaus

description: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.
name: Tandemaus

name: Cyclizar

description: It's possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.
name: Iron Jugulis

description: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you draw 2 cards for each Supporter card you find there.
name: Clive

description: Each player shuffles their hand into their deck and draws 4 cards.
name: Judge

description: Draw 3 cards.
name: Nemona

description: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. For each Paldean Student card (not including this card) in your discard pile, you may search for an additional Pokémon in this way. Then, shuffle your deck. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
name: Paldean Student

description: Search your deck for a Pokémon that doesn't have a Rule Box, reveal it, and put it into your hand. (Pokémon ex, Pokémon V, etc. have Rule Boxes.)
name: Paldean Student

description: Search your deck for an Item card and a Pokémon Tool card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
name: Arven

description: Your opponent reveals their hand, and you draw 2 cards for each Supporter card you find there.
name: Clive

description: Each player shuffles their hand and puts it on the bottom of their deck. If either player put any cards on the bottom of their deck in this way, each player draws a card for each of their remaining Prize cards.
name: Iono

description: Draw 3 cards.
name: Nemona

description: Put 1 of your Basic Pokémon and all attached cards into your hand.
name: Penny

description: The sharp scythes on its forearms become increasingly sharp by cutting through hard objects.
name: Scyther

description: It spits out a fluid that it uses to glue tree bark to its body. The fluid hardens when it touches air.
name: Pineco

description: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.
name: Seedot

description: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.
name: Nuzleaf

description: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.
name: Shiftry

description: If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top of its head to protect itself.
name: Shroomish

description: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.
name: Breloom

description: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.
name: Roselia

description: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.
name: Roserade

description: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
name: Turtwig

description: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
name: Grotle

description: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
name: Shaymin

description: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.
name: Cottonee

description: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.
name: Whimsicott

description: Deerling have different scents depending on the season. In this form, Deerling have a softly sweet scent that lingers in the nose.
name: Deerling

description: Sawsbuck in their Autumn Form are known for having very short tempers. The males fight each other incessantly.
name: Sawsbuck

description: Its natural enemies, like Rookidee, may flee rather than risk getting caught in its large mandibles that can snap thick tree branches.
name: Grubbin

description: After a piece of seaweed merged with debris from a sunken ship, it was reborn as this ghost Pokémon.
name: Dhelmise

description: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.
name: Bramblin

description: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.
name: Brambleghast

description: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.
name: Rellor

description: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.
name: Rabsca

description: It can't run properly when it's newly born. As it races around with others of its kind, its legs grow stronger.
name: Ponyta

description: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.
name: Rapidash

description: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.
name: Slugma

description: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.
name: Magcargo

description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
name: Victini

description: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.
name: Heatmor

description: It spends even the smallest amount of downtime grooming its fur with its tongue. Loose fur gathers in its stomach and serves as fuel for fiery moves.
name: Litten

description: In the midst of battle, the fire pouch on Torracat's neck rings like a bell and produces stronger flames than usual.
name: Torracat

description: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.
name: Turtonator

description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
name: Sizzlipede

description: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
name: Centiskorch

description: It is small but rough and tough. It won't hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.
name: Totodile

description: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
name: Croconaw

description: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.
name: Feraligatr

description: It won't attack while it's alone—not even if it spots prey. Instead, it waits for other Carvanha to join it, and then the Pokémon attack as a group.
name: Carvanha

description: As soon as it catches the scent of prey, Sharpedo will jet seawater from its backside, hurtling toward the target to attack at 75 mph.
name: Sharpedo

description: Keldeo has strengthened its resolve for battle, filling its body with power and changing its form.
name: Keldeo

description: It eats snow that has accumulated on the ground. It prefers soft, freshly fallen snow, so it will eat its way up a mountain, aiming for the peak.
name: Snom

description: Frosmoth senses air currents with its antennae. It sends its scales drifting on frigid air, making them fall like snow.
name: Frosmoth

description: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
name: Wiglett

description: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.
name: Finizen

description: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.
name: Palafin

description: When several of these Pokémon gather, their electricity can build and cause lightning storms.
name: Pikachu

description: If the electric pouches in its cheeks become fully charged, both ears will stand straight up.
name: Raichu

description: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.
name: Electabuzz

description: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.
name: Electivire

description: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.
name: Charjabug

description: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.
name: Vikavolt

description: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.
name: Zeraora

description: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
name: Yamper

description: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
name: Boltund

description: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.
name: Iron Hands

description: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.
name: Iron Thorns

description: The broadness of its hands may be no coincidence—many scientists believe its palms became enlarged specifically for pantomiming.
name: Mr. Mime

description: The fur on its body naturally repels water. It can stay dry even when it plays in the water.
name: Marill

description: Its long ears are superb sensors. It can distinguish the movements of things in water and tell what they are.
name: Azumarill

description: Girafarig's tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.
name: Girafarig

description: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
name: Latias

description: Ancient people believed that the pattern on Bronzor's back contained a mysterious power.
name: Bronzor

description: In ages past, this Pokémon was revered as a bringer of rain. It was found buried in the ground.
name: Bronzong

description: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.
name: Solosis

description: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.
name: Duosion

description: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.
name: Reuniclus

description: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.
name: Elgyem

description: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.
name: Beheeyem

description: Nectar and pollen are its favorite fare. You can find Cutiefly hovering around Gossifleur, trying to get some of Gossifleur's pollen.
name: Cutiefly

description: It makes pollen puffs from pollen and nectar. The puffs' effects depend on the type of ingredients and how much of each one is used.
name: Ribombee

description: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.
name: Scream Tail

description: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.
name: Flutter Mane

description: It's possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.
name: Iron Valiant

description: It's possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.
name: Iron Valiant

description: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.
name: Meditite

description: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
name: Medicham

description: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.
name: Relicanth

description: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.
name: Drilbur

description: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.
name: Excadrill

description: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.
name: Golett

description: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.
name: Golurk

description: This Pokémon is very friendly when it's young. Its disposition becomes vicious once it matures, but it never forgets the kindness of its master.
name: Rockruff

description: Lycanroc attacks its prey with its sharp claws and fangs. It loyally obeys the instructions of a Trainer it trusts.
name: Lycanroc

description: This Pokémon covers itself in mud that it has regurgitated. The mud won't dry out even if it's exposed to the sun for a long time.
name: Mudbray

description: This Pokémon has been treasured not just for its physical labor but also because it produces high-quality mud used for making pottery.
name: Mudsdale

description: On sunny days, Rolycoly will come out onto grassy plains and roll around. Then it will eat the grass that gets tangled in its wheel-like leg.
name: Rolycoly

description: The temperature inside its body increases when it experiences strong emotions. It rolls around frantically while spewing flames.
name: Carkol

description: To intimidate its opponents, Coalossal will vigorously shake its body, scattering coal from its smoldering back.
name: Coalossal

description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.
name: Great Tusk

description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.
name: Great Tusk

description: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon's traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.
name: Sandy Shocks

description: The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.
name: Ekans

description: The pattern on its belly appears to be a frightening face. Weak foes will flee just at the sight of the pattern.
name: Arbok

description: It wraps its opponent in its gas-like body, slowly weakening its prey by poisoning it through the skin.
name: Gastly

description: It likes to lurk in the dark and tap shoulders with a gaseous hand. Its touch causes endless shuddering.
name: Haunter

description: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
name: Poochyena

description: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
name: Mightyena

description: It dwells in the darkness of caves. It uses its sharp claws to dig up gems to nourish itself.
name: Sableye

description: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.
name: Roaring Moon

description: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.
name: Forretress

description: It uses its docile-looking face to lull foes into complacency, then bites with its huge, relentless jaws.
name: Mawile

description: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum's sharp claws.
name: Beldum

description: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.
name: Metang

description: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.
name: Metagross

description: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.
name: Meltan

description: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.
name: Melmetal

description: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.
name: Iron Treads

description: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.
name: Koraidon

description: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.
name: Miraidon

description: If this Pokémon's sticky saliva gets on you and you don't clean it off, an intense itch will set in. The itch won't go away, either.
name: Lickitung

description: Lickilicky's strange tongue can stretch to many times the length of its body. No one has figured out how Lickilicky's tongue can stretch so far.
name: Lickilicky

description: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
name: Hoothoot

description: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
name: Noctowl

description: It creates mazes in dark locations. When spotted, it flees into the ground by digging with its tail.
name: Dunsparce

description: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.
name: Dudunsparce

description: It can't stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
name: Skitty

description: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.
name: Delcatty

description: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it's one of them. This way they won't attack it.
name: Chatot

description: Where people go, these Pokémon follow. If you're scattering food for them, be careful— several hundred of them can gather at once.
name: Pidove

description: It can fly moderately quickly. No matter how far it travels, it can always find its way back to its master and its nest.
name: Tranquill

description: Unfezant are exceptional fliers. The females are known for their stamina, while the males outclass them in terms of speed.
name: Unfezant

description: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.
name: Minccino

description: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.
name: Cinccino

description: The mountains it calls home are nearly two miles in height. On rare occasions, it descends to play with the children living in the towns below.
name: Drampa

description: It's possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.
name: Iron Jugulis

description: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.
name: Tangela

description: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.
name: Tangrowth

description: These Pokémon judge one another based on pincers. Thicker, more impressive pincers make for more popularity with the opposite gender.
name: Pinsir

description: Some fishers weave its sturdy thread into nets to catch fish Pokémon.
name: Spinarak

description: It wanders in search of food after darkness falls, never nesting in a specific place.
name: Ariados

description: It is very weak. Its only means of defense is to shake its leaves desperately at its attacker.
name: Sunkern

description: Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun.
name: Sunflora

description: With its herculean powers, it can easily throw around an object that is 100 times its own weight.
name: Heracross

description: It flashes the light on its rear to communicate with other Volbeat. It loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.
name: Volbeat

description: It guides Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. There are scholars who research the meaning of these signs.
name: Illumise

description: The younger they are, the more they smell like fresh grass. With age, their fragrance takes on the odor of fallen leaves.
name: Leafeon

description: This Pokémon came to be when the spirit of a deceased child possessed a tree stump. It now wanders the forest searching for friends.
name: Phantump

description: Trevenant is very kind to Pokémon living in the forest. It doesn't even care if these Pokémon take up residence in the greenery on its head.
name: Trevenant

description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
name: Grookey

description: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
name: Thwackey

description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
name: Rillaboom

description: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.
name: Applin

description: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.
name: Dipplin

description: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.
name: Iron Leaves

description: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.
name: Poltchageist

description: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.
name: Poltchageist

description: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.
name: Sinistcha

description: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.
name: Teal Mask Ogerpon

description: As its body grows larger, its six warm tails become more beautiful, with a more luxurious coat of fur.
name: Vulpix

description: It has nine long tails and fur that gleams gold. It is said to live for 1,000 years.
name: Ninetales

description: It's said that in ancient times, when volcanoes were more active, there were many more Slugma than there are now.
name: Slugma

description: Coal is the source of Torkoal's energy. Large amounts of coal can be found in the mountains where they live.
name: Torkoal

description: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can't extinguish the fire.
name: Chimchar

description: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
name: Monferno

description: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.
name: Infernape

description: It derives its power from fire burning inside its body. If the fire dwindles, this Pokémon will immediately fall asleep.
name: Darumaka

description: The thick arms of this hot-blooded Pokémon can deliver punches capable of obliterating a dump truck.
name: Darmanitan

description: While shining a light and pretending to be a guide, it leeches off the life-force of any who follow it.
name: Litwick

description: The spirits it absorbs fuel its baleful fire. It hangs around hospitals waiting for people to pass on.
name: Lampent

description: It absorbs spirits, which it then burns. By waving the flames on its arms, it puts its foes into a hypnotic trance.
name: Chandelure

description: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.
name: Chi-Yu

description: Its legs are newly grown, and it can't walk very well. It seems to prefer swimming through the water instead.
name: Poliwag

description: Its skin is moist all over its body. The skin on its belly spiral also feels smooth.
name: Poliwhirl

description: It can use its well-developed arms and legs to run on the surface of the water for a split second.
name: Poliwrath

description: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.
name: Goldeen

description: In autumn, its body becomes more fatty in preparing to propose to a mate. It takes on beautiful colors.
name: Seaking

description: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.
name: Jynx

description: It can live in impure water, where it doesn't need to compete with other water Pokémon for food, so its numbers have steadily increased.
name: Corphish

description: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.
name: Crawdaunt

description: It is the shabbiest Pokémon of all. It forms schools and lives at the bottom of rivers that teem with plant life.
name: Feebas

description: It lives at the bottom of clear lakes. In times of war, it shows itself, which soothes people's minds and hearts.
name: Milotic

description: It is said that a home visited by a Snorunt will prosper. It can withstand cold of −150 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Snorunt

description: It prevents prey from escaping by instantaneously freezing moisture in the air.
name: Glalie

description: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.
name: Froslass

description: It lowers its body heat to freeze its fur. The hairs then become like needles it can fire.
name: Glaceon

description: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.
name: Phione

description: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
name: Froakie

description: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
name: Frogadier

description: It's an incredibly poor learner because it uses the bare minimum amount of energy for its brain. It focuses on battling instead.
name: Cramorant

description: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.
name: Finizen

description: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen's, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.
name: Palafin

description: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.
name: Iron Bundle

description: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.
name: Walking Wake

description: This Pokémon has complete control over electricity. There are tales of Zapdos nesting in the dark depths of pitch-black thunderclouds.
name: Zapdos

description: The extension and contraction of its muscles generates electricity. Its fur glows when it's in trouble.
name: Shinx

description: By gathering their tails together, they collectively generate powerful electricity from their claws.
name: Luxio

description: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.
name: Emolga

description: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.
name: Helioptile

description: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.
name: Heliolisk

description: It has a small stomach. If it isn't constantly eating the seeds it keeps in its pockets, it will get hungry immediately.
name: Morpeko

description: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.
name: Tadbulb

description: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt's belly-button dynamo.
name: Bellibolt

description: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they're a popular delicacy.
name: Wattrel

description: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There's hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.
name: Kilowattrel

description: On nights with a full moon, they gather together and dance. The surrounding area is enveloped in an abnormal magnetic field.
name: Clefairy

description: It has an acute sense of hearing. It can easily hear a pin being dropped nearly 1,100 yards away.
name: Clefable

description: This Pokémon uses its psychic powers while it sleeps. The contents of Abra's dreams affect the powers that the Pokémon wields.
name: Abra

description: Using its psychic power, Kadabra levitates as it sleeps. It uses its springy tail as a pillow.
name: Kadabra

description: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.
name: Alakazam

description: Girafarig's tail has a small head. It instinctively bites at any foe that approaches the Pokémon from behind.
name: Girafarig

description: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.
name: Farigiraf

description: Its cries echo inside its hollow body to emerge as beautiful notes for startling and repelling foes.
name: Chimecho

description: This Flabébé rides a red flower. Immediately after birth, this Pokémon begins flying around in search of a flower it likes.
name: Flabébé

description: This Pokémon uses red wavelengths of light to pour its own energy into flowers and draw forth their latent potential.
name: Floette

description: They say that flower gardens created by Florges are constantly showered with a power that can heal both body and spirit.
name: Florges

description: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.
name: Swirlix

description: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.
name: Slurpuff

description: It flings sand into the eyes of its prey and tries to close in on them while they're blinded, but since Sandygast is so slow, the prey tends to escape.
name: Sandygast

description: From the hollows in its arms, it fires the bones of its victims, which are all dried up after being drained of their vitality.
name: Palossand

description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
name: Enamorus

description: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.
name: Munkidori

description: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.
name: Fezandipiti

description: No matter how high a place it falls from, this Pokémon can save itself by rolling into a ball and bouncing.
name: Sandshrew

description: The spikes on its body are made up of its hardened hide. It rolls up and attacks foes with its spikes.
name: Sandslash

description: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.
name: Hisuian Growlithe

description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.
name: Hisuian Arcanine

description: When endangered, it may protect itself by increasing its magnetism and drawing nearby iron objects to its body.
name: Nosepass

description: Probopass radiates such a powerful magnetic field that nearby electrical appliances are rendered useless while it's around.
name: Probopass

description: It fights by swinging a piece of lumber around. It is close to evolving when it can handle heavy lumber without difficulty.
name: Timburr

description: This Pokémon is so muscular and strongly built that even a group of wrestlers could not make it budge an inch.
name: Gurdurr

description: Rather than rely on their strength, they master moves that make good use of centrifugal force to swing around concrete.
name: Conkeldurr

description: Hawlucha live quietly without flocking together. They fight constantly with their natural enemies: noisy groups of Primeape.
name: Hawlucha

description: Glimmet's toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.
name: Glimmet

description: Glimmora's petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.
name: Glimmora

description: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.
name: Ting-Lu

description: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.
name: Okidogi

description: Poochyena pursue their prey in packs. Once the prey is exhausted, the pack finishes it off. But sometimes the prey retaliates, and the pack flees.
name: Poochyena

description: Once it's caught the scent of faraway prey, the leader gives a signal, and the whole pack moves out.
name: Mightyena

description: Venipede and Sizzlipede are similar species, but when the two meet, a huge fight ensues.
name: Venipede

description: This Pokémon spins itself rapidly and charges into its opponents. Its top speed is just over 60 mph.
name: Whirlipede

description: Scolipede latches on to its prey with the claws on its neck before slamming them into the ground and jabbing them with its claws' toxic spikes.
name: Scolipede

description: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.
name: Brute Bonnet

description: People fashion swords from Skarmory's shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.
name: Skarmory

description: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.
name: Aron

description: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.
name: Lairon

description: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.
name: Aggron

description: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
name: Heatran

description: The steel section is Varoom's actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.
name: Varoom

description: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.
name: Revavroom

description: Applin lives inside an apple. When an Applin is separated from its apple, its body loses moisture and the Pokémon grows weak.
name: Applin

description: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.
name: Dipplin

description: It has a habit of biting at Clauncher even though it doesn't feed on them. This is said to be vestigial behavior from when Dreepy was alive.
name: Dreepy

description: This Pokémon stores up energy in its lungs, then shoots it out. It takes care of Dreepy and battles alongside them until they're all grown up.
name: Drakloak

description: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.
name: Tatsugiri

description: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.
name: Farfetch'd

description: It walks carefully to prevent its egg from breaking. However, it is extremely fast at running away.
name: Chansey

description: Its genetic code is irregular. It may mutate if it is exposed to radiation from element stones.
name: Eevee

description: Its stomach's digestive juices can dissolve any kind of poison. Eating things off the ground doesn't bother it at all.
name: Snorlax

description: Its tail moves with greater dexterity than its hands. Making deft use of this tail, Aipom lives high among the treetops.
name: Aipom

description: Split into two, the tails are so adept at handling and doing things that Ambipom rarely uses its hands.
name: Ambipom

description: It strengthens its body by diving into the depths of ponds, swimming around while looking for bog moss to eat.
name: Ducklett

description: It's said that many artists have taken inspiration from the sight of a Swanna performing a beautiful dance in the light of dawn.
name: Swanna

name: Metal Saucer
