description: While young, it has six gorgeous tails. When it grows, several new tails are sprouted.
name: Vulpix

description: It is said to live 1,000 years, and each of its tails is loaded with supernatural powers.
name: Ninetales

description: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.
name: Heatmor

description: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.
name: Salandit

description: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.
name: Salazzle

description: Explosive substances coat the shell on its back. Enemies that dare attack it will be blown away by an immense detonation.
name: Turtonator

description: Its flowers give off a relaxing fragrance. The stronger its aroma, the healthier the Roselia is.
name: Roselia

description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.
name: Scorbunny

description: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.
name: Scorbunny

description: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
name: Raboot

description: Its thick and fluffy fur protects it from the cold and enables it to use hotter fire moves.
name: Raboot

description: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
name: Cinderace

description: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
name: Cinderace

description: It juggles a pebble with its feet, turning it into a burning soccer ball. Its shots strike opponents hard and leave them scorched.
name: Cinderace

description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
name: Sizzlipede

description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
name: Sizzlipede

description: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
name: Centiskorch

description: After captivating opponents with its sweet scent, it lashes them with its thorny whips.
name: Roserade

description: It swims facing backward by opening and closing its two-piece shell. It is surprisingly fast.
name: Shellder

description: Its shell is extremely hard. It cannot be shattered, even with a bomb. The shell opens only when it is attacking.
name: Cloyster

description: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.
name: Krabby

description: It can be found near the sea. The large pincers grow back if they are torn out of their sockets.
name: Krabby

description: The large and hard pincer has 10,000-horsepower strength. However, being so big, it is unwieldy to move.
name: Kingler

description: Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.
name: Goldeen

description: Its dorsal, pectoral, and tail fins wave elegantly in water. That is why it is known as the Water Dancer.
name: Goldeen

description: Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.
name: Seaking

description: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.
name: Lapras

description: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.
name: Cottonee

description: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.
name: Qwilfish

description: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.
name: Mantine

description: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.
name: Sobble

description: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.
name: Sobble

description: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
name: Drizzile

description: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
name: Drizzile

description: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
name: Inteleon

description: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
name: Inteleon

description: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.
name: Whimsicott

description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
name: Chewtle

description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
name: Drednaw

description: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.
name: Cramorant

description: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.
name: Snom

description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
name: Frosmoth

description: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
name: Pikachu

description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.
name: Raichu

description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
name: Chinchou

description: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.
name: Chinchou

description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.
name: Lanturn

description: With noises that could be mistaken for the rattles of maracas, it creates an upbeat rhythm, startling bird Pokémon and making them fly off in a hurry.
name: Maractus

description: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.
name: Joltik

description: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.
name: Galvantula

description: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
name: Yamper

description: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
name: Yamper

description: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
name: Boltund

description: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
name: Boltund

description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
name: Pincurchin

description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.
name: Morpeko

description: They lay their eggs deep inside their nests. When attacked by Heatmor, they retaliate using their massive mandibles.
name: Durant

description: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.
name: Galarian Ponyta

description: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.
name: Galarian Rapidash

description: Born from gases, anyone would faint if engulfed by its gaseous body, which contains poison.
name: Gastly

description: Its tongue is made of gas. If licked, its victim starts shaking constantly until death eventually comes.
name: Haunter

description: On the night of a full moon, if shadows move on their own and laugh, it must be Gengar's doing.
name: Gengar

description: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.
name: Munna

description: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.
name: Musharna

description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
name: Sinistea

description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
name: Polteageist

description: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.
name: Diglett

description: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
name: Dugtrio

description: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
name: Hitmonlee

description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
name: Hitmonchan

description: It can remember only one thing at a time. Once it starts rushing, it forgets why it started.
name: Rhyhorn

description: Strong, but not too bright, this Pokémon can shatter even a skyscraper with its charging tackles.
name: Rhyhorn

description: Protected by an armor-like hide, it is capable of living in molten lava of 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Rhydon

description: It relies on its carapace to deflect incoming attacks and throw its enemy off balance. As soon as that happens, it drives its drill into the foe.
name: Rhyperior

description: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.
name: Hisuian Voltorb

description: The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.
name: Hisuian Electrode

description: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.
name: Scyther

description: The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.
name: Scyther

description: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.
name: Yanma

description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.
name: Yanmega

description: This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.
name: Heracross

description: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
name: Kricketot

description: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.
name: Kricketune

description: The members of the trio spend all their time together. Each one has a slightly different taste in nectar.
name: Combee

description: It skillfully commands its grubs in battles with its enemies. The grubs are willing to risk their lives to defend Vespiquen.
name: Vespiquen

description: Cells similar to those of plants have been found in its fur. Its hard tail can fell a large tree with one stroke, and the tail's sharpness exceeds even that of a sword crafted by a master.
name: Leafeon

description: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.
name: Shaymin

description: The leaves on its head are highly valued for medicinal purposes. Dry the leaves in the sun, boil them, and then drink the bitter decoction for remarkably effective relief from fatigue.
name: Petilil

description: I suspect that its well-developed legs are the result of a life spent on mountains covered in deep snow. The scent it exudes from its flower crown heartens those in proximity.
name: Hisuian Lilligant

description: Flies noiselessly on delicate wings. It has mastered the art of deftly launching dagger-sharp feathers from those same wings.
name: Rowlet

description: Regularly basks in sunlight to gather power—presumably due to the frigid climate. Nonetheless, the edges of the blade quills set into its wings are keen as ever.
name: Dartrix

description: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.
name: Ponyta

description: This Pokémon can be seen galloping through fields at speeds of up to 150 mph, its fiery mane fluttering in the wind.
name: Rapidash

description: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.
name: Cyndaquil

description: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.
name: Quilava

description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.
name: Radiant Heatran

description: Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.
name: Psyduck

description: This Pokémon lives in gently flowing rivers. It paddles through the water with its long limbs, putting its graceful swimming skills on display.
name: Golduck

description: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.
name: Swinub

description: If it charges at an enemy, the hairs on its back stand up straight. It is very sensitive to sound.
name: Piloswine

description: This Pokémon can be spotted in wall paintings from as far back as 10,000 years ago. For a while, it was thought to have gone extinct.
name: Mamoswine

description: This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.
name: Mantine

description: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.
name: Barboach

description: It makes its nest at the bottom of swamps. It will eat anything—if it is alive, Whiscash will eat it.
name: Whiscash

description: With cold air that can reach temperatures as low as −328 degrees Fahrenheit, Regice instantly freezes any creature that approaches it.
name: Regice

description: Glaceon is able to lower its body temperature very quickly. It freezes the atmosphere, creating diamond dust that glitters like gems while it flutters and dances around.
name: Glaceon

description: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name "scalchop.".
name: Oshawott

description: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.
name: Dewott

description: Though it differs from other Basculin in several respects, including demeanor—this one is gentle—I have categorized it as a regional form given the vast array of shared qualities.
name: Hisuian Basculin

description: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
name: Hisuian Basculegion

description: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.
name: Keldeo

description: It appears and vanishes with a ninja's grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
name: Radiant Greninja

description: Lives on mountains blanketed in perennial snow. It freezes water vapor in the air to make the ice helmet that it dons for defense.
name: Bergmite

description: The armor of ice covering its lower jaw puts steel to shame and can shatter rocks with ease. This Pokémon barrels along steep mountain paths, cleaving through the deep snow.
name: Hisuian Avalugg

description: This Pokémon is a cluster of electrical energy. It's said that removing the rings on Regieleki's body will unleash the Pokémon's latent power.
name: Regieleki

description: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.
name: Hisuian Typhlosion

description: This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.
name: Togepi

description: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.
name: Togetic

description: These Pokémon are never seen anywhere near conflict or turmoil. In recent times, they've hardly been seen at all.
name: Togekiss

description: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.
name: Misdreavus

description: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.
name: Mismagius

description: Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.
name: Ralts

description: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
name: Kirlia

description: True to its honorable-warrior image, it uses the blades on its elbows only in defense of something or someone.
name: Gallade

description: Said to lure away young children and carry them off to the afterlife. Some whisper that Drifloon are formed of reincarnated human souls, but these rumors are as yet unconfirmed.
name: Drifloon

description: Some say this Pokémon is a collection of souls burdened with regrets, silently drifting through the dusk.
name: Drifblim

description: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.
name: Uxie

description: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake's surface.
name: Mesprit

description: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.
name: Azelf

description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
name: Diancie

description: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
name: Wyrdeer

description: They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.
name: Hisuian Growlithe

description: Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.
name: Hisuian Arcanine

description: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.
name: Sudowoodo

description: Every bit of Regirock's body is made of stone. As parts of its body erode, this Pokémon sticks rocks to itself to repair what's been lost.
name: Regirock

description: Its hard skull is its distinguishing feature. It snapped trees by headbutting them, and then it fed on their ripe berries.
name: Cranidos

description: This ancient Pokémon used headbutts skillfully. Its brain was really small, so some theories suggest that its stupidity led to its extinction.
name: Rampardos

description: Though large and languid, Hippopotas is difficult to detect due to its tendency to burrow into and lurk beneath the soil. When agitated or excited, it expels sand from its nostrils.
name: Hippopotas

description: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.
name: Hippowdon

description: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.
name: Radiant Hawlucha

description: The air stored inside the rachises of Decidueye's feathers insulates the Pokémon against Hisui's extreme cold. This is firm proof that evolution can be influenced by environment.
name: Hisuian Decidueye

description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
name: Kleavor

description: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
name: Kleavor

description: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.
name: Hisuian Qwilfish

description: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.
name: Hisuian Qwilfish

description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
name: Hisuian Overqwil

description: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname "sea fiend." It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
name: Hisuian Overqwil

description: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.
name: Hisuian Sneasel

description: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
name: Hisuian Sneasler

description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.
name: Poochyena

description: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.
name: Mightyena

description: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.
name: Absol

description: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
name: Hisuian Samurott

description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
name: Nickit

description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
name: Thievul

description: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.
name: Magnemite

description: This Pokémon is three Magnemite that have linked together. Magneton sends out powerful radio waves to study its surroundings.
name: Magneton

description: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.
name: Magnezone

description: Registeel's body is made of a strange material that is flexible enough to stretch and shrink but also more durable than any metal.
name: Registeel

description: Although its fossils can be found in layers of primeval rock, nothing but its face has ever been discovered.
name: Shieldon

description: This Pokémon is from roughly 100 million years ago. Its terrifyingly tough face is harder than steel.
name: Bastiodon

description: Floats using a mysterious energy. The pattern engraved upon its back is held as sacred and can sometimes be found in imagery from ancient cemeteries and other such timeworn places.
name: Bronzor

description: Some believe it to be a deity that summons rain clouds. When angered, it lets out a warning cry that rings out like the tolling of a bell.
name: Bronzong

description: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.
name: Pawniard

description: It's accompanied by a large retinue of Pawniard. Bisharp keeps a keen eye on its minions, ensuring none of them even think of double-crossing it.
name: Bisharp

description: An academic theory proposes that Regidrago's arms were once the head of an ancient dragon Pokémon. The theory remains unproven.
name: Regidrago

description: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.
name: Eevee

description: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.
name: Hoothoot

description: Its eyes are specially developed to enable it to see clearly even in murky darkness and minimal light.
name: Noctowl

description: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.
name: Teddiursa

description: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.
name: Ursaring

description: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
name: Ursaluna

description: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.
name: Stantler

description: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.
name: Miltank

description: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.
name: Glameow

description: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.
name: Purugly

description: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.
name: Chatot

description: There is an enduring legend that states this Pokémon towed continents with ropes.
name: Regigigas

description: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.
name: Rufflet

description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.
name: Hisuian Braviary

description:
You can use this card only if you discard 2 Metal Energy cards from your hand.
Search your deck for up to 2 cards and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
name: Adaman

description: Until the end of your turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon has no Abilities. (This includes Pokémon that come into play during that turn.)
name: Canceling Cologne

description: Each player reveals their hand. Draw 3 cards.
name: Choy

description: Flip 2 coins. Put a number of cards up to the number of heads from your discard pile on top of your deck in any order.
name: Cyllene

description: Attach a basic Darkness Energy card from your discard pile to 1 of your Benched Darkness Pokémon.
name: Dark Patch

description: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal an Energy card you find there and put it into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
name: Energy Loto

description: Search your deck for a Pokémon that has no Retreat Cost, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
name: Feather Ball

description: Whenever either player puts a Basic Pokémon from their hand onto their Bench, put 2 damage counters on that Pokémon.
name: Gapejaw Bog

description: Draw 2 cards. If you drew any cards in this way, attach up to 2 Grass Energy cards from your hand to 1 of your Benched Pokémon.
name: Gardenia's Vigor

description:
During this turn, your Fighting Pokémon's attacks do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
During your turn, if this Grant is in your discard pile, you may discard 2 cards, except any Grant, from your hand. If you do, put this Grant into your hand. (This effect doesn't use up your Supporter card for the turn.)
name: Grant

description: Reveal the top card of your deck. If that card is a Fighting Energy card, attach it to 1 of your Benched Pokémon. If it is not a Fighting Energy card, put it into your hand.
name: Gutsy Pickaxe

description: Look at your face-down Prize cards. You may reveal a Basic Pokémon you find there, put it into your hand, and put this Hisuian Heavy Ball in its place as a face-down Prize card. (If you don't reveal a Basic Pokémon, put this card in the discard pile.) Then, shuffle your face-down Prize cards.
name: Hisuian Heavy Ball

description: Search your deck for a Water Pokémon and an Item card, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
name: Irida

description: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.
name: Milotic

description: It's said that if they are seen at midnight, they'll cause heavy snow. They eat snow and ice to survive.
name: Snorunt

description: It has a body of ice that won't melt, even with fire. It can instantly freeze moisture in the atmosphere.
name: Glalie

description: After a woman met her end on a snowy mountain, her regrets lingered on. From them, this Pokémon was born. Its favorite food is frozen souls.
name: Froslass

description: Rock-hard scales and oil-filled swim bladders allow this Pokémon to survive the intense water pressure of the deep sea.
name: Relicanth

description: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
name: Phione

description: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.
name: Keldeo

description: It forms a water bubble at the rear of its body and then covers its head with it. Meeting another Dewpider means comparing water-bubble sizes.
name: Dewpider

description: It launches water bubbles with its legs, drowning prey within the bubbles. This Pokémon can then take its time to savor its meal.
name: Araquanid

description: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
name: Pikachu

description: Its long tail serves as a ground to protect itself from its own high-voltage power.
name: Raichu

description: Its antennae, which evolved from a fin, have both positive and negative charges flowing through them.
name: Chinchou

description: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea's surface from a depth of over three miles.
name: Lanturn

description: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.
name: Rotom

description: As Emolga flutters through the air, it crackles with electricity. This Pokémon is cute, but it can cause a lot of trouble.
name: Emolga

description: Thanks to bacteria that lived in the mud flats with it, this Pokémon developed the organs it uses to generate electricity.
name: Stunfisk

description: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.
name: Zeraora

description: It has an incredibly high level of intelligence. Some say that Alakazam remembers everything that ever happens to it, from birth till death.
name: Radiant Alakazam

description: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.
name: Drowzee

description: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.
name: Hypno

description: In certain parts of Galar, Jynx was once feared and worshiped as the Queen of Ice.
name: Jynx

description: What makes it happy is imitating the voices of weeping people and scaring everyone. It doesn't deal well with folks who aren't easily frightened.
name: Misdreavus

description: Its muttered curses can cause awful headaches or terrifying visions that torment others.
name: Mismagius

description: It is highly attuned to the emotions of people and Pokémon. It hides if it senses hostility.
name: Ralts

description: If its Trainer becomes happy, it overflows with energy, dancing joyously while spinning about.
name: Kirlia

description: It has the power to predict the future. Its power peaks when it is protecting its Trainer.
name: Gardevoir

description: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.
name: Meditite

description: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.
name: Medicham

description: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.
name: Chimecho

description: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.
name: Sigilyph

description: It communicates with others telepathically. Its body is encapsulated in liquid, but if it takes a heavy blow, the liquid will leak out.
name: Solosis

description: Its psychic power can supposedly cover a range of more than half a mile—but only if its two brains can agree with each other.
name: Duosion

description: While it could use its psychic abilities in battle, this Pokémon prefers to swing its powerful arms around to beat opponents into submission.
name: Reuniclus

description: If this Pokémon stands near a TV, strange scenery will appear on the screen. That scenery is said to be from its home.
name: Elgyem

description: Whenever a Beheeyem visits a farm, a Dubwool mysteriously disappears.
name: Beheeyem

description: Though Espurr's expression never changes, behind that blank stare is an intense struggle to contain its devastating psychic power.
name: Espurr

description: Females are a bit more selfish and aggressive than males. If they don't get what they want, they will torment you with their psychic abilities.
name: Meowstic

description: It eats its own weight in sugar every day. If it doesn't get enough sugar, it becomes incredibly grumpy.
name: Swirlix

description: By taking in a person's scent, it can sniff out their mental and physical condition. It's hoped that this skill will have many medical applications.
name: Slurpuff

description: A Dedenne's whiskers pick up electrical waves other Dedenne send out. These Pokémon share locations of food or electricity with one another.
name: Dedenne

description: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.
name: Indeedee

description: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
name: Dreepy

description: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
name: Drakloak

description: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
name: Dragapult

description: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
name: Phanpy

description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.
name: Donphan

description: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.
name: Baltoy

description: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.
name: Claydol

description: This Pokémon was restored from a fossil. Anorith lived in the ocean about 100,000,000 years ago, hunting with its pair of claws.
name: Anorith

description: After evolution, this Pokémon emerged onto land. Its lower body has become stronger, and blows from its tail are devastating.
name: Armaldo

description: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.
name: Terrakion

description: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.
name: Hawlucha

description: Grudges of the dead have possessed a mound of sand and become a Pokémon. Sandygast is fond of the shovel on its head.
name: Sandygast

description: Palossand is known as the Beach Nightmare. It pulls its prey down into the sand by controlling the sand itself, and then it sucks out their souls.
name: Palossand

description: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.
name: Stonjourner

description: It emits ultrasonic waves from its mouth to check its surroundings. Even in tight caves, Zubat flies around with skill.
name: Zubat

description: It loves to drink other creatures' blood. It's said that if it finds others of its kind going hungry, it sometimes shares the blood it's gathered.
name: Golbat

description: Both of its legs have turned into wings. Without a sound, Crobat flies swiftly toward its prey and sinks its fangs into the nape of its target's neck.
name: Crobat

description: It searches for shiny things for its boss. Murkrow's presence is said to be unlucky, so many people detest it.
name: Murkrow

description: Its goons take care of most of the fighting for it. The only time it dirties its own hands is in delivering a final blow to finish off an opponent.
name: Honchkrow

description: It makes frightening noises with its poison-filled cheek sacs. When opponents flinch, Croagunk hits them with a poison jab.
name: Croagunk

description: It bounces toward opponents and gouges them with poisonous claws. No more than a scratch is needed to knock out its adversaries.
name: Toxicroak

description: The desert gets cold at night, so when the sun sets, this Pokémon burrows deep into the sand and sleeps until sunrise.
name: Sandile

description: Krokorok has specialized eyes that enable it to see in the dark. This ability lets Krokorok hunt in the dead of night without getting lost.
name: Krokorok

description: This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sands. Krookodile's mighty jaws can bite through heavy plates of iron with almost no effort at all.
name: Krookodile

description: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.
name: Mareanie

description: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.
name: Toxapex

description: Intense hunger drives it to extremes of violence, and the electricity in its cheek sacs has converted into a Dark-type energy.
name: Morpeko

description: From its rear, Beldum emits a magnetic force that rapidly pulls opponents in. They get skewered on Beldum's sharp claws.
name: Beldum

description: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.
name: Metang

description: Because the magnetic powers of these Pokémon get stronger in freezing temperatures, Metagross living on snowy mountains are full of energy.
name: Metagross

description: It is said to have the ability to grant any wish for just one week every thousand years.
name: Radiant Jirachi

description: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.
name: Ferroseed

description: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.
name: Ferrothorn

description: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.
name: Klink

description: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.
name: Klang

description: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.
name: Klinklang

description: This Pokémon appears in a legend alongside Terrakion and Virizion, fighting against humans in defense of the Unova region's Pokémon.
name: Cobalion

description: With the long hairs on its back, this Pokémon takes in electricity from other electric Pokémon. It stores what it absorbs in an electric sac.
name: Togedemaru

description: Dratini dwells near bodies of rapidly flowing water, such as the plunge pools of waterfalls. As it grows, Dratini will shed its skin many times.
name: Dratini

description: This Pokémon lives in pristine oceans and lakes. It can control the weather, and it uses this power to fly into the sky, riding on the wind.
name: Dragonair

description: It's a kindhearted Pokémon. If it spots a drowning person or Pokémon, Dragonite simply must help them.
name: Dragonite

description: After nightfall, they emerge from the caves they nest in during the day. Using their ultrasonic waves, they go on the hunt for ripened fruit.
name: Noibat

description: Aggressive and cruel, this Pokémon will ruthlessly torment enemies that are helpless in the dark.
name: Noivern

description: Born when around 10% of Zygarde's cells have been gathered from all over, this form is skilled in close-range combat.
name: Zygarde

description: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.
name: Smeargle

description: Each Spinda's spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents' attacks brilliantly!
name: Spinda

description: Its cottony wings are full of air, making them light and fluffy to the touch. Swablu takes diligent care of its wings.
name: Swablu

description: As it flies in a calm and relaxed manner, Altaria performs a humming song that would enrapture any audience.
name: Altaria

description: If both of Buneary's ears are rolled up, something is wrong with its body or mind. It's a sure sign the Pokémon is in need of care.
name: Buneary

description: Lopunny is constantly monitoring its surroundings. If danger approaches, this Pokémon responds with superdestructive kicks.
name: Lopunny

description: This Pokémon was successfully restored from a fossil. As research suggested, Archen is unable to fly. But it's very good at jumping.
name: Archen

description: It needs a running start to take off. If Archeops wants to fly, it first needs to run nearly 25 mph, building speed over a course of about 2.5 miles.
name: Archeops

description: Its chick-like looks belie its hotheadedness. It challenges its parents at every opportunity, desperate to prove its strength.
name: Rufflet

description: Screaming a bloodcurdling battle cry, this huge and ferocious bird Pokémon goes out on the hunt. It blasts lakes with shock waves, then scoops up any prey that float to the water's surface.
name: Hisuian Braviary

description: Its melodious cries are actually warnings. Fletchling will mercilessly peck at anything that enters its territory.
name: Fletchling

description:
You can use this card only when it is the last card in your hand.
Draw a card for each Benched Pokémon (both yours and your opponent's).
name: Brandon

description: Look at the top 7 cards of your deck. You may reveal any number of Water Pokémon and Water Energy cards you find there and put them into your hand. Shuffle the other cards back into your deck.
name: Candice

description: Flip a coin. If heads, search your deck for an Evolution Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If tails, search your deck for a Basic Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
name: Capturing Aroma

description: The Pokémon V this card is attached to can use the VSTAR Power on this card. (You still need the necessary Energy to use this attack.)
name: Earthen Seal Stone

description: At the end of each turn, if the Pokémon this card is attached to has 30 HP or less remaining and has any damage counters on it, heal 120 damage from it. If you healed any damage in this way, discard this card.
name: Emergency Jelly

name: Forest Seal Stone

description: Search your deck for a Basic Pokémon and put it onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck. You may switch that Pokémon with your Active Pokémon.
name: Furisode Girl

description: Draw 2 cards. If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, draw 2 more cards.
name: Gym Trainer

description: Search your deck for up to 3 Dragon Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
name: Lance

description: Whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to the Pokémon VSTAR or Pokémon VMAX this card is attached to.
name: Leafy Camo Poncho

description: Once during each player's turn, that player may look at the top card of their deck. They may discard that card.
name: Primordial Altar

description: Put up to 3 Pokémon that have "Hisuian" in their names from your discard pile into your hand.
name: Professor Laventon

description:
You may use 4 Quad Stone cards at once.
• If you used 1 card, heal 10 damage from your Active Pokémon.
• If you used 4 cards, heal all damage from each of your Pokémon. (This effect works one time for 4 cards.)

name: Wallace

description: If exposed to moonlight, it starts to move. It roams far and wide at night to scatter its seeds.
name: Oddish

description: Its pistils exude an incredibly foul odor. The horrid stench can cause fainting at a distance of 1.25 miles.
name: Gloom

description: Plentiful in the tropics. When it dances, its petals rub together and make a pleasant ringing sound.
name: Bellossom

description: Hidden beneath a tangle of vines that grows nonstop even if the vines are torn off, this Pokémon's true appearance remains a mystery.
name: Tangela

description: Tangrowth has two arms that it can extend as it pleases. Recent research has shown that these arms are, in fact, bundles of vines.
name: Tangrowth

description: As Scyther fights more and more battles, its scythes become sharper and sharper. With a single slice, Scyther can fell a massive tree.
name: Scyther

description: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.
name: Sunkern

description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.
name: Yanma

description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.
name: Yanmega

description: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
name: Kricketot

description: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!
name: Cherubi

description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.
name: Carnivine

description: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.
name: Grubbin

description: Within dense forests, this Pokémon lives in a pack with others of its kind. It's incredibly aggressive, and the other Pokémon of the forest fear it.
name: Zarude

description: Calyrex is a merciful Pokémon, capable of providing healing and blessings. It reigned over the Galar region in times of yore.
name: Calyrex

description: It spits fire that is hot enough to melt boulders. It may cause forest fires by blowing flames.
name: Radiant Charizard

description: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
name: Entei

description: The people of ancient times believed that Larvesta fell from the sun.
name: Larvesta

description: Volcarona scatters burning scales. Some say it does this to start fires. Others say it's trying to rescue those that suffer in the cold.
name: Volcarona

description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
name: Volcanion

description: Its venom sacs produce a fluid that this Pokémon then heats up with the flame in its tail. This process creates Salandit's poisonous gas.
name: Salandit

description: Only female Salazzle exist. They emit a gas laden with pheromones to captivate male Salandit.
name: Salazzle

description: Thanks to its thick fat, cold seas don't bother it at all, but it gets tired pretty easily in warm waters.
name: Seel

description: It can radiate chilliness from the bottoms of its feet. It'll spend the whole day tap-dancing on a frozen floor.
name: Galarian Mr. Mime

description: It shows off by spraying jets of seawater from the nostrils above its eyes. It eats a solid ton of Wishiwashi every day.
name: Wailmer

description: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.
name: Wailord

description: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.
name: Corphish

description: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Snorunt

description: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.
name: Luvdisc

description: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
name: Kyogre

description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
name: Shinx

description: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.
name: Shinx

description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
name: Luxio

description: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.
name: Luxio

description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.
name: Luxray

description: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.
name: Luxray

description: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.
name: Emolga

description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
name: Eelektrik

description: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.
name: Helioptile

description: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.
name: Heliolisk

description: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.
name: Radiant Charjabug

description: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.
name: Zeraora

description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
name: Pincurchin

description: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.
name: Exeggcute

description: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.
name: Exeggutor

description: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.
name: Mewtwo

description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.
name: Girafarig

description: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.
name: Lunatone

description: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.
name: Dusclops

description: Although called a guardian deity, Tapu Lele is devoid of guilt about its cruel disposition and can be described as nature incarnate.
name: Tapu Lele

description: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
name: Enamorus

description: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.
name: Graveler

description: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.
name: Solrock

description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.
name: Baltoy

description: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.
name: Riolu

description: It chooses a Pangoro as its master and then imitates its master's actions. This is how it learns to battle and hunt for prey.
name: Pancham

description: This Pokémon can bond very strongly with its Trainer, but it also has a habit of biting. Raising a Rockruff for a long time can be challenging.
name: Rockruff

description: This form of Lycanroc is reckless. It charges headlong at its opponents, attacking without any care about what injuries it might receive.
name: Lycanroc

description: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.
name: Koffing

description: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.
name: Absol

description: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.
name: Purrloin

description: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.
name: Liepard

description: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.
name: Krokorok

description: This Pokémon is quick to anger, and it has no problem using its prodigious strength to get its way. It lives for duels against Obstagoon.
name: Pangoro

description: It drifts in the ocean, blending in with floating seaweed. When other Pokémon come to feast on the seaweed, Skrelp feasts on them instead.
name: Skrelp

description: Dragalge uses a poisonous liquid capable of corroding metal to send tankers that enter its territory to the bottom of the sea.
name: Dragalge

description: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.
name: Hoopa

description: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.
name: Galarian Meowth

description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
name: Galarian Perrserker

description: Bulky pincers account for one third of Scizor's body weight. A single swing of one of these pincers will crush a boulder completely.
name: Scizor

description: It eats iron ore—and sometimes railroad tracks— to build up the steel armor that protects its body.
name: Aron

description: Lairon live in mountains brimming with spring water and iron ore, so these Pokémon often came into conflict with humans in the past.
name: Lairon

description: Aggron has a horn sharp enough to perforate thick iron sheets. It brings down its opponents by ramming into them horn first.
name: Aggron

description: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.
name: Metang

description: It uses river stones to maintain the cutting edges of the blades covering its body. These sharpened blades allow it to bring down opponents.
name: Pawniard

name: Magmar

description: In battle, it flaps its wings at great speed to release highly toxic dust into the air.
name: Butterfree

description: Magmortar takes down its enemies by shooting fireballs, which burn them to a blackened crisp. It avoids this method when hunting prey.
name: Magmortar

description: The flame on its head keeps its body slightly warm. This Pokémon takes lost children by the hand to guide them to the spirit world.
name: Litwick

description: This Pokémon appears just before someone passes away, so it's feared as an emissary of death.
name: Lampent

description: This Pokémon haunts dilapidated mansions. It sways its arms to hypnotize opponents with the ominous dancing of its flames.
name: Chandelure

description: There's a hole in its tail that allows it to draw in the air it needs to keep its fire burning. If the hole gets blocked, this Pokémon will fall ill.
name: Heatmor

description: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.
name: Galarian Mr. Mime

description: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
name: Galarian Mr. Rime

description: It is virtually worthless in terms of both power and speed. It is the most weak and pathetic Pokémon in the world.
name: Magikarp

description: Its two sharp scythes are more than just weapons. It uses them with dexterity to dress its prey before eating.
name: Scyther

description: It has an extremely aggressive nature. The Hyper Beam it shoots from its mouth totally incinerates all targets.
name: Gyarados

description: It makes its nest on sheer cliffs. Riding the sea breeze, it glides up into the expansive skies.
name: Wingull

description: It is a messenger of the skies, carrying small Pokémon and eggs to safety in its bill.
name: Pelipper

description: Graceful ripples running across the water's surface are a sure sign that Tympole are singing in high-pitched voices below.
name: Tympole

description: It weakens its prey with sound waves intense enough to cause headaches, then entangles them with its sticky tongue.
name: Palpitoad

description: The vibrating of the bumps all over its body causes earthquake-like tremors. Seismitoad and Croagunk are similar species.
name: Seismitoad

description: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.
name: Galarian Darumaka

description: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.
name: Galarian Darmanitan

description: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.
name: Shuckle

description: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.
name: Cramorant

description: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.
name: Arrokuda

description: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
name: Barraskewda

description: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
name: Eiscue

description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.
name: Voltorb

description: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.
name: Electrode

description: While it's often blamed for power outages, the truth is the cause of outages is more often an error on the part of the electric company.
name: Electabuzz

description: A single Electivire can provide enough electricity for all the buildings in a big city for a year.
name: Electivire

description: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it's not that good at flying.
name: Heracross

description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
name: Shinx

description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
name: Luxio

description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.
name: Luxray

description: When spread, the frills on its head act like solar panels, generating the power behind this Pokémon's electric moves.
name: Helioptile

description: A now-vanished desert culture treasured these Pokémon. Appropriately, when Heliolisk came to the Galar region, treasure came with them.
name: Heliolisk

description: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.
name: Charjabug

description: It builds up electricity in its abdomen, focuses it through its jaws, and then fires the electricity off in concentrated beams.
name: Vikavolt

description: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
name: Toxel

description: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
name: Toxtricity

description: It searches about for clean water. If it does not drink water for too long, the leaf on its head wilts.
name: Lotad

description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.
name: Morpeko

description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
name: Clefairy

description: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.
name: Clefable

description: It is extremely good at climbing tree trunks and likes to eat the new sprouts on the trees.
name: Natu

description: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.
name: Xatu

description: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.
name: Galarian Corsola

description: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.
name: Galarian Cursola

description: It is nocturnal and becomes active at nightfall. It feeds on aquatic mosses that grow in the riverbed.
name: Lombre

description: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.
name: Sigilyph

description: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.
name: Sandygast

description: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.
name: Palossand

description: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
name: Hatenna

description: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
name: Hattrem

description: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
name: Hatterene

description: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
name: Milcery

description: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.
name: Alcremie

description: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.
name: Indeedee

description: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
name: Dreepy

description: The rhythm of bright, festive music activates Ludicolo's cells, making it more powerful.
name: Ludicolo

description: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
name: Drakloak

description: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
name: Dragapult

description: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.
name: Galarian Farfetch'd

description: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.
name: Galarian Sirfetch'd

description: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.
name: Nosepass

description: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.
name: Meditite

description: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe's next move.
name: Medicham

description: Its slimy body is hard to grasp. In one region, it is said to have been born from hardened mud.
name: Barboach

description: It moves with blinding speed and lobs poison at foes. Featuring Accelgor as a main character is a surefire way to make a movie or comic popular.
name: Accelgor

description: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.
name: Grimer

description: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.
name: Muk

description: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.
name: Spinarak

description: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.
name: Ariados

description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
name: Darkrai

description: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.
name: Purrloin

description: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.
name: Liepard

description: When it encounters something, its first urge is usually to bite it. If it likes what it tastes, it will commit the associated scent to memory.
name: Deino

description: While hunting for prey, Zweilous wanders its territory, its two heads often bickering over which way to go.
name: Zweilous

description: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.
name: Rowlet

description: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.
name: Hydreigon

description: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.
name: Hoopa

description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
name: Nickit

description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
name: Thievul

description: It throws one knifelike feather after another at its enemies, and each one precisely strikes a weak point. These feathers are known as blade quills.
name: Dartrix

description: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!
name: Skarmory

description: When it evolves, it sheds the steel carapace that covered its whole body and develops a new one.
name: Aron

description: It habitually shows off its strength with the sparks it creates by ramming its steel body into boulders.
name: Lairon

description: While seeking iron for food, it digs tunnels by breaking through bedrock with its steel horns.
name: Aggron

description: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.
name: Escavalier

description: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.
name: Klink

description: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.
name: Klang

description: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.
name: Klinklang

description: It dissolves and eats metal. Circulating liquid metal within its body is how it generates energy.
name: Meltan

description: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.
name: Decidueye

description: At the end of its life-span, Melmetal will rust and fall apart. The small shards left behind will eventually be reborn as Meltan.
name: Melmetal

description: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
name: Cufant

description: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
name: Copperajah

description: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.
name: Kangaskhan

description: They live in groups. The one with the longest, thickest, and most-scarred horns is the boss of the herd.
name: Tauros

description: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.
name: Sentret

description: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.
name: Furret

description: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.
name: Dunsparce

description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.
name: Teddiursa

description: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.
name: Ursaring

description: Its body gives off a sweet, fruity scent that is extremely appetizing to bird Pokémon.
name: Bounsweet

description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.
name: Lugia

description: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.
name: Skitty

description: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
name: Delcatty

description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.
name: Starly

description: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.
name: Staravia

description: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.
name: Staraptor

description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
name: Ducklett

description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
name: Swanna

description: As it twirls like a dancer, a sweet smell spreads out around it. Anyone who inhales the scent will feel a surge of happiness.
name: Steenee

description: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.
name: Bunnelby

name: Fletchling

name: Skwovet

description: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.
name: Greedent

description: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
name: Rookidee

description: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
name: Corvisquire

description: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
name: Corviknight

name: Rillaboom

description: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Coalossal
