description: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Torchic

description: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
name: Combusken

description: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.
name: Blaziken

description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.
name: Heatran

description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Pansear

description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
name: Simisear

description: Anger has reignited its atrophied flame sac. This Pokémon spews fire everywhere as it rampages indiscriminately.
name: Galarian Darmanitan

description: It protects itself with flame. Long years ago, people believed Larvesta had a nest on the sun.
name: Larvesta

description: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.
name: Paras

description: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.
name: Volcarona

description: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.
name: Fletchinder

description: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.
name: Talonflame

description: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.
name: Galarian Mr. Mime

description: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
name: Galarian Mr. Rime

description: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
name: Suicune

description: Although unattractive and unpopular, this Pokémon's marvelous vitality has made it a subject of research.
name: Feebas

description: Milotic has provided inspiration to many artists. It has even been referred to as the most beautiful Pokémon of all.
name: Milotic

description: The bug is mostly dead, with the mushroom on its back having become the main body. If the mushroom comes off, the bug stops moving.
name: Parasect

description: The reason it hasn't changed at all in a hundred million years is that it's apparently already a perfect life-form.
name: Relicanth

description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
name: Panpour

description: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
name: Simipour

description: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.
name: Galarian Darumaka

description: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.
name: Galarian Darmanitan

description: Unable to survive in hot areas, it makes itself comfortable by breathing out air cold enough to cause snow. It burrows into the snow to sleep.
name: Vanillite

description: By drinking pure water, it grows its icy body. This Pokémon can be hard to find on days with warm, sunny weather.
name: Vanillish

description: When its anger reaches a breaking point, this Pokémon unleashes a fierce blizzard that freezes every creature around it, be they friend or foe.
name: Vanilluxe

description: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.
name: Cubchoo

description: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.
name: Beartic

description: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.
name: Carnivine

description: Individually, they're incredibly weak. It's by gathering up into schools that they're able to confront opponents.
name: Wishiwashi

description: The first symptom of its sting is numbness. The next is an itching sensation so intense that it's impossible to resist the urge to claw at your skin.
name: Mareanie

description: To survive in the cold waters of Galar, this Pokémon forms a dome with its legs, enclosing its body so it can capture its own body heat.
name: Toxapex

description: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.
name: Dracovish

description: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
name: Arctovish

description: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.
name: Mareep

description: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.
name: Flaaffy

description: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.
name: Ampharos

description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.
name: Electrike

description: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.
name: Manectric

description: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.
name: Pansage

description: The lightning-wielding guardian deity of Melemele, Tapu Koko is brimming with curiosity and appears before people from time to time.
name: Tapu Koko

description: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
name: Toxel

description: Capable of generating 15,000 volts of electricity, this Pokémon looks down on all that would challenge it.
name: Toxtricity

description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
name: Pincurchin

description: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
name: Dracozolt

description: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
name: Arctozolt

description: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!
name: Jigglypuff

description: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!
name: Wigglytuff

description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
name: Simisage

description: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.
name: Snubbull

description: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.
name: Granbull

description: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.
name: Lunatone

description: Though they're still only babies, there's psychic power stored in their ribbonlike feelers, and sometimes they use that power to fight.
name: Gothita

description: It's said that when stars shine in the night sky, this Pokémon will spirit away sleeping children. Some call it the Witch of Punishment.
name: Gothorita

description: It has tremendous psychic power, but it dislikes conflict. It's also able to predict the future based on the movement of the stars.
name: Gothitelle

description: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.
name: Golett

description: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.
name: Golurk

description: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.
name: Dedenne

description: Pokémon living in the forest eat the delicious caps on Morelull's head. The caps regrow overnight.
name: Morelull

description: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.
name: Karrablast

description: Its flickering spores lure in prey and put them to sleep. Once this Pokémon has its prey snoozing, it drains their vitality with its fingertips.
name: Shiinotic

description: It wears a rag fashioned into a Pikachu costume in an effort to look less scary. Unfortunately, the costume only makes it creepier.
name: Mimikyu

description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
name: Sinistea

description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
name: Polteageist

description: If a Diglett digs through a field, it leaves the soil perfectly tilled and ideal for planting crops.
name: Diglett

description: A team of Diglett triplets. It triggers huge earthquakes by burrowing 60 miles underground.
name: Dugtrio

description: Born deep underground, it comes aboveground and becomes a pupa once it has finished eating the surrounding soil.
name: Larvitar

description: Even sealed in its shell, it can move freely. Hard and fast, it has outstanding destructive power.
name: Pupitar

description: Its body can't be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.
name: Tyranitar

description: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.
name: Trapinch

description: When attacked, it tightly shuts the lid of its shell. This reaction fails to protect it from Karrablast, however, because they can still get into the shell.
name: Shelmet

description: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.
name: Vibrava

description: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.
name: Flygon

description: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.
name: Solrock

description: It moves through the sands with its mouth open, swallowing sand along with its prey. It gets rid of the sand by spouting it from its nose.
name: Hippopotas

description: Stones can get stuck in the ports on their bodies. Dwebble help dislodge such stones, so Hippowdon look after these Pokémon.
name: Hippowdon

description: With power equal to an excavator, it can dig through dense bedrock. It's a huge help during tunnel construction.
name: Diggersby

description: Displaying amazing teamwork, they follow the orders of their boss as they all help out in the search for their favorite berries.
name: Passimian

description: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.
name: Galarian Sirfetch'd

description: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
name: Centiskorch

description: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.
name: Carvanha

description: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.
name: Sharpedo

description: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
name: Hatenna

description: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
name: Hattrem

description: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.
name: Weedle

description: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
name: Hatterene

description: Its whole body is composed of muscles. Even though it's the size of a human child, it can hurl 100 grown-ups.
name: Machop

description: Its muscular body is so powerful, it must wear a power-save belt to be able to regulate its motions.
name: Machoke

description: It quickly swings its four arms to rock its opponents with ceaseless punches and chops from all angles.
name: Machamp

description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
name: Zygarde

description: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!
name: Rockruff

description: While awaiting evolution, it hides from predators under leaves and in nooks of branches.
name: Kakuna

description: The rocks in its mane are sharper than a knife. Fragments that break off are treasured as good luck charms.
name: Lycanroc

description: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
name: Rolycoly

description: The eggs of bird Pokémon are its favorite food. It swallows eggs whole, so sometimes an egg gets stuck, and Ekans faints.
name: Ekans

description: After stunning its opponents with the pattern on its stomach, it quickly wraps them up in its body and waits for them to stop moving.
name: Arbok

description: Its restlessness has it constantly running around. If it sees another Pokémon, it will purposely run into them in order to start a fight.
name: Galarian Zigzagoon

description: It uses its long tongue to taunt opponents. Once the opposition is enraged, this Pokémon hurls itself at the opponent, tackling them forcefully.
name: Galarian Linoone

description: Its voice is staggering in volume. Obstagoon has a tendency to take on a threatening posture and shout—this move is known as Obstruct.
name: Galarian Obstagoon

description: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.
name: Absol

description: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.
name: Purrloin

description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.
name: Beedrill

description: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.
name: Liepard

description: If it locks eyes with you, watch out! Nothing and no one is safe from the reckless headbutts of this troublesome Pokémon.
name: Scraggy

description: As halfhearted as this Pokémon's kicks may seem, they pack enough power to shatter Conkeldurr's concrete pillars.
name: Scrafty

description: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.
name: Trubbish

description: It spins while making its luminescent spots flash. These spots allow it to communicate with others by using different patterns of light.
name: Inkay

description: Gazing at its luminescent spots will quickly induce a hypnotic state, putting the observer under Malamar's control.
name: Malamar

description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
name: Nickit

description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.
name: Swablu

description: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.
name: Altaria

name: Sizzlipede

description: Its poison stinger is very powerful. Its bright-colored body is intended to warn off its enemies.
name: Weedle

description: If it remains still, it looks just like a real nut. It delights in surprising foraging Pokémon.
name: Seedot

description: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
name: Clobbopus

description: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
name: Grapploct

description: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.
name: Zamazenta

description: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.
name: Poochyena

description: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.
name: Mightyena

description: This Pokémon is feared. When its gemstone eyes begin to glow with a sinister shine, it's believed that Sableye will steal people's spirits away.
name: Sableye

description: Sandile's still not good at hunting, so it mostly eats things that have collapsed in the desert. It's called "the cleaner of the desert."
name: Sandile

description: It buries some of its prey in the sand to use as emergency meals when its hunts are unsuccessful.
name: Krokorok

description: It conceals itself in sandstorms that Flygon whip up and waits patiently for prey to appear.
name: Krookodile

description: It lives deep in forests. With the leaf on its head, it makes a flute whose song makes listeners uneasy.
name: Nuzleaf

description: Its favorite places are unsanitary ones. If you leave trash lying around, you could even find one of these Pokémon living in your room.
name: Trubbish

description: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.
name: Garbodor

description: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.
name: Galarian Meowth

description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
name: Galarian Perrserker

description: In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.
name: Forretress

description: If you anger it, it will do more than rampage. It will also burst out strong magnetism, causing nearby machines to break.
name: Beldum

description: It flies at high speeds around the skies. When it finds its prey, Metang takes a firm grip with its sharp claws and never lets go.
name: Metang

description: It analyzes its opponents with more accuracy than a supercomputer, which enables it to calmly back them into a corner.
name: Metagross

description: Once every 1,000 years, the singing of a pure voice will rouse this Pokémon from its near-perpetual slumber. It wakes for only seven days.
name: Jirachi

description: A Pokémon that was feared as a forest guardian. It can read the foe's mind and take preemptive action.
name: Shiftry

description: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.
name: Lucario

description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
name: Dialga

description: It's not uncommon for tunnels that appear to have formed naturally to actually be a result of Excadrill's rampant digging.
name: Excadrill

description: It defends itself by launching spikes, but its aim isn't very good at first. Only after a lot of practice will it improve.
name: Ferroseed

description: This Pokémon scrapes its spikes across rocks, and then uses the tips of its feelers to absorb the nutrients it finds within the stone.
name: Ferrothorn

description: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.
name: Galarian Stunfisk

description: Built roughly 500 years ago by a scientist, the part called the Soul-Heart is the actual life-form.
name: Magearna

description: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
name: Duraludon

description: Because it lived almost entirely underground, it is nearly blind. It uses its antennae instead.

description: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.
name: Eevee

name: Snorlax

description: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.
name: Lugia

description: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.
name: Taillow

description: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.
name: Swellow

description: If it senses danger, it scares the foe by crying out with the volume of a jet-plane engine.

description: The shock waves from its cries can tip over trucks. It stamps its feet to power up.

description: Its roar in battle shakes the ground like a tremor—or like an earthquake has struck.
name: Exploud

description: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.

description: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.

description: Its cry leaves a lasting headache if heard for too long. It moves so quickly that it is almost invisible.
name: Ninjask

description: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.
name: Tornadus

description: It may look spindly, but its neck muscles are heavy-duty. It can peck at a tree 16 times per second!
name: Pikipek

description: From its mouth, it fires the seeds of berries it has eaten. The scattered seeds give rise to new plants.
name: Trumbeak

description: Known for forming harmonious couples, this Pokémon is brought to wedding ceremonies as a good luck charm.

name: Charmeleon

name: Charizard

name: Vaporeon

name: Wailmer

description: It can sometimes knock out opponents with the shock created by breaching and crashing its big body onto the water.
name: Wailord

description: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
name: Oshawott

description: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.
name: Dewott

description: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
name: Samurott

description: Apparently the itch of its teething impels it to snap its jaws at anything in front of it.
name: Chewtle

description: With jaws that can shear through steel rods, this highly aggressive Pokémon chomps down on its unfortunate prey.
name: Drednaw

description: Six of them form a single Pokémon. Should one of the six be lost, the next morning there will once more be six.
name: Exeggcute

description: Cramorant's gluttony led it to try to swallow an Arrokuda whole, which in turn led to Cramorant getting an Arrokuda stuck in its throat.
name: Cramorant

description: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.
name: Arrokuda

description: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
name: Barraskewda

description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.
name: Voltorb

description: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.
name: Electrode

description: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.
name: Jolteon

description: A legendary Pokémon that is said to live in thunderclouds. It freely controls lightning bolts.
name: Zapdos

description: Each of its three heads has its own thoughts. When they want to go in different directions, Exeggutor becomes unable to move.
name: Exeggutor

description: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.
name: Raikou

description: It stores static electricity in its fur for discharging. It gives off sparks if a storm approaches.
name: Electrike

description: It stimulates its own muscles with electricity, so it can move quickly. It eases its soreness with electricity, too, so it can recover quickly as well.
name: Manectric

description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
name: Blitzle

description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
name: Zebstrika

description: Joltik can be found clinging to other Pokémon. It's soaking up static electricity because it can't produce a charge on its own.
name: Joltik

description: It launches electrified fur from its abdomen as its means of attack. Opponents hit by the fur could be in for three full days and nights of paralysis.
name: Galvantula

description: One alone can emit only trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.
name: Tynamo

description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
name: Eelektrik

description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
name: Eelektross

description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.
name: Yanma

description: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.
name: Zekrom

description: It runs as fast as lightning strikes, shredding its opponents with its high-voltage claws.
name: Zeraora

description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
name: Pincurchin

description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
name: Clefairy

description: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.
name: Clefable

description: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.
name: Girafarig

description: A most peculiar Pokémon that somehow appears in a Poké Ball when a Nincada evolves.
name: Shedinja

description: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."
name: Shuppet

description: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.
name: Banette

description: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.
name: Duskull

description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.
name: Yanmega

description: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.
name: Dusclops

description: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.
name: Dusknoir

description: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.
name: Chimecho

description: While inside a cave, if you look up and see lots of heart-shaped marks lining the walls, it's evidence that Woobat live there.
name: Woobat

description: Emitting powerful sound waves tires it out. Afterward, it won't be able to fly for a little while.
name: Swoobat

description: It shoots cotton from its body to protect itself. If it gets caught up in hurricane-strength winds, it can get sent to the other side of the Earth.
name: Cottonee

description: It scatters cotton all over the place as a prank. If it gets wet, it'll become too heavy to move and have no choice but to answer for its mischief.
name: Whimsicott

description: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.
name: Dedenne

description: When the horns on its head shine in seven different colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.
name: Xerneas

description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
name: Diancie

description: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.
name: Pineco

description: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
name: Milcery

description: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.
name: Alcremie

description: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.
name: Zacian

description: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.
name: Wooper

description: It has an easygoing nature. It doesn't care if it bumps its head on boats and boulders while swimming.
name: Quagsire

description: It stores berries inside its shell. To avoid attacks, it hides beneath rocks and remains completely still.
name: Shuckle

description: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
name: Phanpy

description: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.
name: Donphan

description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.
name: Hitmontop

description: The same rocks that form its body have been found in ground layers around the world.
name: Regirock

description: This Pokémon has the ability to move through time. Records describing it as a forest deity can be found from many different eras.
name: Celebi

description: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.
name: Riolu

description: It brings its claws together and whirls around at high speed before rushing toward its prey.
name: Drilbur

description: It has phenomenal power. It will mercilessly crush anyone or anything that bullies small Pokémon.
name: Terrakion

description: Born when all of Zygarde's cells have been gathered together, it uses force to neutralize those who harm the ecosystem.
name: Zygarde

description: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!
name: Rockruff

description: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.
name: Lycanroc

description: Loads weighing up to 50 times as much as its own body weight pose no issue for this Pokémon. It's skilled at making use of mud.
name: Mudbray

description: Mud that hardens around a Mudsdale's legs sets harder than stone. It's so hard that it allows this Pokémon to scrap a truck with a single kick.
name: Mudsdale

description: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.
name: Yanma

description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
name: Grookey

description: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.
name: Thwackey

description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
name: Rillaboom

description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.
name: Gossifleur

description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
name: Eldegoss

description: Once the vines on Zarude's body tear off, they become nutrients in the soil. This helps the plants of the forest grow.
name: Zarude

description: When Reshiram's tail flares, the heat energy moves the atmosphere and changes the world's weather.
name: Reshiram

description: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.
name: Yanmega

description: It makes its nest in the shade of corals. If it senses danger, it spits murky ink and flees.
name: Horsea

description: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
name: Kyogre

description: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.
name: Buizel

description: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.
name: Floatzel

description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.
name: Manaphy

description: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
name: Volcanion

description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
name: Chewtle

description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
name: Drednaw

description: This hungry Pokémon swallows Arrokuda whole. Occasionally, it makes a mistake and tries to swallow a Pokémon other than its preferred prey.
name: Cramorant

description: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
name: Snom

description: It has the power to travel across time, but it is said to appear only in peaceful times.
name: Celebi

description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
name: Frosmoth

description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
name: Shinx

description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
name: Luxio

description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.
name: Luxray

description: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.
name: Rotom

description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.
name: Morpeko

description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.
name: Morpeko

description: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.
name: Cacnea

description: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.
name: Trapinch

description: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.
name: Koffing

description: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.
name: Galarian Weezing

description: Although the poison from its fangs isn't that strong, it's potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.
name: Spinarak

description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
name: Yveltal

description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
name: Nickit

description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
name: Thievul

description: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
name: Cufant

description: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.
name: Tropius

description: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.
name: Eevee

description: It uses the horns on its head to sense the emotions of others. Males will act as valets for those they serve, looking after their every need.
name: Indeedee

name: Ball Guy

description: Switch 1 of your opponent's Benched Pokémon with their Active Pokémon.
name: Boss's Orders (Lysandre)

description: Draw 2 cards. If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, draw 2 more cards.
name: Gym Trainer

description: At a distance, it launches its sharp feathers while flying about. If the enemy gets too close, Rowlet switches tactics and delivers vicious kicks.
name: Rowlet

description: Discard your hand and draw 7 cards.
name: Professor's Research (Professor Juniper)

description: The Zamazenta V this card is attached to gets +70 HP.
name: Rusted Shield

description: The attacks of the Zacian V this card is attached to do 30 more damage to your opponent's Active Pokémon (before applying Weakness and Resistance).
name: Rusted Sword

description: Search your deck for up to 2 Rare Fossil cards and put them onto your Bench. Then, shuffle your deck.

description: Draw 2 cards. If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, draw 2 more cards.
name: Gym Trainer

description: Search your deck for an Energy card and a Darkness Pokémon, reveal them, and put them into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
name: Piers

name: Dartrix

description: Search your deck for a Pokémon, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
name: Poké Kid

description: Attach up to 2 basic Energy cards from your discard pile to 1 of your Pokémon VMAX. If you attached any Energy cards in this way, discard your hand.

description: Search your deck for a Trainer card, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
name: Skyla

name: Thwackey

name: Rillaboom

name: Blipbug

description: As it grows inside its shell, it uses its psychic abilities to monitor the outside world and prepare for evolution.
name: Dottler

description: It emits psychic energy to observe and study what's around it—and what's around it can include things over six miles away.
name: Orbeetle

description: It whirls around in the wind while singing a joyous song. This delightful display has charmed many into raising this Pokémon.
name: Gossifleur

description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
name: Eldegoss

description: It spends its entire life inside an apple. It hides from its natural enemies, bird Pokémon, by pretending it's just an apple and nothing more.
name: Applin

description: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
name: Flapple

description: Eating a sweet apple caused its evolution. A nectarous scent wafts from its body, luring in the bug Pokémon it preys on.
name: Appletun

description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.
name: Scorbunny

description: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
name: Raboot

description: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
name: Cinderace

description: It stores flammable gas in its body and uses it to generate heat. The yellow sections on its belly get particularly hot.
name: Sizzlipede

description: When it heats up, its body temperature reaches about 1,500 degrees Fahrenheit. It lashes its body like a whip and launches itself at enemies.
name: Centiskorch

description: Its talent is tap-dancing. It can also manipulate temperatures to create a floor of ice, which this Pokémon can kick up to use as a barrier.
name: Galarian Mr. Mime

description: It's highly skilled at tap-dancing. It waves its cane of ice in time with its graceful movements.
name: Galarian Mr. Rime

description: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
name: Suicune

description: It lived in snowy areas for so long that its fire sac cooled off and atrophied. It now has an organ that generates cold instead.
name: Galarian Darumaka

description: On days when blizzards blow through, it comes down to where people live. It stashes food in the snowball on its head, taking it home for later.
name: Galarian Darmanitan

description: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.
name: Sobble

description: A clever combatant, this Pokémon battles using water balloons created with moisture secreted from its palms.
name: Drizzile

description: It has many hidden capabilities, such as fingertips that can shoot water and a membrane on its back that it can use to glide through the air.
name: Inteleon

description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
name: Chewtle

description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
name: Drednaw

description: It's so strong that it can knock out some opponents in a single hit, but it also may forget what it's battling midfight.
name: Cramorant

description: If it sees any movement around it, this Pokémon charges for it straightaway, leading with its sharply pointed jaw. It's very proud of that jaw.
name: Arrokuda

description: This Pokémon has a jaw that's as sharp as a spear and as strong as steel. Apparently Barraskewda's flesh is surprisingly tasty, too.
name: Barraskewda

description: It spits out thread imbued with a frigid sort of energy and uses it to tie its body to branches, disguising itself as an icicle while it sleeps.
name: Snom

description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
name: Frosmoth

description: It drifted in on the flow of ocean waters from a frigid place. It keeps its head iced constantly to make sure it stays nice and cold.
name: Eiscue

description: Powerful legs and jaws made it the apex predator of its time. Its own overhunting of its prey was what drove it to extinction.
name: Dracovish

description: Though it's able to capture prey by freezing its surroundings, it has trouble eating the prey afterward because its mouth is on top of its head.
name: Arctovish

description: One boy's invention led to the development of many different machines that take advantage of Rotom's unique capabilities.
name: Rotom

description: This Pokémon is very popular as a herding dog in the Galar region. As it runs, it generates electricity from the base of its tail.
name: Yamper

description: This Pokémon generates electricity and channels it into its legs to keep them going strong. Boltund can run nonstop for three full days.
name: Boltund

description: It stores poison in an internal poison sac and secretes that poison through its skin. If you touch this Pokémon, a tingling sensation follows.
name: Toxel

description: When this Pokémon sounds as if it's strumming a guitar, it's actually clawing at the protrusions on its chest to generate electricity.
name: Toxtricity

description: It feeds on seaweed, using its teeth to scrape it off rocks. Electric current flows from the tips of its spines.
name: Pincurchin

description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.
name: Morpeko

description: In ancient times, it was unbeatable thanks to its powerful lower body, but it went extinct anyway after it depleted all its plant-based food sources.
name: Dracozolt

description: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
name: Arctozolt

description: This Pokémon will look into your eyes and read the contents of your heart. If it finds evil there, it promptly hides away.
name: Galarian Ponyta

description: Brave and prideful, this Pokémon dashes airily through the forest, its steps aided by the psychic power stored in the fur on its fetlocks.
name: Galarian Rapidash

description: Watch your step when wandering areas oceans once covered. What looks like a stone could be this Pokémon, and it will curse you if you kick it.
name: Galarian Corsola

description: Its shell is overflowing with its heightened otherworldly energy. The ectoplasm serves as protection for this Pokémon's core spirit.
name: Galarian Cursola

description: Its upper whiskers are sensors that survey its surroundings. Its lower whiskers are organs that shoot electricity.
name: Dedenne

description: This Pokémon is said to have been born when a lonely spirit possessed a cold, leftover cup of tea.
name: Sinistea

description: This species lives in antique teapots. Most pots are forgeries, but on rare occasions, an authentic work is found.
name: Polteageist

description: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
name: Hatenna

description: No matter who you are, if you bring strong emotions near this Pokémon, it will silence you violently.
name: Hattrem

description: It emits psychic power strong enough to cause headaches as a deterrent to the approach of others.
name: Hatterene

description: This Pokémon was born from sweet-smelling particles in the air. Its body is made of cream.
name: Milcery

description: When it trusts a Trainer, it will treat them to berries it's decorated with cream.
name: Alcremie

description: These intelligent Pokémon touch horns with each other to share information between them.
name: Indeedee

description: After being reborn as a ghost Pokémon, Dreepy wanders the areas it used to inhabit back when it was alive in prehistoric seas.
name: Dreepy

description: It's capable of flying faster than 120 mph. It battles alongside Dreepy and dotes on them until they successfully evolve.
name: Drakloak

description: When it isn't battling, it keeps Dreepy in the holes on its horns. Once a fight starts, it launches the Dreepy like supersonic missiles.
name: Dragapult

description: The Farfetch'd of the Galar region are brave warriors, and they wield thick, tough leeks in battle.
name: Galarian Farfetch'd

description: Only Farfetch'd that have survived many battles can attain this evolution. When this Pokémon's leek withers, it will retire from combat.
name: Galarian Sirfetch'd

description: A clay slab with cursed engravings took possession of a Yamask. The slab is said to be absorbing the Yamask's dark power.
name: Galarian Yamask

description: A powerful curse was woven into an ancient painting. After absorbing the spirit of a Yamask, the painting began to move.
name: Galarian Runerigus

description: Most of its body has the same composition as coal. Fittingly, this Pokémon was first discovered in coal mines about 400 years ago.
name: Rolycoly

description: It forms coal inside its body. Coal dropped by this Pokémon once helped fuel the lives of people in the Galar region.
name: Carkol

description: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Coalossal

description: It spews sand from its nostrils. While the enemy is blinded, it burrows into the ground to hide.
name: Silicobra

description: Its unique style of coiling allows it to blast sand out of its sand sac more efficiently.
name: Sandaconda

description: It's very curious, but its means of investigating things is to try to punch them with its tentacles. The search for food is what brings it onto land.
name: Clobbopus

description: A body made up of nothing but muscle makes the grappling moves this Pokémon performs with its tentacles tremendously powerful.
name: Grapploct

description: Five of them are troopers, and one is the brass. The brass's orders are absolute.
name: Falinks

description: It stands in grasslands, watching the sun's descent from zenith to horizon. This Pokémon has a talent for delivering dynamic kicks.
name: Stonjourner

description: Its body is full of poisonous gas. It floats into garbage dumps, seeking out the fumes of raw, rotting trash.
name: Koffing

description: This Pokémon consumes particles that contaminate the air. Instead of leaving droppings, it expels clean air.
name: Galarian Weezing

description: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.
name: Galarian Zigzagoon

description: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.
name: Galarian Linoone

description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
name: Galarian Obstagoon

description: Aided by the soft pads on its feet, it silently raids the food stores of other Pokémon. It survives off its ill-gotten gains.
name: Nickit

description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.
name: Thievul

description: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
name: Impidimp

description: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
name: Morgrem

description: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
name: Grimmsnarl

description: Living with a savage, seafaring people has toughened this Pokémon's body so much that parts of it have turned to iron.
name: Galarian Meowth

description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
name: Galarian Perrserker

description: Living in mud with a high iron content has given it a strong steel body.
name: Galarian Stunfisk

description: This Pokémon reigns supreme in the skies of the Galar region. The black luster of its steel body could drive terror into the heart of any foe.
name: Corviknight

description: It digs up the ground with its trunk. It's also very strong, being able to carry loads of over five tons without any problem at all.
name: Cufant

description: They came over from another region long ago and worked together with humans. Their green skin is resistant to water.
name: Copperajah

description: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
name: Duraludon

description: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.
name: Minccino

description: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.
name: Cinccino

description: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
name: Ducklett

description: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
name: Swanna

description: It excels at digging holes. Using its ears, it can dig a nest 33 feet deep in one night.
name: Bunnelby

description: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.
name: Oranguru

description: Found throughout the Galar region, this Pokémon becomes uneasy if its cheeks are ever completely empty of berries.
name: Skwovet

description: It stashes berries in its tail—so many berries that they fall out constantly. But this Pokémon is a bit slow-witted, so it doesn't notice the loss.
name: Greedent

description: It will bravely challenge any opponent, no matter how powerful. This Pokémon benefits from every battle—even a defeat increases its strength a bit.
name: Rookidee

description: Smart enough to use tools in battle, these Pokémon have been seen picking up rocks and flinging them or using ropes to wrap up enemies.
name: Corvisquire

description: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.
name: Wooloo

description: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
name: Dubwool

description: Its bud looks like a human face. Because of the bud, it is rumored to be a type of legendary mandrake plant.
name: Bellsprout

description: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.
name: Durant

description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.
name: Mawile

description: Polishing Bronzor to a shine makes its surface reflect the truth, according to common lore. Be that as it may, Bronzor hates being polished.
name: Bronzor

description: Many scientists suspect that this Pokémon originated outside the Galar region, based on the patterns on its body.
name: Bronzong

description: A pack of these Pokémon forms to serve a Bisharp boss. Each Pawniard trains diligently, dreaming of one day taking the lead.
name: Pawniard

description: Violent conflicts erupt between Bisharp and Fraxure over places where sharpening stones can be found.
name: Bisharp

description: The blue eye on the sword's handguard is the true body of Honedge. With its old cloth, it drains people's lives away.
name: Honedge

description: The two swords employ a strategy of rapidly alternating between offense and defense to bring down their prey.
name: Doublade

description: Once upon a time, a king with an Aegislash reigned over the land. His Pokémon eventually drained him of life, and his kingdom fell with him.
name: Aegislash

description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.
name: Aegislash

description: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
name: Scatterbug

description: Due to its short wings, it can't fly long distances. It wanders about restlessly and pecks at bug Pokémon.
name: Spearow

description: Carrying food through Fearow's territory is dangerous. It will snatch the food away from you in a flash!
name: Fearow

description: It licks filth clean with its tongue. Whatever it licks always stinks afterward, so whether it's really clean is…questionable.
name: Lickitung

description: It uses its tongue much more skillfully than its hands or its feet. It can deftly pick up a single small bean with its tongue.
name: Lickilicky

description: When it's happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
name: Glameow

description: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.
name: Purugly

description: Their fluffy fur absorbs damage, even if they strike foes with a fierce headbutt.
name: Bouffalant

description: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.
name: Drampa

description: The beaks of birds can't begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.
name: Spewpa

description: Through its horns, it can pick up on the emotions of creatures around it. Positive emotions are the source of its strength.
name: Indeedee

description: Shuffle your hand into your deck. Then, draw 4 cards. If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out during your opponent's last turn, draw 7 cards instead.
name: Bruno

description: Search your deck for a card and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck. Your turn ends.
name: Camping Gear

description: Heal all damage from each of your Evolution Pokémon. If you do, discard all Energy from the Pokémon that were healed in this way.
name: Cheryl

description: Shuffle up to 5 basic Energy cards from your discard pile into your deck.
name: Energy Recycler

description: Each player switches their Active Pokémon with 1 of their Benched Pokémon. Your opponent switches first. (If a player does not have a Benched Pokémon, they don't switch Pokémon.)
name: Escape Rope

description: When your Active Pokémon is Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon, you may move a basic Energy from that Pokémon to the Pokémon this card is attached to.
name: Exp. Share

description: Put a Special Energy attached to 1 of your opponent's Pokémon on the bottom of their deck.
name: Fan of Waves

description: Draw cards until you have 6 cards in your hand.
name: Korrina's Focus

description: Search your deck for a Pokémon with 90 HP or less, reveal it, and put it into your hand. Then, shuffle your deck.
name: Level Ball

name: Welcoming Lantern

description: According to legends, it was hatched from a flaming cocoon to save people and Pokémon that were suffering from the cold.
name: Volcarona

description: It has special pads on the backs of its feet, and one on its nose. Once it's raring to fight, these pads radiate tremendous heat.
name: Scorbunny

description: It kicks berries right off the branches of trees and then juggles them with its feet, practicing its footwork.
name: Raboot

description: It's skilled at both offense and defense, and it gets pumped up when cheered on. But if it starts showboating, it could put itself in a tough spot.
name: Cinderace

description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.
name: Lapras

description: May appear in a swarm. Flies at violent speeds, all the while stabbing with the toxic stinger on its rear.
name: Beedrill

description: It has a cunning yet savage disposition. It waits for parents to leave their nests, and then it sneaks in to steal their eggs.
name: Sneasel

description: With its claws, it leaves behind signs for its friends to find. The number of distinct signs is said to be over 500.
name: Weavile

description: It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it's always scrounging around for more food.
name: Delibird

description: This is Castform's form when pelted by rain. In an experiment where it was placed in a shower, this Pokémon didn't change to this form.
name: Castform Rainy Form

description: This is Castform's form when caught in a hailstorm. Its whole body is chilled, and its skin is partially frozen!
name: Castform Snowy Form

description: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as −150 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Snorunt

description: It spits out cold air of nearly −60 degrees Fahrenheit to freeze its quarry. It brings frozen prey back to its lair and neatly lines them up.
name: Froslass

description: Its body is covered in fluffy fur. The fur keeps it from feeling cold while it is rolling on ice.
name: Spheal

description: Be it Spheal or a Poké Ball, it will spin any round object on its nose with the greatest of ease.
name: Sealeo

description: It shatters drift ice with its strong tusks. Its thick layer of blubber repels enemy attacks.
name: Walrein

description: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.
name: Ledyba

description: Although it's called a guardian deity, terrible calamities sometimes befall those who recklessly approach Tapu Fini.
name: Tapu Fini

description: When it gets wet, its skin changes color, and this Pokémon becomes invisible as if it were camouflaged.
name: Sobble

description: Highly intelligent but also very lazy, it keeps enemies out of its territory by laying traps everywhere.
name: Drizzile

description: Its nictitating membranes let it pick out foes' weak points so it can precisely blast them with water that shoots from its fingertips at Mach 3.
name: Inteleon

description: This form of Urshifu is a strong believer in defeating foes by raining many blows down on them. Its strikes are nonstop, flowing like a river.
name: Rapid Strike Urshifu

description: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.
name: Mareep

description: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.
name: Flaaffy

description: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.
name: Ampharos

description: It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.
name: Ledian

description: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
name: Blitzle

description: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
name: Zebstrika

description: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.
name: Thundurus

description: Because Galarian Slowpoke eat the seeds of a plant that grows only in Galar, their tails have developed a spicy flavor.
name: Galarian Slowpoke

description: With its gas-like body, it can sneak into any place it desires. However, it can be blown away by wind.
name: Gastly

description: If you get the feeling of being watched in darkness when nobody is around, Haunter is there.
name: Haunter

description: It is said to emerge from darkness to steal the lives of those who become lost in mountains.
name: Gengar

description: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.
name: Ralts

description: It roams through forests searching for sweet nectar. Although it boasts fantastic physical strength, it's not that good at flying.
name: Heracross

description: It has a psychic power that enables it to distort the space around it and see into the future.
name: Kirlia

description: To protect its Trainer, it will expend all its psychic power to create a small black hole.
name: Gardevoir

description: There's a proverb that says, "Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk."
name: Shuppet

description: Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.
name: Banette

description: Those who sleep holding Cresselia's feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
name: Cresselia

description: This Pokémon was created from clay. It received orders from its master many thousands of years ago, and it still follows those orders to this day.
name: Golett

description: There's a theory that inside Golurk is a perpetual motion machine that produces limitless energy, but this belief hasn't been proven.
name: Golurk

description: The sweet smell of cotton candy perfumes Swirlix's fluffy fur. This Pokémon spits out sticky string to tangle up its enemies.
name: Swirlix

description: Slurpuff's fur contains a lot of air, making it soft to the touch and lighter than it looks.
name: Slurpuff

description: By exposing foes to the blinking of its luminescent spots, Inkay demoralizes them, and then it seizes the chance to flee.
name: Inkay

description: It's said that Malamar's hypnotic powers played a role in certain history-changing events.
name: Malamar

description: If this Pokémon senses a strong emotion, it will run away as fast as it can. It prefers areas without people.
name: Hatenna

description: Using the braids on its head, it pummels foes to get them to quiet down. One blow from those braids would knock out a professional boxer.
name: Hattrem

description: If you're too loud around it, you risk being torn apart by the claws on its tentacle. This Pokémon is also known as the Forest Witch.
name: Hatterene

description: It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
name: Diglett

description: These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it's like underground.
name: Dugtrio

description: The stalks of leeks are thicker and longer in the Galar region. Farfetch'd that adapted to these stalks took on a unique form.
name: Galarian Farfetch'd

description: After deflecting attacks with its hard leaf shield, it strikes back with its sharp leek stalk. The leek stalk is both weapon and food.
name: Galarian Sirfetch'd

description: Sharply attuned to others' wishes for help, this Pokémon seeks out those in need and aids them in battle.
name: Gallade

description: It's said that this Pokémon was formed when an ancient clay tablet was drawn to a vengeful spirit.
name: Galarian Yamask

description: Never touch its shadowlike body, or you'll be shown the horrific memories behind the picture carved into it.
name: Galarian Runerigus

description: Crabrawler has been known to mistake Exeggutor for a coconut tree and climb it. The enraged Exeggutor shakes it off and stomps it.
name: Crabrawler

description: Before it stops to think, it just starts pummeling. There are records of its turning back avalanches with a flurry of punches.
name: Crabominable

description: When it rubs the rocks on its neck against you, that's proof of its love for you. However, the rocks are sharp, so the gesture is quite painful!
name: Rockruff

description: They live alone without forming packs. They will only listen to orders from Trainers who can draw out their true power.
name: Lycanroc

description: Passimian live in groups of about 20, with each member performing an assigned role. Through cooperation, the group survives.
name: Passimian

description: The berries that grow around its belly are like ice pops. Galarian Darumaka absolutely love these berries.
name: Snover

description: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.
name: Clobbopus

description: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.
name: Grapploct

description: If Kubfu pulls the long white hair on its head, its fighting spirit heightens and power wells up from the depths of its belly.
name: Kubfu

description: It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.
name: Koffing

description: Very rarely, a sudden mutation can result in two small Koffing twins becoming conjoined as a Weezing.
name: Weezing

description: Long ago, during a time when droves of factories fouled the air with pollution, Weezing changed into this form for some reason.
name: Galarian Weezing

description: While chanting strange spells, this Pokémon combines its internal toxins with what it's eaten, creating strange potions.
name: Galarian Slowking

description: Although it's tough, it can't handle cold well. When night falls, it buries itself in leafage and sleeps.
name: Pinsir

description: It's well liked by other Pokémon because of its beauty. The flower on its head needs constant care, or it will soon wither and rot.
name: Lilligant

description: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.
name: Zorua

description: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.
name: Zoroark

description: Cunning and cautious, this Pokémon survives by stealing food from others. It erases its tracks with swipes of its tail as it makes off with its plunder.
name: Nickit

description: With a lithe body and sharp claws, it goes around stealing food and eggs. Boltund is its natural enemy.
name: Thievul

description: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.
name: Altaria

description: Some theories suggest that its behavior of forcefully bashing its head into things stimulates cells that affect its evolution.
name: Bagon

description: Shelgon lives deep within caves. It stays shut up in its hard shell, dreaming of the day it will be able to fly.
name: Shelgon

description: Thanks to its fervent wishes, the cells in its body finally mutated, and at last it has its heart's desire—wings.
name: Salamence

description: It first tries to find a rock to live in, but if there are no suitable rocks to be found, Dwebble may move in to the ports of a Hippowdon.
name: Dwebble

description: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
name: Dialga

description: Because it can't see, this Pokémon is constantly biting at everything it touches, trying to keep track of its surroundings.
name: Deino

description: Their two heads will fight each other over a single piece of food. Zweilous are covered in scars even without battling others.
name: Zweilous

description: The three heads take turns sinking their teeth into the opponent. Their attacks won't slow until their target goes down.
name: Hydreigon

description: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.
name: Kyurem

description: Some say it can change to an even more powerful form when battling those who threaten the ecosystem.
name: Zygarde

description: Drampa is a kind and friendly Pokémon—up until it's angered. When that happens, it stirs up a gale and flattens everything around.
name: Drampa

description: Its thick claws are its greatest weapons. They're mighty enough to crack Rhyperior's carapace.
name: Crustle

description: It flies on wings of apple skin and spits a powerful acid. It can also change its shape into that of an apple.
name: Flapple

description: Its body is covered in sweet nectar, and the skin on its back is especially yummy. Children used to have it as a snack.
name: Appletun

description: Its body is composed of crystallized dragon energy. Regidrago is said to have the powers of every dragon Pokémon.
name: Regidrago

description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.
name: Eevee

description: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.
name: Teddiursa

description: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.
name: Ursaring

description: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.
name: Smeargle

description: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.
name: Slakoth

description: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.
name: Vigoroth

description: It is the world's most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.
name: Slaking

description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.
name: Swablu

description: This Pokémon is popular with beginners because it's intelligent, obedient to its Trainer's commands, and easy to raise.
name: Lillipup

description: It has been living with people for so long that portrayals of it can be found on the walls of caves from long, long ago.
name: Herdier

description: Its fur is long and thick. A long time ago in cold regions, every household kept a Stoutland.
name: Stoutland

description: A combative Pokémon, it's ready to pick a fight with anyone. It has talons that can crush hard berries.
name: Rufflet

description: Because this Pokémon is hotheaded and belligerent, it's Corviknight that's taken the role of transportation in Galar.
name: Braviary

description: Its body is always warm. Trainers who live in cold areas apparently sleep with it in their bed.
name: Fletchling

description: Its speed right after takeoff already puts it in the top speed class of all bird Pokémon.
name: Fletchinder

description: Bird Pokémon make up most of its diet. It approaches at high speeds and smacks them down to the ground with its powerful kick.
name: Talonflame

name: Gossifleur

name: Lucky Ice Pop

name: Entei

name: Victini

name: Pyroar
