name: Turffield Stadium

description: It has been found that its brain cells are 10 times more active when Psyduck is experiencing a headache.
name: Psyduck

description: A professional swimmer, it can continue swimming for two days straight by waving its long tail skillfully.
name: Golduck

description: Its body is 99% water. The remaining 1% contains the organ that makes its poison.
name: Tentacool

description: It communicates with others of its kind by lighting up the red orbs on its head. When the orbs are blinking, it's a warning sign.
name: Tentacruel

description: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.
name: Skiploom

description: Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.
name: Lotad

description: It lives at the water's edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.
name: Lombre

description: If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.
name: Ludicolo

description: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.
name: Carvanha

description: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.
name: Sharpedo

description: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
name: Feebas

description: It's said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you're feeling.
name: Milotic

description: Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola's branches.
name: Luvdisc

description: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.
name: Jumpluff

description: It uses sound waves to communicate with others of its kind. People and other Pokémon species can't hear its cries of warning.
name: Tympole

description: They are composed of ice crystals. They capture prey with chains of ice, freezing the prey at -148 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Cryogonal

description: This Pokémon lives in areas of frigid cold. It secures itself to the back of an Avalugg by freezing its feet in place.
name: Bergmite

description: As Avalugg moves about during the day, the cracks in its body deepen. The Pokémon's body returns to a pristine state overnight.
name: Avalugg

description: When it senses danger, its eyes tear up. The sparkle of its tears signals other Wishiwashi to gather.
name: Wishiwashi

description: This Pokémon keeps its heat-sensitive head cool with ice. It fishes for its food, dangling its single hair into the sea to lure in prey.
name: Eiscue

description: When Pikachu meet, they'll touch their tails together and exchange electricity through them as a form of greeting.
name: Pikachu

description: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.
name: Seedot

description: If its electric pouches run empty, it raises its tail to gather electricity from the atmosphere.
name: Raichu

description: On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
name: Chinchou

description: This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.
name: Lanturn

description: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You'll want to pet it because it's cute, but if you use your bare hand, you'll get a painful shock.
name: Mareep

description: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.
name: Flaaffy

description: Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.
name: Ampharos

description: As it flies, it scatters electricity around, so bird Pokémon keep their distance. That's why Emolga can keep all its food to itself.
name: Emolga

description: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.
name: Tropius

description: Its entire body is made up of a single organ that generates electrical energy. Regieleki is capable of creating all Galar's electricity.
name: Regieleki

description: It puts its prey to sleep and devours their dreams. It seems that bad dreams taste sour, so Drowzee doesn't particularly like eating them.
name: Drowzee

description: There are some Hypno that assist doctors with patients who can't sleep at night in hospitals.
name: Hypno

description: Known as Articuno, this Pokémon fires beams that can immobilize opponents as if they had been frozen solid.
name: Galarian Articuno

description: To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.
name: Wobbuffet

description: It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.
name: Sableye

description: It emits ultrasonic waves as it flutters about, searching for its prey—bug Pokémon.
name: Woobat

description: The auspicious shape of this Pokémon's nose apparently led some regions to consider Swoobat a symbol of good luck.
name: Swoobat

description: Flabébé wears a crown made from pollen it's collected from its flower. The crown has hidden healing properties.
name: Flabébé

description: It gives its own power to flowers, pouring its heart into caring for them. Floette never forgives anyone who messes up a flower bed.
name: Floette

description: Its life can span several hundred years. It's said to devote its entire life to protecting gardens.
name: Florges

description: The light that streams out from the holes in the pumpkin can hypnotize and control the people and Pokémon that see it.
name: Pumpkaboo

description: In the darkness of a new-moon night, Gourgeist will come knocking. Whoever answers the door will be swept off to the afterlife.
name: Gourgeist

description: An opponent's aura can tell Cutiefly what that opponent's next move will be. Then Cutiefly can glide around the attack and strike back.
name: Cutiefly

description: Ribombee absolutely hate getting wet or rained on. In the cloudy Galar region, they are very seldom seen.
name: Ribombee

description: It sinks into the shadows of people and Pokémon, where it can understand their feelings and copy their capabilities.
name: Marshadow

description: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
name: Hitmonchan

description: One kick from its powerful legs will pulverize a dump truck. Supposedly, this Pokémon runs through the mountains at over 180 mph.
name: Galarian Zapdos

description: This Pokémon is active during the day and passes the cold desert nights burrowed snugly into the sand.
name: Hippopotas

description: When roused to violence by its rage, it spews out the quantities of sand it has swallowed and whips up a sandstorm.
name: Hippowdon

description: When it detects a noise, it starts to move. The energy core inside it makes this Pokémon slightly warm to the touch.
name: Roggenrola

description: It relies on sound in order to monitor what's in its vicinity. When angered, it will attack without ever changing the direction it's facing.
name: Boldore

description: Although its energy blasts can blow away a dump truck, they have a limitation— they can only be fired when the sun is out.
name: Gigalith

description: On occasion, their cries are sublimely pleasing to the ear. Palpitoad with larger lumps on their bodies can sing with a wider range of sounds.
name: Palpitoad

description: They prefer clean water and soil. When the environment they live in turns bad, the whole bunch will up and move to a new area.
name: Petilil

description: This Pokémon is popular among the elderly, who say the vibrations of its lumps are great for massages.
name: Seismitoad

description: The sinister aura that blazes like molten fire around this Pokémon is what inspired the name Moltres.
name: Galarian Moltres

description: They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf's grass flute fills listeners with dread.
name: Nuzleaf

description: It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.
name: Shiftry

description: It protects itself with its durable skin. It's thought that this Pokémon will evolve once its skin has completely stretched out.
name: Scraggy

description: While mostly known for having the temperament of an aggressive ruffian, this Pokémon takes very good care of its family, friends, and territory.
name: Scrafty

description: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
name: Caterpie

description: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
name: Swadloon

description: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.
name: Charjabug

description: If it carries a Charjabug to use as a spare battery, a flying Vikavolt can rapidly fire high-powered beams of electricity.
name: Vikavolt

description: It approaches its enemies at the speed of lightning, then tears them limb from limb with its sharp claws.
name: Zeraora

description: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.
name: Toxel

description: It manipulates the chemical makeup of its poison to produce electricity. The voltage is weak, but it can cause a tingling paralysis.
name: Toxel

description: This short-tempered and aggressive Pokémon chugs stagnant water to absorb any toxins it might contain.
name: Toxtricity

description: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.
name: Toxtricity

description: It carries electrically roasted seeds with it as if they're precious treasures. No matter how much it eats, it always gets hungry again in short order.
name: Morpeko

description: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
name: Leavanny

description: The songs they sing are totally different depending on the region they live in. Some even sound like they're shouting!
name: Jigglypuff

description: When it gets angry, it inhales with all its might, and its body gradually inflates. Sometimes they can grow 20 times larger!
name: Wigglytuff

description: Its strange cries sound like human language. There are some musicians who compose songs for Jynx to sing.
name: Jynx

description: In contrast to its appearance, it's quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.
name: Snubbull

description: Although it's popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it's totally incompetent as a watchdog.
name: Granbull

description: Sudden climate change wiped out this ancient kind of Corsola. This Pokémon absorbs others' life-force through its branches.
name: Galarian Corsola

description: Be cautious of the ectoplasmic body surrounding its soul. You'll become stiff as stone if you touch it.
name: Galarian Cursola

description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.
name: Mawile

description: Once each year, this Pokémon scatters its seeds. They're jam-packed with nutrients, making them a precious food source out in the desert.
name: Maractus

description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.
name: Deoxys

description: It eats dreams and releases mist. The mist is pink when it's eating a good dream, and black when it's eating a nightmare.
name: Munna

description: It drowses and dreams all the time. It's best to leave it be if it's just woken up, as it's a terrible grump when freshly roused from sleep.
name: Musharna

description: A discovery was made in the desert where Sigilyph fly. The ruins of what may have been an ancient city were found beneath the sands.
name: Sigilyph

description: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
name: Meloetta

description: If you build sand mounds when you're playing, destroy them before you go home, or they may get possessed and become Sandygast.
name: Sandygast

description: Once it has whipped up a sandstorm to halt its opponents in their tracks, this terrifying Pokémon snatches away their vitality.
name: Palossand

description: They diligently serve people and Pokémon so they can gather feelings of gratitude. The females are particularly good at babysitting.
name: Indeedee

description: If this weak Pokémon is by itself, a mere child could defeat it. But if Dreepy has friends to help it train, it can evolve and become much stronger.
name: Dreepy

description: Without a Dreepy to place on its head and care for, it gets so uneasy it'll try to substitute any Pokémon it finds for the missing Dreepy.
name: Drakloak

description: It has a strange physiology that responds to electricity. When together with Karrablast, Shelmet evolves for some reason.
name: Shelmet

description: Apparently the Dreepy inside Dragapult's horns eagerly look forward to being launched out at Mach speeds.
name: Dragapult

description: When its skin gets wrinkled from moisture, it heads for a volcano. It lies flat on a spot with a lot of geothermal heat and dries itself out.
name: Sandshrew

description: Thanks to its thick claws, it's good at climbing trees. There are plenty of Sandslash that park themselves in trees and go right to sleep.
name: Sandslash

description: If one gets angry, all the others around it will get angry, so silence is a rare visitor in a troop of Mankey.
name: Mankey

description: The blood vessels in its brain are sturdier than those of other Pokémon, so it can stay healthy despite its constant raging.
name: Primeape

description: It uses both hands to climb precipitous cliffs. People who see it in action have been known to take up bouldering.
name: Geodude

description: It travels by rolling down cliffs. If it falls into a river, it will explode with its last gasp.
name: Graveler

description: It detonates its own body. The power from that explosion can propel it up steep mountain paths with amazing speed.
name: Golem

description: It rapidly bores through the ground at 50 mph by squirming and twisting its massive, rugged body.
name: Onix

description: It is thought its body transformed as a result of iron accumulating internally from swallowing soil.
name: Steelix

description: Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in bands of membrane.
name: Accelgor

description: It flies straight at its target's face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.
name: Gligar

description: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.
name: Gliscor

description: There's a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.
name: Makuhita

description: Hariyama that are big and fat aren't necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.
name: Hariyama

description: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.
name: Baltoy

description: It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.
name: Claydol

description: It's a digger, using its claws to burrow through the ground. It causes damage to vegetable crops, so many farmers have little love for it.
name: Drilbur

description: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.
name: Landorus

description: Wanting to make sure it's taken seriously, Pancham's always giving others a glare. But if it's not focusing, it ends up smiling.
name: Pancham

description: Legends say this Pokémon confounded opponents with its swift movements.
name: Virizion

description: The way it protects itself by flailing its arms may be an adorable sight, but stay well away. This is flailing that can snap thick tree trunks.
name: Stufful

description: The moves it uses to take down its prey would make a martial artist jealous. It tucks subdued prey under its arms to carry them to its nest.
name: Bewear

description: Its tentacles tear off easily, but it isn't alarmed when that happens—it knows they'll grow back. It's about as smart as a three-year-old.
name: Clobbopus

description: Searching for an opponent to test its skills against, it emerges onto land. Once the battle is over, it returns to the sea.
name: Grapploct

description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.
name: Falinks

description: The six of them work together as one Pokémon. Teamwork is also their battle strategy, and they constantly change their formation as they fight.
name: Falinks

description: Thought to be the oldest form of Zigzagoon, it moves in zigzags and wreaks havoc upon its surroundings.
name: Galarian Zigzagoon

description: With a voice like a human child's, it cries out to lure adults deep into the forest, getting them lost among the trees.
name: Phantump

description: This very aggressive Pokémon will recklessly challenge opponents stronger than itself.
name: Galarian Linoone

description: It evolved after experiencing numerous fights. While crossing its arms, it lets out a shout that would make any opponent flinch.
name: Galarian Obstagoon

description: With its sturdy jaws and fangs, it can easily chomp wooden boats to splinters. It fights with Basculin over food.
name: Carvanha

description: It drinks in seawater and jets it from its rear to propel itself. It's very sensitive to the scent of blood.
name: Sharpedo

description: The elderly call it the disaster Pokémon and detest it, but interest in its power to predict disasters is on the rise.
name: Absol

description: Once diluted, its poison becomes medicinal. This Pokémon came into popularity after a pharmaceutical company chose it as a mascot.
name: Croagunk

description: It booms out a victory croak when its prey goes down in defeat. This Pokémon and Seismitoad are related species.
name: Toxicroak

description: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
name: Darkrai

description: This Pokémon was born from a bag stuffed with trash. Galarian Weezing relish the fumes belched by Trubbish.
name: Trubbish

description: The toxic liquid it launches from its right arm is so virulent that it can kill a weakened creature instantly.
name: Garbodor

description: Small roots that extend from the tips of this Pokémon's feet can tie into the trees of the forest and give Trevenant control over them.
name: Trevenant

description: If a normally talkative child suddenly stops talking, it may have been replaced by Zorua.
name: Zorua

description: If it thinks humans are going to discover its den, Zoroark shows them visions that make them wander around in the woods.
name: Zoroark

description: Vullaby grow quickly. Bones that have gotten too small for older Vullaby to wear often get passed down to younger ones in the nest.
name: Vullaby

description: They adorn themselves with bones. There seem to be fashion trends among them, as different bones come into and fall out of popularity.
name: Mandibuzz

description: Using its leaf, Pangoro can predict the moves of its opponents. It strikes with punches that can turn a dump truck into scrap with just one hit.
name: Pangoro

description: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
name: Yveltal

description: It sneaks into people's homes, stealing things and feasting on the negative energy of the frustrated occupants.
name: Impidimp

description: With sly cunning, it tries to lure people into the woods. Some believe it to have the power to make crops grow.
name: Morgrem

description: Its hairs work like muscle fibers. When its hairs unfurl, they latch on to opponents, ensnaring them as tentacles would.
name: Grimmsnarl

description: Hunger hormones affect its temperament. Until its hunger is appeased, it gets up to all manner of evil deeds.
name: Morpeko

description: It uses its big jaws to dig nests into the forest floor, and it loves to feed on sweet tree sap.
name: Grubbin

description: These daring Pokémon have coins on their foreheads. Darker coins are harder, and harder coins garner more respect among Meowth.
name: Galarian Meowth

description: After many battles, it evolved dangerous claws that come together to form daggers when extended.
name: Galarian Perrserker

description: Its body is draped in steel armor. It looks heavy, but it can fly at speeds of up to 185 miles an hour!
name: Skarmory

description: Known as the Drill King, this Pokémon can tunnel through the terrain at speeds of over 90 mph.
name: Excadrill

description: With their large mandibles, these Pokémon can crunch their way through rock. They work together to protect their eggs from Sandaconda.
name: Durant

description: Long ago it lived in mines, but once the minerals that make up its diet became scarcer, Klefki began appearing in human settlements.
name: Klefki

description: When it's in trouble, it curls up into a ball, makes its fur spikes stand on end, and then discharges electricity indiscriminately.
name: Togedemaru

description: It melts particles of iron and other metals found in the subsoil, so it can absorb them into its body of molten steel.
name: Meltan

description: Revered long ago for its capacity to create iron from nothing, for some reason it has come back to life after 3,000 years.
name: Melmetal

description: Dewpider normally lives underwater. When it comes onto land in search of food, it takes water with it in the form of a bubble on its head.
name: Dewpider

description: With their great intellect and flying skills, these Pokémon very successfully act as the Galar region's airborne taxi service.
name: Corviknight

description: If a job requires serious strength, this Pokémon will excel at it. Its copper body tarnishes in the rain, turning a vibrant green color.
name: Cufant

description: These Pokémon live in herds. Their trunks have incredible grip strength, strong enough to crush giant rocks into powder.
name: Copperajah

description: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.
name: Latias

description: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.
name: Latios

description: Their horns are powerful sensors. As soon as Goomy pick up any sign of enemies, they go into hiding. This is how they've survived.
name: Goomy

description: The lump on its back contains its tiny brain. It thinks only of food and escaping its enemies.
name: Sliggoo

description: Its form of offense is forcefully stretching out its horns. The strikes land 100 times harder than any blow from a heavyweight boxer.
name: Goodra

description: Eating sulfur in its volcanic habitat is what causes explosive compounds to develop in its shell. Its droppings are also dangerously explosive.
name: Turtonator

description: It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn't get along with Galarian Meowth.
name: Meowth

description: Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can't withstand a harsh attack.
name: Metapod

description: It acts as a caretaker for Dewpider, putting them inside its bubble and letting them eat any leftover food.
name: Araquanid

description: Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.
name: Persian

description: Because the eggs on their bellies have been overharvested by people in the past, the Chansey population remains very small.
name: Chansey

description: This Pokémon is overflowing with love. Only Chansey that share a strong bond with their Trainer can evolve, so people say.
name: Blissey

description: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.
name: Kangaskhan

description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.
name: Eevee

description: This Pokémon's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.
name: Snorlax

description: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.
name: Dunsparce

description: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.
name: Stantler

description: It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.
name: Smeargle

description: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.
name: Skitty

description: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
name: Delcatty

description: The reason it keeps one ear rolled up is so it can launch a swift counterattack if it's attacked by an enemy.
name: Buneary

description: It's notably wary and has a dislike of fighting, but at the same time, it can deliver powerful kicks with its lithe legs.
name: Lopunny

description: It's very sensitive to danger. The sound of Corviknight's flapping will have Bunnelby digging a hole to hide underground in moments.
name: Bunnelby

description: The fur on its belly retains heat exceptionally well. People used to make heavy winter clothing from fur shed by this Pokémon.
name: Diggersby

description: It always strikes a pose before going for its finishing move. Sometimes opponents take advantage of that time to counterattack.
name: Hawlucha

description: Jumping nimbly about, this small-bodied Pokémon takes advantage of even the slightest opportunity to disorient larger opponents.
name: Rookidee

description: The lessons of many harsh battles have taught it how to accurately judge an opponent's strength.
name: Corvisquire

description: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.
name: Wooloo

description: If its fleece grows too long, Wooloo won't be able to move. Cloth made with the wool of this Pokémon is surprisingly strong.
name: Wooloo

description: Its majestic horns are meant only to impress the opposite gender. They never see use in battle.
name: Dubwool

name: Vulpix

description: It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.
name: Flaaffy

description: Once during each player's turn, that player may put a basic Energy card from their discard pile into their hand.
name: Training Court

name: Vulpix

description: It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
name: Butterfree

description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.
name: Ninetales

description: Very smart and very vengeful. Grabbing one of its many tails could result in a 1,000-year curse.
name: Ninetales

description: Extremely loyal, it will fearlessly bark at any opponent to protect its own Trainer from harm.
name: Growlithe

description: A Pokémon that has long been admired for its beauty. It runs agilely as if on wings.
name: Arcanine

description: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn't keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
name: Slugma

description: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.
name: Magcargo

description: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being's entire body will be overflowing with power.
name: Victini

description: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Pansear

description: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
name: Simisear

description: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
name: Shroomish

description: A flame serves as its tongue, melting through the hard shell of Durant so that Heatmor can devour their insides.
name: Heatmor

description: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.
name: Oricorio

description: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
name: Sizzlipede

description: It wraps prey up with its heated body, cooking them in its coils. Once they're well-done, it will voraciously nibble them down to the last morsel.
name: Sizzlipede

description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.
name: Centiskorch

description: While its burning body is already dangerous on its own, this excessively hostile Pokémon also has large and very sharp fangs.
name: Centiskorch

description: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.
name: Breloom

description: Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
name: Shellder

description: Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.
name: Cloyster

description: No number of injuries can bother Staryu. Its amazing regenerative powers return it to its previous state in half a day!
name: Staryu

description: It rotates its geometrically shaped body to swim through the water. It always seems to be sending out mysterious radio waves.
name: Starmie

description: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.
name: Lapras

description: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.
name: Totodile

description: Once it bites down, it won't let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.
name: Croconaw

description: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
name: Feraligatr

description: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That's why this Pokémon is never cold.
name: Marill

description: The bubble-like pattern on its stomach helps it camouflage itself when it's in the water.
name: Azumarill

description: The small spikes covering its body developed from scales. They inject a toxin that causes fainting.
name: Qwilfish

description: As it majestically swims, it doesn't care if Remoraid attach to it to scavenge for its leftovers.
name: Mantine

description: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
name: Mudkip

description: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.
name: Marshtomp

description: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
name: Swampert

description: Clamperl's pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder's pearls.
name: Clamperl

description: Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.
name: Huntail

description: It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.
name: Gorebyss

description: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
name: Panpour

description: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
name: Simipour

description: It's good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It's kind enough to share them with friends.
name: Pansage

description: Known for their violence, these Pokémon have the most fights with schools of red-striped Basculin.
name: Basculin

description: The colder they get, the more energetic they are. They freeze their breath to make snowballs, using them as ammo for playful snowball fights.
name: Galarian Darumaka

description: Though it has a gentle disposition, it's also very strong. It will quickly freeze the snowball on its head before going for a headbutt.
name: Galarian Darmanitan

description: It moves around by jetting water from its right pincer. It has a poor sense of balance, so it's terrible at swimming straight.
name: Clauncher

description: Its right arm is packed with meat. When its pincer falls off, it's exported to be used as a cooking ingredient.
name: Clawitzer

description: It's covered in a slime that keeps its skin moist, allowing it to stay on land for days without drying up.
name: Pyukumuku

description: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
name: Simisage

description: It starts off battles by attacking with its rock-hard horn, but as soon as the opponent flinches, this Pokémon bites down and never lets go.
name: Chewtle

description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
name: Drednaw

description: After it's eaten its fill, its movements become extremely sluggish. That's when Cramorant swallows it up.
name: Arrokuda

description: It spins its tail fins to propel itself, surging forward at speeds of over 100 knots before ramming prey and spearing into them.
name: Barraskewda

description: It eats snow that piles up on the ground. The more snow it eats, the bigger and more impressive the spikes on its back grow.
name: Snom

description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
name: Frosmoth

description: Usually found in power plants. Easily mistaken for a Poké Ball, it has zapped many people.
name: Voltorb

description: It stores an overflowing amount of electric energy inside its body. Even a small shock makes it explode.
name: Electrode

description: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.
name: Plusle

description: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
name: Sewaddle

description: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
name: Minun

description: All of its fur dazzles if danger is sensed. It flees while the foe is momentarily blinded.
name: Shinx

description: Strong electricity courses through the tips of its sharp claws. A light scratch causes fainting in foes.
name: Luxio

description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.
name: Luxray

description: With a body made of plasma, it can inhabit all sorts of machines. It loves to surprise others.
name: Rotom

description: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.
name: Tynamo

description: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
name: Eelektrik

description: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
name: Eelektross

description: The sun powers this Pokémon's electricity generation. Interruption of that process stresses Helioptile to the point of weakness.
name: Helioptile

description: One Heliolisk basking in the sun with its frill outspread is all it would take to produce enough electricity to power a city.
name: Heliolisk

description: Though it may look like it's just a bunch of eggs, it's a proper Pokémon. Exeggcute communicates with others of its kind via telepathy, apparently.
name: Exeggcute

description: Each of Exeggutor's three heads is thinking different thoughts. The three don't seem to be very interested in one another.
name: Exeggutor

description: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
name: Shroomish

description: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.
name: Breloom

description: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.
name: Tropius

description: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.
name: Turtwig

description: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
name: Grotle

description: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
name: Torterra

description: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.
name: Burmy

description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.
name: Wormadam

description: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.
name: Mothim

description: The deeper a Cherubi's red, the more nutrients it has stockpiled in its body. And the sweeter and tastier its small ball!
name: Cherubi

description: Its strange physiology reacts to electrical energy in interesting ways. The presence of a Shelmet will cause this Pokémon to evolve.
name: Karrablast

description: Magmar dispatches its prey with fire. But it regrets this habit once it realizes that it has burned its intended prey to a charred crisp.
name: Magmar

description: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Magmortar

description: It's one of the legendary bird Pokémon. When Moltres flaps its flaming wings, they glimmer with a dazzling red glow.
name: Moltres

description: It burns coal inside its shell for energy. It blows out black soot if it is endangered.
name: Torkoal

description: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.
name: Chimchar

description: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.
name: Monferno

description: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.
name: Infernape

description: If you visit a beach at the end of summer, you'll be able to see groups of Staryu lighting up in a steady rhythm.
name: Staryu

description: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.
name: Lapras

description: No matter how dirty the water in the river, it will adapt and thrive. It has a strong will to survive.
name: Corphish

description: A rough customer that wildly flails its giant claws. It is said to be extremely hard to raise.
name: Crawdaunt

description: It can only survive in cold areas. It bounces happily around, even in environments as cold as -150 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Snorunt

description: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
name: Piplup

description: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.
name: Prinplup

description: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
name: Empoleon

description: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.
name: Buizel

description: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.
name: Floatzel

description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.
name: Manaphy

description: When this Pokémon is in good health, its snot becomes thicker and stickier. It will smear its snot on anyone it doesn't like.
name: Cubchoo

description: It swims through frigid seas, searching for prey. From its frozen breath, it forms icy fangs that are harder than steel.
name: Beartic

description: The hair on its head connects to the surface of its brain. When this Pokémon has something on its mind, its hair chills the air around it.
name: Eiscue

description: Many power plants keep Ground-type Pokémon around as a defense against Electabuzz that come seeking electricity.
name: Electabuzz

description: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.
name: Electivire

description: This Pokémon generates electricity by contracting its muscles. Excited trembling is a sign that Shinx is generating a tremendous amount of electricity.
name: Shinx

description: By joining its tail with that of another Luxio, this Pokémon can receive some of the other Luxio's electricity and power up its own electric blasts.
name: Luxio

description: Luxray can see through solid objects. It will instantly spot prey trying to hide behind walls, even if the walls are thick.
name: Luxray

description: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
name: Pachirisu

description: It is said that happiness will come to those who see a gathering of Clefairy dancing under a full moon.
name: Clefairy

description: A timid fairy Pokémon that is rarely seen, it will run and hide the moment it senses people.
name: Clefable

description: This Pokémon has an organ known as its core. The organ glows in seven colors when Starmie is unleashing its potent psychic powers.
name: Starmie

description: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.
name: Mewtwo

description: It moves while spinning around on its single foot. Some Baltoy have been seen spinning on their heads.
name: Baltoy

description: This mysterious Pokémon started life as an ancient clay figurine made over 20,000 years ago.
name: Claydol

description: If it finds bad children who won't listen to their parents, it will spirit them away—or so it's said.
name: Duskull

description: Its body is entirely hollow. When it opens its mouth, it sucks everything in as if it were a black hole.
name: Dusclops

description: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.
name: Dusknoir

description: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.
name: Chimecho

description: Psychic power allows these Pokémon to fly. Some say they were the guardians of an ancient city. Others say they were the guardians' emissaries.
name: Sigilyph

description: Since Dedenne can't generate as much electricity on its own, it steals electricity from outlets or other electric Pokémon.
name: Dedenne

description: They say that any patisserie visited by Milcery is guaranteed success and good fortune.
name: Milcery

description: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
name: Alcremie

description: It launches kicks while spinning. If it spins at high speed, it may bore its way into the ground.
name: Hitmontop

description: It hunts without twitching a muscle by pulling in its prey with powerful magnetism. But sometimes it pulls natural enemies in close.
name: Nosepass

description: Its nest is a sloped, bowl-like pit in the desert. Once something has fallen in, there is no escape.
name: Trapinch

description: The ultrasonic waves it generates by rubbing its two wings together cause severe headaches.
name: Vibrava

description: This Pokémon hides in the heart of sandstorms it creates and seldom appears where people can see it.
name: Flygon

description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.
name: Wormadam

description: It's exceedingly energetic, with enough stamina to keep running all through the night. Taking it for walks can be a challenging experience.
name: Riolu

description: It controls waves known as auras, which are powerful enough to pulverize huge rocks. It uses these waves to take down its prey.
name: Lucario

description: It performs throwing moves with first-rate skill. Over the course of many battles, Throh's belt grows darker as it absorbs its wearer's sweat.
name: Throh

description: If you see a Sawk training in the mountains in its single-minded pursuit of strength, it's best to quietly pass by.
name: Sawk

description: They were sculpted from clay in ancient times. No one knows why, but some of them are driven to continually line up boulders.
name: Golett

description: Artillery platforms built into the walls of ancient castles served as perches from which Golurk could fire energy beams.
name: Golurk

description: The wastewater coming from factories is clean these days, so Grimer have nothing to eat. They're said to be on the verge of extinction.
name: Grimer

description: Because they scatter germs everywhere, they've long been targeted for extermination, leading to a steep decline in their population.
name: Muk

description: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.
name: Sneasel

description: They attack their quarry in packs. Prey as large as Mamoswine easily fall to the teamwork of a group of Weavile.
name: Weavile

description: Exactly 108 spirits gathered to become this Pokémon. Apparently there are some ill-natured spirits in the mix.
name: Spiritomb

description: It steals things from people just to amuse itself with their frustration. A rivalry exists between this Pokémon and Nickit.
name: Purrloin

description: Don't be fooled by its gorgeous fur and elegant figure. This is a moody and vicious Pokémon.
name: Liepard

description: Through its nose, it sucks in the emanations produced by people and Pokémon when they feel annoyed. It thrives off this negative energy.
name: Impidimp

description: When it gets down on all fours as if to beg for forgiveness, it's trying to lure opponents in so that it can stab them with its spear-like hair.
name: Morgrem

description: With the hair wrapped around its body helping to enhance its muscles, this Pokémon can overwhelm even Machamp.
name: Grimmsnarl

description: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.
name: Wormadam

description: It uses three small units to catch prey and battle enemies. The main body mostly just gives orders.
name: Probopass

description: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.
name: Heatran

description: They use shells they've stolen from Shelmet to arm and protect themselves. They're very popular Pokémon in the Galar region.
name: Escavalier

description: The two minigears that compose this Pokémon are closer than twins. They mesh well only with each other.
name: Klink

description: When Klang goes all out, the minigear links up perfectly with the outer part of the big gear, and this Pokémon's rotation speed increases sharply.
name: Klang

description: From its spikes, it launches powerful blasts of electricity. Its red core contains an enormous amount of energy.
name: Klinklang

description: Gible prefers to stay in narrow holes in the sides of caves heated by geothermal energy. This way, Gible can stay warm even during a blizzard.
name: Gible

description: This Pokémon emits ultrasonic waves from a protrusion on either side of its head to probe pitch-dark caves.
name: Gabite

description: Garchomp makes its home in volcanic mountains. It flies through the sky as fast as a jet airplane, hunting down as much prey as it can.
name: Garchomp

description: These Pokémon nest in the ground and use their tusks to crush hard berries. Crushing berries is also how they test each other's strength.
name: Axew

description: After battle, this Pokémon carefully sharpens its tusks on river rocks. It needs to take care of its tusks—if one breaks, it will never grow back.
name: Fraxure

description: Its resilient tusks are its pride and joy. It licks up dirt to take in the minerals it needs to keep its tusks in top condition.
name: Haxorus

description: Druddigon are vicious and cunning. They take up residence in nests dug out by other Pokémon, treating the stolen nests as their own lairs.
name: Druddigon

description: The stalk this Pokémon carries in its wings serves as a sword to cut down opponents. In a dire situation, the stalk can also serve as food.
name: Farfetch'd

description: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform's disposition!
name: Castform

description: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.
name: Starly

description: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.
name: Staravia

description: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.
name: Staraptor

description: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.
name: Bidoof

description: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
name: Bibarel

description: The way it brushes away grime with its tail can be helpful when cleaning. But its focus on spotlessness can make cleaning more of a hassle.
name: Minccino

description: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.
name: Cinccino

description: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.
name: Tornadus

description: It drives its opponents to exhaustion with its agile maneuvers, then ends the fight with a flashy finishing move.
name: Hawlucha

name: Flareon

description: When Vaporeon's fins begin to vibrate, it is a sign that rain will come within a few hours.
name: Vaporeon

description: It traps enemies with its suction-cupped tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.
name: Octillery

description: If it is angered or startled, the fur all over its body bristles like sharp needles that pierce foes.
name: Jolteon

description: When the interior part of its tail spins like a motor, Zekrom can generate many bolts of lightning to blast its surroundings.
name: Zekrom

description: At the bidding of transmissions from the spirit world, it steals people and Pokémon away. No one knows whether it has a will of its own.
name: Dusknoir

name: Dedenne

description: When Alcremie is content, the cream it secretes from its hands becomes sweeter and richer.
name: Alcremie

description: It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.
name: Ariados

description: Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.
name: Houndoom

description: Thanks to its unstable genetic makeup, this special Pokémon conceals many different possible evolutions.
name: Eevee

description: It knows the forest inside and out. If it comes across a wounded Pokémon, Oranguru will gather medicinal herbs to treat it.
name: Oranguru

description: When it uses its special stick to strike up a beat, the sound waves produced carry revitalizing energy to the plants and flowers in the area.
name: Grookey

description: A warm-up of running around gets fire energy coursing through this Pokémon's body. Once that happens, it's ready to fight at full power.
name: Scorbunny

description: When scared, this Pokémon cries. Its tears pack the chemical punch of 100 onions, and attackers won't be able to resist weeping.
name: Sobble

description: By drumming, it taps into the power of its special tree stump. The roots of the stump follow its direction in battle.
name: Rillaboom

description: It shows no mercy to any who desecrate fields and mountains. It will fly around on its icy wings, causing a blizzard to chase offenders away.
name: Frosmoth

description: What appears to be an iron helmet is actually hardened hair. This Pokémon lives for the thrill of battle.
name: Galarian Perrserker

description: Its body secretes oil that this Pokémon spreads over its nest as a coating to protect it from dust. Cinccino won't tolerate even a speck of the stuff.
name: Cinccino

description: It anchors itself in the ground with its single leg, then basks in the sun. After absorbing enough sunlight, its petals spread as it blooms brilliantly.
name: Gossifleur

description: Its curly fleece is such an effective cushion that this Pokémon could fall off a cliff and stand right back up at the bottom, unharmed.
name: Wooloo

description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.
name: Morpeko

description: Its small horn hides a healing power. With a few rubs from this Pokémon's horn, any slight wound you have will be healed.
name: Galarian Ponyta

description: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
name: Pikachu

description: It ate a sour apple, and that induced its evolution. In its cheeks, it stores an acid capable of causing chemical burns.
name: Flapple

description: Luxray's ability to see through objects comes in handy when it's scouting for danger.
name: Luxray

description: It's usually peaceful, but the vandalism of mines enrages it. Offenders will be incinerated with flames that reach 2,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Coalossal

description: This Pokémon eats trash, which turns into poison inside its body. The main component of the poison depends on what sort of trash was eaten.
name: Garbodor

description: If it builds up enough speed swimming, it can jump out above the waves and glide for over 300 feet.
name: Mantine

description: When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.
name: Noctowl

description: Its body resembles polished metal, and it's both lightweight and strong. The only drawback is that it rusts easily.
name: Duraludon

description: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.
name: Rayquaza

description: As it eats the seeds stored up in its pocket-like pouches, this Pokémon is not just satisfying its constant hunger. It's also generating electricity.
name: Morpeko

description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.
name: Snorlax

description: Now armed with a weapon it used in ancient times, this Pokémon needs only a single strike to fell even Gigantamax Pokémon.
name: Zacian

description: Its ability to deflect any attack led to it being known as the Fighting Master's Shield. It was feared and respected by all.
name: Zamazenta

description: As if wielding a bow, it launches the arrow quills hidden among the feathers of its wings. Decidueye's shots never miss.
name: Decidueye

description: The shaking of its freezing upper half is what generates its electricity. It has a hard time walking around.
name: Arctozolt

description: There are a slew of stories about villages that were destroyed by Hydreigon. It bites anything that moves.
name: Hydreigon

description: You shouldn't get close to the child when it's playing outside its mother's pouch. Its mother is always nearby watching over it.
name: Kangaskhan

description: Pikachu that can generate powerful electricity have cheek sacs that are extra soft and super stretchy.
name: Pikachu

description: Via the protrusion on its head, it senses other creatures' emotions. If you don't have a calm disposition, it will never warm up to you.
name: Hatenna

description: Once it has stored up enough heat, this Pokémon's body temperature can reach up to 1,700 degrees Fahrenheit.
name: Flareon

description: It has the ability to alter the composition of its body to suit its surrounding environment.
name: Eevee

description: The cotton on the head of this Pokémon can be spun into a glossy, gorgeous yarn—a Galar regional specialty.
name: Eldegoss

description: This Pokémon rapidly extends its retractable neck to sink its sharp fangs into distant enemies and take them down.
name: Drednaw
